The Snake Princess pits Luffy’s Gum Gum abilities against the incredible Haki Power of her serpentine sisters in a fight to the death. Will Luffy survive long enough to save his statuesque friends?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 414
sub.description:
Luffy kicks his attack mode into second gear to save a precious statue, and the snake sisters start to feel the Straw Hat heat. At the battle’s climax, Luffy makes an impression on his opponents.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 415
sub.description:
News of Luffy’s run-in with the Celestial Dragons impresses the Snake Princess, so she tells him the story of her tortured past. Will his honorable nature speed Luffy toward a reunion with his crew?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 416
sub.description:
Luffy is mobbed by a hoard of pretty amazons eager to touch a real live man. Granny Nyon offers him safe haven, but what she has to say might sink his plans for a Straw Hat reunion.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 417
sub.description:
Boa Hancock`s illness threatens to sabotage Luffy`s rescue mission; however, the Snake Princess just can`t say "no" to the rubberman, so a plan to save Ace is quickly hatched.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 418
sub.description:
While Luffy races to save Ace, Nami tries to survive life on Sky Island, and Franky dances up a snowstorm before making the switch from cola to tea!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 419
sub.description:
Chopper narrowly avoids being served for dinner in a land inhabited by giant birds, and Sanji`s refined tastes land him a role as a leading lady on the island of "girlish hearts".
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 420
sub.description:
Nico Robin finds herself trapped on the island of Tequila Wolf: a miserable land where children are forced to work as slaves. Elsewhere, Usopp tries to survive a run-in with a man-eating plant!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 421
sub.description:
Zoro is held against his will by the pink-haired princess of bad vibes, Brook gets mistaken for the king of darkness, and Luffy continues to eat his way toward a reunion with Fire-Fist Ace!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 422
sub.description:
Luffy and Boa arrive at Impel Down, but only thirty-three hours remain until Ace`s execution. To save him, the Snake Princess must find a way to hide Luffy during her full-body search!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 423
sub.description:
Time is running out on Ace, so Luffy teams up with a scoundrel who`s going to pieces trying to escape Impel Down. There`s no love lost between Buggy the Clown and the Straw Hat captain, but they`d better work together if they want to survive.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 424
sub.description:
Luffy must part ways with a priceless treasure map before Buggy the Clown agrees to lead him through the bloody tangle of Blade Trees and Spike Needle Grass that make up Impel Down`s Crimson Hell!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 425
sub.description:
Luffy and Buggy the Clown could end up as hippo food if they aren`t careful in Impel Down`s Wild Beast Hell. Of course, the rubberman might find that a better fate than dealing with the prison`s putrid warden!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 426
sub.description:
Luffy and his crew stumble upon a most peculiar village when they hitch a ride on a fire-breathing beetle. The natives are petrified of pirates, but they welcome the Straw Hats with open arms!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 427
sub.description:
The citizens of Little East Blue throw a feast in honor of the Straw Hats, but when the Amigo Pirates try to capture Boss the beetle, Luffy and his crew will have to defend their new friends.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 428
sub.description:
Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji prepare to do battle on behalf of Boss the beetle, but Captain Largo of the Amigo Pirates counters with a deadly arsenal of nets to put the Straw Hat brawlers on lock down!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 429
sub.description:
Luffy kicks into second gear for his rematch with Largo, and Nami leads the islanders as they lay waste to the Amigo Pirates. Boss the Beetle may be safe for now, but someone sinister lurks behind the scenes.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 430
sub.description:
Luffy struggles to stay a step ahead of a prison patrol made up of hungry lions and poisonous scorpions! Meanwhile, Ace spends what could be his final hours swapping stories with a pirate who hates pirates.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 431
sub.description:
While the guards struggle to squelch a violent prison uprising, Luffy and his fellow fugitives try to keep their cool in a level of Impel Down known as Starvation Hell!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 432
sub.description:
Boa Hancock uses her ample assets to buy some private time for a clandestine chat with Ace. Meanwhile, Luffy needs help from a graceful friend to escape the jaws of a hungry Sphinx!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 433
sub.description:
Luffy and Bon are on the verge of reaching Level 4, but they didn`t count on fighting a demonic, lightning-fast, devastatingly powerful Minotaur! To defeat this beast, they`ll need help from a human candle and a deranged clown!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 434
sub.description:
Luffy narrowly avoids a deadly dip in a boiling pool of blood, only to find himself face to face with Warden Magellan. Meanwhile, outside the prison walls, the marine fleet prepares for Whitebeard`s onslaught!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 435
sub.description:
Warden Magellan is a monster of a man with a penchant for poisoning prisoners. To rescue Ace, Luffy must go toe to toe with this toxic terror, but how do you defeat a foe who`s deadly to the touch?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 436
sub.description:
Luffy`s daring assault on the venomous warden of Impel Down leaves him struggling to stand up, but despite the lethal poison breaking down his body, the rubber-man kicks his rescue mission into second gear!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 437
sub.description:
Luffy is at the end of the line - the only thing that can save him now is true friendship. But in a place like Impel Down can true friendship be found?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 438
sub.description:
No existing antidote can save Luffy from the poison coursing through his veins, yet Bon Clay refuses to give up. His final, fleeting hope is a mysterious miracle-worker rumored to have vanished into the Gates of Hell!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 439
sub.description:
Bon is overjoyed to hear that Luffy is still alive, but his happiness quickly turns to shock when he learns that Ivan`s agonizingly painful "Healing Hormones" will cost the rubber-man ten years of his life!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 440
sub.description:
Ace is scheduled to be executed in a matter of hours, and Luffy`s still hovering on the verge of death. It will take a miracle to save them both, but Bon would rather die than give up on his friend!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 441
sub.description:
Luffy miraculously survived his brush with death, but he`s far too weak to finish rescuing Ace. Ivan is reluctant to lend a hormonal hand to the doomed rescue mission - until he learns of Luffy`s lineage!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 442
sub.description:
The quest to rescue Ace tuckers out thanks to a blast of sleeping gas! Ivan`s scissor-handed sidekick puts an end to nap time, but Luffy will have to join forces with a scar-faced foe from the past if he wants to complete his mission!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 443
sub.description:
Luffy`s desperate attempt to rescue Ace is bolstered by two powerful new allies: the murderous Crocodile and the honorable fishman Jinbei. Meanwhile, Ivan sparks a prison riot to create a diversion for the rubber-man.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 444
sub.description:
Luffy and his gang of outlaws cause a commotion on Level Four, Blackbeard`s arrival leads to the release of the prison`s most feared inmate, and Ace gazes upon the great blue sky for what could be the very last time!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 445
sub.description:
Ivan undergoes a curvaceous transformation to better battle sadistic Sadie, the commander of the Demon Guards. Meanwhile, Blackbeard and Shiryu head for a showdown on Level 1!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 446
sub.description:
Luffy`s bone-crushing battle with the Vice Warden of Impel Down is interrupted by the sudden appearance of Blackbeard. When the rubber-man hears what the warlord has to say - heads will roll!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 447
sub.description:
Even in Second Gear, Luffy is no match for Blackbeard`s vortex, but the rubber-man rebounds by knocking out a Demon Guard with one ferocious pistol-punch. Elsewhere, Warden Magellan vows to finish Luffy once and for all!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 448
sub.description:
Ace is to be executed in a matter of hours, and Magellan`s toxic breath is singeing the back of Luffy`s neck. Ivan uses a devastating Death Wink to buy some time, but the warden`s Poison Hydra may be more than he can handle!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 449
sub.description:
Luffy dons a suit of waxy armor in preparation for his rematch with Warden Magellan. Outside the prison walls, Jimbei turns a door into a boat, so Crocodile and Buggy can commandeer an escape vessel!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 450
sub.description:
Magellan takes his toxic attack to the next level by unleashing the hideous and deadly Venom Demon! If Jimbei and Crocodile don`t return with a rescue ship soon, Luffy won`t survive long enough to save Ace!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 451
sub.description:
Luffy and his merry band of escapees are safely onboard the rescue ship, but they`re not out hot water just yet. A fleet of marines is bombarding them with cannon balls, and an impenetrable gate looms on the horizon!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 452
sub.description:
Luffy and Ivan mourn the loss of Bon Clay, and Captain Buggy`s reputation gets a boost when a phone call from the Marines reveals the secrets of his past.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 453
sub.description:
While Luffy continues his rescue mission, Nami learns a lesson about how to turn rain into cash, and Franky wakes up in a freezing forest full of ferocious cyborg animals!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 454
sub.description:
Sanji tries to fight his way off a most peculiar island, but his frilly battle costume threatens to awaken his inner maiden. Elsewhere, Chopper tries to avoid being served in a hot pot!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 455
sub.description:
Nico Robin lends her many hands to an overmatched gang of revolutionaries in a frigid land of eternal suffering, and Usopp bulks up to avoid becoming a snack for a hungry, hungry island!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 456
sub.description:
Zoro`s attempt to reunite with his friends leads him a massive tomb and a host of shadowy swordsmen. Elsewhere, Brook uses his status as Satan to get an eyeful of undergarments!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 457
sub.description:
While the marines prepare for Ace`s execution, Luffy looks back on all the good times he shared with his brother, and Jimbei reveals the shocking details of the day Fire Fist Ace went down in defeat!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 458
sub.description:
Luffy and his gang continue on their way to Marineford, but once he arrives, the rubber-man must defeat both Navy Admirals and Warlords of the Sea before he can save Ace!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 459
sub.description:
Citizens and soldiers alike prepare for all-out war as Ace is led to the site of his execution. While the world watches, the true identity of the condemned man`s father is shockingly revealed!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 460
sub.description:
Flashbacks reveal the agonizing sacrifice made by Ace`s mother in order save his life - and the secret behind his connection to Luffy. Back in the present, Whitebeard makes a unexpected entrance!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 461
sub.description:
As a massive seaquake rocks Marineford, Ace recalls the ups and downs of his life as a pirate, including his first encounter with Whitebeard - and the unthinkable betrayal that led to his capture!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 462
sub.description:
Whitebeard begins his attack with a tsunami-spawning sea quake, but the marines counter with a blast of frigid air that turns the tidal wave into an iceberg! Will Luffy and his crew arrive in time to join the battle?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 463
sub.description:
Fire meets ice as mythical warriors, erupting admirals, legendary pirates, and a giant giant go head to head in the biggest, baddest battle of all time! There`s only one thing missing: Monkey D. Luffy!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 464
sub.description:
A towering giant of a giant known as Little Oars Jr. carves a path of death and destruction as he fights to save Ace. The monstrous mauler is within arm`s reach of his friend when he`s intercepted by the seven warlords of the sea!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 465
sub.description:
In the wake of Little Oars Junior`s tragic defeat, Admiral Sengoku hatches a devious plan to speed up the countdown to Ace`s execution. The situation looks beyond bleak until a hero enters the fray from on high!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 466
sub.description:
Luffy appears on the field of battle with a ferocious sense of urgency. Ace could be executed at any minute, and the rubber-man`s refusal to back down impresses even the most feared men in all the world!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 467
sub.description:
Luffy leaps into action, attacking the Naval forces with a frantic display of brutality. Meanwhile, Ace watches in horror as an army of zombies rises up to attack his brother!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 468
sub.description:
Supernatural powers take center stage in the battle to save Ace as Luffy and his uniquely talented allies throw down with the Navy`s own arsenal of Devil Fruit Eaters!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 469
sub.description:
A gift from Boa Hancock and Ivan-san`s Galaxy Wink get Luffy closer to Ace than ever, but a sword-wielding foe from the past threatens to derail the rescue mission!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 470
sub.description:
Luffy runs into a lethal roadblock in the form of Hawk-Eye Mihawk. The legendary swordsman is determined to halt Luffy`s onslaught, but Ivan-san, Boa Hancock, and Jimbei aren`t ready to give up the fight!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 471
sub.description:
Luffy and his pirate brethren have their hands full with an ominous army of unbeatable Kumas! While the inhuman minions march onward, Whitebeard encounters a former ally!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 472
sub.description:
Whitebeard is betrayed - and brutally stabbed - by one of his own men! In the wake of this unthinkable act of treason, allegations about the legendary pirate bring the battle to a halt!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 473
sub.description:
Whitebeard shrugs off his injuries and leads a ferocious charge into the heart of the enemy`s defenses, but three deadly Admirals join forces to silence his shock wave attack as the pirates find themselves surrounded by impenetrable walls!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 474
sub.description:
With the ice melting beneath his feet, Luffy begins a desperate final charge towards his soon-to-be-executed brother. Should his rescue attempt fail, death will surely embrace them both!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 475
sub.description:
Crocodile`s unexpected assistance creates an opening for Luffy to advance, and Whitebeard has a surprise lurking beneath the ice that might swing the momentum in favor of the pirates!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 476
sub.description:
The battle rages on and the bodies pile up as Whitebeard squares off against an Admiral, Luffy gets knocked cold, and the legendary Vice-Admiral Garp finally enters the fray!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 477
sub.description:
While awaiting his execution, Ace flashes back to a trouble youth spent seeking the truth about his father. Meanwhile, Luffy begs Ivan for a potentially-deadly treatment that will allow him to continue fighting!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 478
sub.description:
Luffy makes short work of face from his past, and Whitebeard struggles to withstand the full force of the Marine onslaught. With the executioner`s swords hovering above Ace`s head, Straw Hat Luffy discovers a new ability!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 479
sub.description:
Whitebeard orders his men to help Luffy clear a path to the execution scaffold, but someone close to the Rubber-man rises up to derail the rescue mission at the last second!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 480
sub.description:
Luffy must defeat the man who taught him how to fight - his own grandfather - in order to save Ace. Battling his own flesh and blood won`t be easy, but a waxy ally is there to provide back up!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 481
sub.description:
Ace is finally free from the execution scaffold! Luffy and his brother make a fearsome team as they blaze a path toward salvation. Ravaged by the war, Whitebeard wistfully commands his men to make the journey to the New World without him!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 482
sub.description:
Despite Whitebeard`s order to retreat, Ace is drawn back to the battlefield by the cruel taunts of a Marine adversary. Luffy watches in horror as his brother makes what could be his last stand!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 483
sub.description:
An eerie silence falls over the battlefield as Luffy and Ace share a heartbreaking final moment together. With his dying breath, Ace begs his brother to convey a message to his fellow pirates.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 484
sub.description:
Anguished cries echo across the battlefield in the wake of Ace`s tragic death. Luffy - paralyzed by grief - must be carried to safety, but Whitebeard summons the strength for one last ferocious attack!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 485
sub.description:
Whitebeard’s children watch in horror as the old man faces off the villainous Blackbeard pirates. Though his injuries are mounting and the odds are stacked against him, Whitebeard never, ever runs away from a fight!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 486
sub.description:
The world reacts to Whitebeard`s death with shock and awe. Meanwhile, Jimbei risks his life to save Luffy and Blackbeard reveals the depraved depths of his nefarious nature!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 487
sub.description:
While Blackbeard and his men seek to sink Marineford, Jimbei and Luffy`s desperate attempt to flee is thwarted by Akainu`s fiery fists. The situation appears dire until a former enemy lends a sandy hand!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 488
sub.description:
Trafalgar Law and the Heart Pirates offer Luffy a submarine escape route, Blackbeard continues his reckless rampage, and a puny pink-hair marine changes the world with a scream!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 489
sub.description:
The Heart Pirates head for the bottom of the ocean as Trafalgar Law prepares to operate on Luffy and Jimbei. Meanwhile, the arrival of Shanks brings the bloodshed to a sudden halt!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 490
sub.description:
The world rejoices in the wake of Whitebeard`s death, and a host of powerful pirates vie for his position. Meanwhile, Luffy`s friends fear that Ace`s death may be more than the rubber-man can handle - if he ever wakes up!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 491
sub.description:
Power-hungry pirates terrorize innocent citizens once protected by Whitebeard, and Luffy`s nightmarish awakening sends him on a reckless rampage that could land him in an early grave!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 492
sub.description:
One Piece X Toriko Crossover
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 493
sub.description:
A flashback to the younger days of Luffy and Ace reveals their unusual upbringing under the not-so-watchful eye of villainous mountain bandits!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 494
sub.description:
The flashback continues as Ace robs a ruthless gang of pirates, and Luffy is left to take the fall! Will Ace and his friend Sabo let Luffy be tortured to death - or will they risk their high seas dreams to save him?!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 495
sub.description:
Ace and Sabo race to rescue Luffy from the clutches of a murderous gang of pirates! Sabo wants to grab Luffy and make a break for it, but Ace refuses to back down from a fight - even when he`s outnumbered!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 496
sub.description:
When a nobleman recognizes Sabo in the streets, Luffy and Ace learn the painful secret of their friend`s past. As a sign of solidarity, the three boys pledge to become pirates, and hoist a toast to brotherhood!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 497
sub.description:
After another beating from Garp, Luffy and his friends take to the jungle and build a pirate hideout at the top of an enormous tree. First order of business: booby trap the new place!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 498
sub.description:
Luffy and his friends vow to defeat the giant tiger that`s been stealing their food, Ace gets angry when his father`s identity is revealed, and Sabo`s parents hire pirates to track down their son!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 499
sub.description:
Luffy, Ace, and Sabo take pirate lessons from a mysterious old scallywag who just might know the secret to defeating the big tiger - and becoming a good captian!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 500
sub.description:
The brothers are captured by a gang of pirates, and Sabo is handed over to his noble father, where the boy quickly discovers a sinister plot to destroy Gray Terminal forever!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 501
sub.description:
While flames spread across Gray Terminal, Sabo makes a desperate attempt to escape the trappings of his noble birth and save his brothers. Meanwhile, Luffy and Ace must fight to avoid an untimely end!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 502
sub.description:
Luffy is spared from a fiery death by an unlikely rescuer, but Ace refuses to leave Gray Terminal until he settles the score with Bluejam. Meanwhile, Sabo makes waves with a last ditch escape attempt!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 503
sub.description:
Luffy and Ace receive troubling reports of a Celestial attack on Sabo`s ship. Ace is eager to seek out the responsible parties and extract revenge, but a letter from his absent brother tempers his eagerness to fight!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 504
sub.description:
In the wake of Sabo`s death, Luffy and Ace grow stronger than ever by continuing their daily routine of nonstop fighting. As the years pass, each brother prepares to set sail in search of future adventures!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 505
sub.description:
Garp takes a beating from a heartbroken mountain bandit, and a big, blue friend helps Luffy drown his despair in the newfound desire to reunite with his mates!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 506
sub.description:
One by one, the Straw Hats are crushed to learn the tragic fate of Fire Fist Ace. Despite their own unique problems, the crew members` thoughts immediately turn to their crestfallen captain.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 507
sub.description:
Luffy is determined to reassemble his scattered crew, but a powerful old friend forces him to rethink his plans. Meanwhile, Usopp fights to escape an island that wants to have him for lunch!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 508
sub.description:
Desperate to reach Luffy, Nami risks her life to escape from an island of weather wizards. Meanwhile, Franky rides a carbonation high through the ice and snow in search of a seaworthy vessel!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 509
sub.description:
Zoro`s escape attempt is thwarted by a gang of sword-slinging baboon bullies, and Brook uses music to end a feud between irate islanders with unequal arms!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 510
sub.description:
Chopper hitches a ride on a giant bird, Luffy makes a shocking return to Marineford, and Sanji finds himself fighting the most beautiful man he`s ever seen!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 511
sub.description:
Luffy, along with Jimbei and Dark King Rayleigh, causes quite the commotion upon his return to Marineford. Meanwhile, powerful pirates all across the globe wreak havoc on the innocent!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 512
sub.description:
Luffy hopes to send a message to his mates by way of a clue hidden in a newspaper article. Meanwhile, the Flying Fish Riders protect the Straw Hat`s ship from scandalous scavengers!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 513
sub.description:
Trafalgar Law waits for the right moment to make his move, Blackbeard is pursued by powerful marines, and Chopper makes a surprising return to the land of gargantuan birds!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 514
sub.description:
Nami uses her feminine charms to learn about the New World weather, Franky moves into Dr. Vegapunk`s laboratory, and Sanji must fight to stay out of a cute dress!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 515
sub.description:
The Straw Hats continue preparations for their voyage to the New World as Robin heads for a meeting with the Revolutionary Dragon, Usopp aspires to become King of the Snipers, and Zoro begs his mortal enemy to train him!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 516
sub.description:
Dark King Rayleigh takes Luffy to a deadly, deserted island for two years of intense battle training! If the Straw Hat captain wants to survive in the New World, he`ll have to hone his hidden powers!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 517
sub.description:
After two years of rigorous training, the new and improved Straw Hats make their way to Sabaody Archipelago, but their long-awaited reunion is spoiled by a villainous gang of imposters!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 518
sub.description:
Luffy picks a fight with himself, Chopper falls in with a dubious crowd of imitation pirates, and Zoro causes a commotion when he falls asleep on the wrong ship!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 519
sub.description:
Chopper struggles to make sense of the changes his "friends" have undergone in the last two years, and the Navy mobilizes in an attempt to stop the pirate posers. Will the real Straw Hats please stand up?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 520
sub.description:
Chopper and Usopp flip over Franky`s new body, Brook must choose between rock-n-roll stardom and the life of a pirate, and Luffy wanders into a very dangerous crowd!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 521
sub.description:
While the rest of the Straw Hats prepare to set sail, Luffy gets a chance to show off his new powers in a brutal throw down between notorious pirates, navy soldiers, and deadly Pacifistas!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 522
sub.description:
Luffy and his crew are finally reunited, but before they can set sail, they`ll need help from Dark King Rayleigh, Boa Hancock, and all the friends they`ve made in the last two years!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 523
sub.description:
As word of the Straw Hat resurrection spreads through the Navy, Luffy and his crew get acclimated to their underwater environment, and Franky reveals the startling identity of the man who protected their ship!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 524
sub.description:
The Straw Hats are attacked by a rival gang of pirates, but that may be the least of their worries. Luffy and his crew are on a collision course with a cantankerous Kraken!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 525
sub.description:
After their quarrel with the Kraken, the Straw Hats find themselves in hot water as Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji turn up missing, and the rest of the crew runs short on air!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 526
sub.description:
Thanks to a little help from a friend, Luffy saves his mates from a ghost ship captained by a deranged Dutchman! Unfortunately, their happy reunion is cut short by a volcanic eruption! Can the Hats take the heat?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 527
sub.description:
The Straw Hats finally make it to Fish-Man Island, but their reputation precedes them, leading to trouble with the New Fish-Man Pirates! Only a daring maneuver can get them out of hot water, but there`s no guarantee they`ll survive!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 528
sub.description:
When Sanji gets up close and personal with a mesmerizing mermaid, his extreme fondness for the female form lands him in a life and death situation. Could the Straw Hat chef die from a nosebleed?!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 529
sub.description:
After two generous donors save Sanji from death by nosebleed, Luffy and Usopp take a tour of the island. But their welcome is worn out when a mystic mermaid has a terrifying vision - that Fish-Man Island will be destroyed at the hands of a Straw Hat!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 530
sub.description:
After reuniting with Nami, Luffy and the gang are invited to the royal palace of Neptune, god of the sea! Meanwhile, the New Fish-Man Pirates exploit the power of a designer steroid in order to terrorize humans!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 531
sub.description:
A trio of unsuspecting mermaids find themselves in hot water after releasing a bad guy from his barrel of a prison. Over at the royal palace, Luffy gets up close and personal with the Mermaid Princess!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.description:
Luffy learns the truth about life in Dressrosa under Doflamingo`s reign. Meanwhile, Rebecca needs help from a friend to survive her bone-crushing battle with Logan!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 660
sub.description:
Rebecca continues her valiant stand in the arena of battle, Luffy is reunited with Zoro, and the heartbreaking story of how Doflamingo conquered Dressrosa continues!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 661
sub.description:
Law`s power begins to fade, making him an easy target for Doflamingo`s vicious attacks. Meanwhile, Franky begs Luffy to let him fight alongside Soldier and the little people!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 662
sub.description:
Luffy sets his sights on a showdown with Doflamingo in a desperate attempt to save Law`s life. Sanji, Nami, Chopper, and Brook are attacked by a very deadly foe!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 663
sub.description:
Soldier reveals his daring plan to return all the toys to their human forms, and Luffy has an emotional encounter with someone from his very distant past!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 664
sub.description:
Usopp and Robin join the little people on their mission to turn the toys back into humans, Franky wreaks havoc at the toy house, and Rebecca continues her gladiator battle!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 665
sub.description:
Zoro attracts unwanted attention by upsetting a child, Soldier risks his life to lead the attack on Doflamingo, and Rebecca struggles to survive the brutal battle of Block D!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 666
sub.description:
Rebecca survives an encounter with an opponent`s deadly alter ego, Franky continues his battle with a man who dresses like a baby, and Violet offers to sneak Luffy into the palace!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 667
sub.description:
Franky has his hands full battling a host of enemies at the Toy House, Violet leads Luffy to a secret entrance into the palace, and Fujitora issues Doflamingo a grave warning!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 668
sub.description:
Diamante`s unique abilities and the presence of special Fighting Fish add a deadly wrinkle to the tournament`s final round. Elsewhere, Luffy spoils any chance of sneaking up on Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 669
sub.description:
Luffy tangles with a monster made of stone, Franky bursts into flames after getting shot by a cannon, and the courageous little people hatch a plan to turn the toys back into humans!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 670
sub.description:
Soldier takes a beating from a Doflamingo Family Executive, Lucy shows off a powerful new fighting style, and Zoro pushes his blades to the breaking point in a showdown with a man made of stone!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 671
sub.description:
Zoro repeatedly slices his stone opponent into pieces, but he can`t find a way to make the bad guy stay down. Meanwhile, the bravery of the little people could get them turned into toys!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 672
sub.description:
The Tontattas are devastated by Trebol’s furious attack, but as Usopp tries to convince Leo to abort the operation, Leo tells him about their commander Toy Soldier’s stunning true identity! Meanwhile, with the help of another Tontatta group, the Toy Soldier finally shakes off Lao G and gets moving again!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 673
sub.description:
Zoro continues his deadly duel with the nearly-indestructible Pica! While the Toy Soldier narrowly escapes Lao G only to come face to face with Gladius! Luffy continues his mad dash to the top of the palace to face Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 674
sub.description:
With the Tontattas beaten, Robin turned into a toy, and Luffy, Franky, and the others all busy elsewhere, Usopp is the last hope for Operation SOP! But will he be able to muster the confidence and courage to face the terrible Trebol? Among the cries of the Tontattas, Usopp has a difficult decision to make - run and fight another day or face his own doom and challenge Trebol!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 675
sub.description:
The deep and tragic story of Kyros is revealed! The legend of this invincible gladiator is tied up with the royal family of Dressrosa! Meanwhile, Trebol`s defeat at the hands of Usopp is not a sure thing yet!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 676
sub.description:
In the Royal Palace, Viola, Luffy, and the Toy Soldier have hidden themselves outside Doflamingo`s chamber, only to have more enemies approach from behind, leaving them surrounded! Meanwhile, Franky is knocked out cold by the Navy, and all hopes rest on Usopp to provide the miracle everyone needs!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 677
sub.description:
Usopp manages to knock Sugar out and Operation SOP is accomplished! The toys in Dressrosa start turning back to their original forms and the people are slowly realizing who Doflamingo really is! In the meantime, the legendary hero Kyros reverts to his true form - and this mighty champion of the Colosseum has a score to settle!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 678
sub.description:
Kyros finally taking down Doflamingo leaves Doflamingo’s clan shocked! Meanwhile at the Colosseum, Rebecca gets her memories of her loving father Kyros back, and Sabo makes a move to end the championship battle by blowing up the whole ring! Will he be able to snag the Flare-Flare Fruit?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 679
sub.description:
Luffy hurries to free Law, but with their pirate alliance dissolved, will Law still see Luffy as an ally? Meanwhile, Usopp has convinced his new-found followers to destroy the factory! Doflamingo`s defeat has thrown Dressrosa into chaos, but the Young Master may have a trick left up his sleeve...
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 680
sub.description:
The mystery of Doflamingo`s return from the dead is revealed! But there isn`t much time to ponder how it happened, as his plan to silence the country of Dressrosa unfolds, spelling doom for the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 681
sub.description:
As the people of Dressrosa see their friends and loved ones slaughter each other under the manipulation of Doflamingo, memories of 10 years ago rush back, and the truth of that event becomes clear. Doflamingo announces the rules for his deadly game - targeting Luffy, King Riku, and Law, but with the highest bounty reserved for Usopp!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 682
sub.description:
Doflamingo and Fujitora`s agreement to not engage each other lasts for the moment - meaning all eyes are turned towards taking down the Straw Hats and claiming the rewards! And as Luffy starts heading to the Royal Palace along with Zoro and Law, Fujitora stands in his way!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 683
sub.description:
Robin, Usopp, the Tontatta`s and the others make moves to rejoin Luffy as Doflamingo`s deadly game rages on! Meanwhile, Kin`emon makes it to the trash heap in his search for his friend Kanjuro - just as Pica emerges in the town and changes the stakes of the game!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 684
sub.description:
With Luffy and the others recovering from Pica`s attack, the game is afoot! Luffy has just enough time to regroup and set out to find Doflamingo, only to find that the dastardly Warlord has more enemies than he might realize! A strange argument breaks out - to decide who gets to take down Doflamingo once and for all!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 685
sub.description:
Don Chin Jao and Elizabello successfully break Pica’s giant arm but the rock giant is unfazed and starts throwing even more destructive punches at Luffy and his band of unwanted collaborators! Meanwhile, Navy Admiral Fujitora moves into action, summoning all the Navy soldiers on the island!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 686
sub.description:
Luffy and Moocy fast approach the showdown with Doflamingo - while the others with a beef against him continue to tag along. Meanwhile, Violet finds the key to Law`s handcuffs, and Rebecca pledges to deliver it to him. Finally, Law`s reason for despising Doflamingo is revealed!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 687
sub.description:
Luffy makes headway toward Doflamingo`s refuge, making his way through Doflamingo`s guards, while down below Admiral Fujitora faces off against Sabo, who has the power of the Fire Fist from eating the Flare-Flare Fruit! But with Fujitora`s ability to call down a meteor, will Sabo have to power to save himself?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 688
sub.description:
Luffy cuts a lucky break as Kelly Funk shows him a shortcut to the Palace! But all may not be as it seems... Meanwhile, Franky and Zoro are locked in one-on-one duels, while Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo enlist the help of the Tontattas to catch up with Luffy and Law!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 689
sub.description:
Penned in at the bottom of a well, Luffy and Law are caught in a trap! But someone has come to save them who they least expect! Meanwhile, the Tontattas help Franky break in to the SMILE factory, and Bartolomeo resorts to tactics he used in the Colosseum to defend himself and protect Robin and Rebecca!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 690
sub.description:
The Tontattas locate their captive comrades and seem to be able to get the message to them - the prison break is on! Meanwhile, heavy-hitters from the Colosseum turn from wringing each other`s necks towards a unified plan, which might just be enough to get Luffy the chance to make it to a final showdown with Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 691
sub.description:
Hidden far underground, Kin`emon finds his old friend Kanjuro, whose powers allow the two to, quickly, but not elegantly, escape to the surface! Meanwhile, Cavendish shares his fears that the "Birdcage" game Doflamingo is playing has been rigged all along - and that the only way to win is to take the Warlord down!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 692
sub.description:
The Tontattas are in full revolt! But can they keep their wits about them long enough to make it out? Meanwhile, Zoro finally gains the upper hand against Pica, and Franky finds a way to deal with Señor Pink.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 693
sub.description:
Franky finally makes it into the factory and the Tontattas are reunited with their captive friends! But Princess Mansherry is nowhere to be found. Factory manager Kuween becomes irate when ignored and launches an attack on Franky while Señor Pink, wise to Frankie`s deception, arrives on the scene ready for a manly showdown!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 694
sub.description:
Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo draw closer to the Flower Field on the fourth level of the Royal Palace plateau, but a sudden attack by Gladius exploding spheres sends Robin and Bartolomeo hurtling towards the level below - and directly into Luffy and the others` battle with the creepy Headcracker Dolls!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 695
sub.description:
Rebecca makes it to the Flower Field alone, but unfortunately finds company there that is less than friendly! Meanwhile, Bartolomeo pushes himself to the limit in order to help Luffy advance, but does he leave himself vulnerable in the process? Meanwhile, Sabo tastes Fujitora`s full might!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 696
sub.description:
Diamante has Rebecca pinned and completely overpowered. If only the Soldier-san of her youth were able to protect her! Meanwhile, Luffy and Law finally surmount incredible odds to land themselves in striking distance of Doflamingo -- but Sugar stands in their way!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 697
sub.description:
Usopp uses Viola`s Clairvoyance to prepare his ammunition to take Sugar out! But the slightest hesitation now will spell disaster -- and the end of Luffy! Luckily for the Straw Hats, Usopp`s ammunition has been specially designed for this specific situation!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 698
sub.description:
The final showdown with Doflamingo begins, but the Warlord still has several tricks up his sleeve - including turning one of Luffy`s own friends against him! Meanwhile Franky and Señor Pink are in a standoff to find out who is the coolest.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 699
sub.description:
All hopes rest on Luffy and Law being able to take down Doflamingo; but the Warlord has other plans in mind as he gives the two the fight of their lives, and reveals his true, shocking history! Meanwhile, Sabo finds out Fujitora’s true intention…
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 700
sub.description:
With Fujitora`s stalemate arousing suspicion in the Navy ranks, Law and Luffy stand seconds away from execution at the hand of Doflamingo! But before he dispatches them both, he shares the secret of his sway over the Celestial Dragons!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 701
sub.description:
The horrible secret of Flevance, the White Town, is revealed, giving clues to Law`s traumatic past! A rage born from the lies of the World Government created a child who had the will to kill Corazon!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 702
sub.description:
Law`s attack on Corazon looks less successful than he thought! And after he`s accepted into the Doflamingo Family, Corazon`s mysterious silence hides a fact that may save Law`s life - and a hidden danger Law must face in Doflamingo himself!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 703
sub.description:
Things grow stranger for Law as he learns the secret behind why Corazon feigns being mute! But the mysterious Corazon`s actions are only beginning to baffle Law as he takes him on a journey to cure his White Lead Disease.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 704
sub.description:
Corazon`s double-dealing with the Navy raises suspicions both with Doflamingo and Law. But all that is secondary as Corazon finally has a chance to grab the Op-Op Fruit during a staged handoff arranged by the Government.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 705
sub.description:
The Op-Op Fruit is in Corazon`s hands! But the price he paid to get it might be too high... When Law goes for help, unfortunate coincidences intervene and leave the two vulnerable! Meanwhile, Doflamingo and his clan finally land at Minion Island; the location of Corazon and Law!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 706
sub.description:
Doflamingo and his Family begin to zero in on Corazon and Law`s whereabouts, but Corazon has a plan to hide Law long enough to let him escape - even if that means sacrificing his own life. However, when things turn sour, it`s a chain of lucky coincidences that allows the plan to be set into motion - almost as though someone or something is keeping Law alive!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 707
sub.description:
Violet runs down the status of the open battles raging in Dressrosa - the Straw Hats, the Tontattas, the executives of the Doflamingo Family - all of them clash around the island, but it`s Law`s revelation to Doflamingo that moves the action forward!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 708
sub.description:
Luffy continues to battle Fake-mingo, but keeps accidentally battling Bellamy instead. Meanwhile the tide of battle turns against Law as painful scars from the past resurface. And Zoro gets unexpected help in his battle with Pica.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 709
sub.description:
Bellamy escapes Doflamingo`s control, but it might be too late. His long history with Doflamingo unfolds and leads to an inglorious end. Meanwhile, Hajrudin has been beaten down, but a fire still burns in him to pay back the favor he owes!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 710
sub.description:
Lao G and Don Chin Jao duke it out as each brings their most devastating attacks to the battle. But a misunderstanding caused by Baby 5 has Sai and Don Chin Jao distracted - are they distracted enough for Lao G to gain the upper hand?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 711
sub.description:
Law is at the whim of Doflamingo and Trebol, while Luffy still has to deal with Bellamy, who fights to keep his honor even after being released by Doflamingo! Meanwhile, Gladius is about to detonate the ground around Cavendish and Bartolomeo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 712
sub.description:
A mysterious force that resembles Cavendish menaces the battlefield - but while it appears to help Bartolomeo and the others at first, it sets its sights on Robin! Meanwhile, the deeply-wounded Ideo sees Dellinger’s horrible true nature!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 713
sub.description:
Bartolomeo is in a neck and neck battle against Gladius to save Robin, and is faced with an impossible dilemma. With all his options leading to their defeat, can his cunning ploy save the day? Meanwhile, Robin is face to face with Cavendish, but his evil aspect Hakuba keeps complicating the situation more!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 714
sub.description:
Princess Mansherry`s amazing power - to heal living beings completely - is in the hands of the Donquixote executive. If she is able to heal all the executives who`ve gone down in battle - the Straw Hats and their allies stand no chance! It`s up to Leo to save the day!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 715
sub.description:
Señor Pink and Franky continue their knock-down, drag-out, manly fight. As both of them are pushed to their limits, we learn Señor`s tragic past! Meanwhile, Princess Mansherry`s rescue hits a snag as she stubbornly refuses to leave!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 716
sub.description:
Franky and Señor Pink end their harrowing duel in a manly way - but victory knocks the wind out of even the winner`s sails! Meanwhile, Diamante and Kyros struggle desperately on the Sunflower Field, each demonstrating their extreme prowess even in near defeat!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 717
sub.description:
Kyros, unbowed by Diamante`s vicious attacks, fights back with the anger and retribution of all of Dressrosa in order to fulfill his promise to protect Rebecca. If he is successful, only a few executives will remain, setting the stage for the Straw Hats` victory.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 718
sub.description:
Pica loses his temper and turns his full wrath against King Riku, whom he hopes to destroy, ending the revolution against Doflamingo. Meanwhile, Zoro, who has been distracted by Pica and drawn far from the battle, has to hatch a plan to save the king!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 719
sub.description:
With the lives of King Riku, Usopp, and the others on the old King`s Plateau in the balance, Zoro must dig deep and discover a powerful technique to counter Pica`s near-unstoppable onslaught. Meanwhile, King Riku ponders what it means to be a good king.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 720
sub.description:
Zoro finishes off Pica, and those below his crumbling body rush to find shelter. Meanwhile, the Tontattas finish up demolishing the SMILE Factory, and Luffy`s hand is forced in his duel with Bellamy!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 721
sub.description:
Taking down Bellamy only enrages Luffy in his fight against Doflamingo, his anger multiplying when he finds Law`s lifeless body! Meanwhile, Doflamingo takes the next step to end the game he started, which will endanger everybody in Dressrosa!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 722
sub.description:
The Birdcage draws tighter and tighter around Dressrosa, threatening to destroy all life on the island kingdom! Meanwhile, Doflamingo stands down Luffy for a final confrontation, but a surprising twist shocks everyone on the top of the Royal Palace!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 723
sub.description:
Law`s attack proves powerful - but Doflamingo`s power has depths which he and Luffy haven`t bargained for. When Doflamingo makes his counterattack, Luffy stares him down with an amazing power.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 724
sub.description:
Trebol`s wrath is fully inflamed as Law summons enough energy to speak, denouncing the Doflamingo Family executives as pawns in Doflamingo`s game. But Law gathers enough energy to do more than just speak out.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 725
sub.description:
Cavendish has to make a difficult decision when the severely wounded Law begs him to be left behind. Meanwhile, seeing even his Second Gear or Third Gear attacks aren`t working against Doflamingo, Luffy decides to use his ultimate technique!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 726
sub.description:
Luffy and Doflamingo duke it out while the Birdcage tightens its grip on Dressrosa! Zoro sets off with a plan to stop it from slicing apart the country, while Luffy`s Fourth Gear proves quite potent against Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 727
sub.description:
The Birdcage continues its merciless constriction, sending the residents of Dressrosa fleeing towards the center of the island, while King Riku calls out to his people; survive long enough for Luffy to vanquish the last of the royal family - Doflamingo himself!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 728
sub.description:
Fourth Gear gives Luffy the power he needs to head off Doflamingo at every strike! But the energy required to keep Fourth Gear going starts to take a toll on Luffy. Will he have enough left to finish the job?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 729
sub.description:
Bounce-man`s power has drained Luffy, leaving him in need of a rest before he can reuse his Haki, but luckily the gladiators from the Colosseum have come around and are focusing on taking down Doflamingo! Sabo steps in at a crucial moment to defend his brother, Luffy!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 730
sub.description:
With Luffy and so many of the Straw Hats` allies incapacitated, victory seems inevitable for Doflamingo - but the compassion of Mansherry may be enough to turn the tide and renew their hope - to stop the Birdcage!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 731
sub.description:
With just over a minute to spare, everyone in Dressrosa turns their efforts towards slowing down the Birdcage as it squeezes the life out of the country! Meanwhile, Viola seeks Doflamingo out herself, for a shocking confrontation!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 732
sub.description:
Only a bit more time remains before Luffy returns to the scene! But as time slips by, those who had been roused by Princess Mansherry`s powers begin to falter! Meanwhile, Rebecca, under the control of Doflamingo, is about to attack Viola!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 733
sub.description:
Luffy regains enough Haki to face off against Doflamingo, but his health is still poor. With the Birdcage closing in, is there a technique left in his repertoire that is strong enough to take down Doflamingo?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 734
sub.description:
With Doflamingo thoroughly quashed and the Birdcage collapsing, the people of Dressrosa shed tears of joy remembering the hardships they`ve endured, and the actions taken by Luffy and the others to free them.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 735
sub.description:
Jesus Burgess of the Blackbeard Pirates tries to agitate Sabo, mocking Ace`s final words in order to unsettle him enough that he can try to steal the Flare-Flare Fruit! Meanwhile, people of Dressrosa beg King Riku to resume the crown when Navy Admiral Fujitora steps in and takes a stunning action!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 736
sub.description:
Repercussions of Doflamingo`s defeat reverberate around the world! Fujitora`s actions put the Navy in a tight spot, and the "Worst Generation" beings to stir into action!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 737
sub.description:
The combatants in the battle for Dressrosa can finally begin to recoup, but those who stay awake are treated to the story of how Sabo joined the Revolutionary Army!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 738
sub.description:
Sabo recounts his surprising reunion with Luffy at the Colosseum as the Straw Hats and the others continue to recoup. Meanwhile, Fujitora gambles on how to make his next move - and the odds are in Luffy`s favor!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 739
sub.description:
As Sabo departs, our attention shifts to the other Straw Hats waging a fierce battle on a mysterious island. And a new drama is set into motion as ill portents fall from the sky!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 740
sub.description:
As Luffy and the others begin to come to their senses, major players in the Navy arrive to search Dressrosa for the Straw Hats! Also, Rebecca`s history is whitewashed with a fake cover story - but why?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 741
sub.description:
Fujitora`s flirting with chance has turned out poorly for the Straw Hats as the full Navy force bears down on Dressrosa searching for the pirates! Luffy and the others make a mad dash for the east port to get off the island, but not without finishing up a piece of business...
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 742
sub.description:
Rebecca has precious little time to follow Luffy`s lead and make it to Kyros. Can she make it in time? Meanwhile, Fujitora is closing in on Bartolomeo and the other Colosseum warriors while Trafalgar Law faces the shadows of his past!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 743
sub.description:
Law and Sengoku share memories of Corazon, and the secret of Trafalgar Law`s name. Meanwhile, Fujitora uses the destruction caused by the battle in Dressrosa as a weapon, and squares off one-on-one with Luffy!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 744
sub.description:
The people of Dressrosa show their appreciation to the Straw Hats one last time by foiling Fujitora`s strategy. As Luffy and the others are able to finally make their break from the island, however, an unbelievable new chapter opens in the story of the Straw Hat Pirates!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 745
sub.description:
With newfound allies won in the battle at Dressrosa, and as the Navy watches, Luffy and the Straw Hats depart Dressrosa for open water. But will Luffy accept the oath of allegiance given by his new fleet?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 746
sub.description:
While the Straw Hats are underway, Doflamingo has serious predictions for the upset of the world order! Meanwhile, the recent actions in Dressrosa have led to surprising results!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 747
sub.description:
While heading to the next island, Zou, Luffy’s appetite causes them trouble and he and Bartolomeo find themselves entangled in the scheme of a pirate lord who can manipulate silver.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 748
sub.description:
The Tram-Man arrives! And has Luffy, Bartolomeo and Desire on the run! The deeper the three fall into the pit, however, the more clear it becomes that Bill`s group hides a terrible secret!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 749
sub.description:
Luffy, Bartolomeo, and Desire make their way up the mineshaft, but Bill`s assassin, Peseta, has other plans! Just when the going gets tough, help arrives, and Zoro battles the assassin head on!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 750
sub.description:
Luffy, Desire, and Bartolomeo go up against Bill! But the mad, Smelt-Smelt man becomes deranged and lets his true power unfurl! Do Luffy and the others have any hope of exposing Bill`s self-serving aims and turning his gang against him?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 751
sub.description:
Bartolomeo recounts the formation of the Straw Hats, sharing their moving story with the rest of his crew! Meanwhile, the mysterious island of Zou approaches in the distance, obscured by fog. But when the haze clears, no one is expecting what they see!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 752
sub.description:
Luffy and the others arrive at the mysterious land of Zou, and find the Sunny. But when they board, they find the other Straw Hats have already disembarked. Thus, Luffy, Zoro, Robin and the others take on the challenge of climbing the monstrous elephant!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 753
sub.description:
Finally scaling the elephant`s back, the Straw Hats continue their search for the other half of their crew! But the mysterious "island" on the back of the elephant may hold more danger than they bargained for, as they learn they are not alone!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 754
sub.description:
Luffy pushes deeper into the mysterious forest on the elephant’s back, but he`s treading in territory where is not welcome! Meanwhile, Usopp and the others make a startling discovery in a ruined city!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 755
sub.description:
Luffy and the others survive the Rain-Ruption and learn of its vital role in maintaining life on Zou. They continue on towards the fortress learning more about the mysterious Mink Tribe, and are finally reunited with the others - but is that the whole story?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 756
sub.description:
Luffy and the others are unexpectedly welcomed at the fortress and treated well by the Minks, although they have to navigate some cultural differences… And Nami starts sharing what happened to them after they left Dressrosa.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 757
sub.description:
Luffy and the others learn about the dangerous intruders who have come to Zou, and why the island is wrecked! Afterwards, Luffy`s loose lips get them into trouble!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 758
sub.description:
Duke Dogstorm - the Straw Hats finally meet the ruler of this strange land, and learn more about the battle that took place here; and the mysterious system by which the island is ruled!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 759
sub.description:
Day turns to night as the Minks keep up their onslaught against the invading Beast Pirates! But Jack`s amazing Devil Fruit power may end the elephant island once and for all!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 760
sub.description:
Night and day, Jack faces the fury of the two sworn defenders of Zou, but while they put up a good fight, the Minks aren`t able to subdue Jack, especially after he brings out his secret weapon...
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 761
sub.description:
In the aftermath of Jack`s deadly attack on the island of Zou, Chopper and Sanji rush in to save the fallen Mink Tribe - but they will need the help of Caesar to overcome the poisonous effects of the gas!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 762
sub.description:
More of the dramatic happenings on Zou are revealed as we learn that Jack`s pirate band were not the only visitors to the elephant island! And what about the mysterious fate of Sanji?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 763
sub.description:
The mystery of Sanji`s disappearance deepens as Luffy learns that Big Mom`s lackeys have caught up with him and the rest - and carry with them an invitation from Big Mom that simply can`t be refused!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 764
sub.description:
Sanji`s dire situation has become clear, but instead of rallying against Big Mom`s crew, he submits to go along with them to bring an end to this situation. But being separated from one of his crew is more than Luffy is willing to tolerate!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 765
sub.description:
There`s only one key to finding out what happened to Sanji - and Luffy and the others make their way towards finding out more about their friend`s disappearance, but on their way the indigenous fauna give them trouble!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 766
sub.description:
Luffy hatches a plan to help Sanji, but he`ll have to go alone to avoid an all-out war with Big Mom. Meanwhile, Kin`emon and Kanjuro finally arrive at Zou, unwittingly setting the stage for the Minks` thirst for revenge!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 767
sub.description:
The samurai have landed! And they make their way into the country of Zou unaware of the welcome they will receive by the Minks! The Straw Hats try their best to stop the fight - but as day meets night and Cat Viper and Dogstorm face each other, tensions run high in the elephant country!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 768
sub.description:
Revelations abound as the true nature of the Wano clan and their relationship with the Minks is revealed! Momonosuke`s role is greater than any had imagined! But even more shocking - the visage of Raizo the Ninja!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 769
sub.description:
The mysteries of ninjutsu enthrall the Straw Hats as Raizo, the implausible ninja, makes his true powers known! Meanwhile, a mysterious artifact points the way towards the end of the Grand Line!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 770
sub.description:
The mystery of the Ponegliffs is revealed - their true significance, and the story of their creation, leads closer to the Straw Hats than they might have imagined!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 771
sub.description:
More mysteries of the Kozuki Clan are revealed - and the samurai propose an alliance to help topple Kaido! But Luffy`s response will shock the crew... and force the young daimyo to take responsibility!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 772
sub.description:
Dogstorm and Cat Viper share their story of being on the journey with Oden and Roger but are interrupted by Nami who is concerned about the sea route. Meanwhile, Jack is plotting to bring down the Mokomo Dukedom again!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 773
sub.description:
The plans are set! The Straw Hats divide and conquer, one group heading to save Sanji, the others to the Land of Wano! But in the final moments before their departure, the tremendous elephant island begins to quake!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 774
sub.description:
After being aggressively attacked by Jack`s fleet, the monstrous Zunesha comes to life and beckons to those on its back! But can the Straw Hats understand its cry? And realize in time what the elephant island needs from them?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 775
sub.description:
With the skirmish with Jack now over, the Straw Hats move on to trying to bandage the great elephant`s wounds! But just as the whole island puts the plan into action, unseen danger lurks on horizon!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 776
sub.description:
The Straw Hats and the others split up into four teams, each on different missions! Some from the Mink Tribe insist on leaving with Luffy’s team! Meanwhile, Usopp makes a weapon for Nami that seems to work like magic!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 777
sub.description:
Luffy`s team sets out from Zou on their way to win back Sanji! But they didn`t realize there is one more crewmember than they have bargained for! Meanwhile, the leading families and leaders of the world make their way to Mariejois for the pivotal world meeting!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 778
sub.description:
Carrot stows away! And settles in with the Straw Hats as they make their way to rescue Sanji! Meanwhile, in the Sakura Kingdom - formerly the Drum Kingdom, Dalton and Kureha are getting ready for the Reverie so as their former enemy in his newly-built kingdom…
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 779
sub.description:
News of the raid on the Revolutionary Army reaches Luffy! But that`s the least of their worries as they face a storm and a sudden lack of provisions! Meanwhile, Emperor Kaido, furious at the loss of Joker, fumes with anger at the reckless generation of upstarts!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 780
sub.description:
Sneaking in to the Navy island facility to replenish their food supply, Luffy and the others risk being caught out in the open! Will their infamy make them easy to spot by the hotheaded Navy recruits around them?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 781
sub.description:
The jig is up as Luffy and the others make a daring dash to avoid the furious Navy! Can they escape without having to turn to fight - and after they`ve had a chance to raid the cabinets for food?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 782
sub.description:
Making a mad dash for the Submerge with the food they stole, Luffy and the others have to get through some of the Navy`s upstart soldiers! Grount, whose arm holds incredible power, summons his training to challenge Luffy!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 783
sub.description:
The Straw Hats continue to suffer from blazing heat and a perilous food crisis! As the seas finally calm, fishing is their only hope! Meanwhile, Sanji arrives in Big Mom`s territory and keeps his cool - until he sees his bride-to-be!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 784
sub.description:
Luffy is in danger as the venomous fish poison courses through his body! With no antidotes on board, the Straw Hats must rely on a mysterious ship for help - a ship that bears a truly surprising crew!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 785
sub.description:
On the edge of life and death, Luffy`s only hope rests with Sanji`s siblings! But even though they refuse to share an antidote, they may be able to save Luffy`s life yet, giving him enough energy to plunge right back into trouble...
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 786
sub.description:
Arriving on Cacao Island, Luffy and Chopper are in heaven as everything before their eyes is edible! But in this most heavenly of places, there are rules to be obeyed - and consequences for breaking them! Luckily someone is on the lookout for the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 787
sub.description:
The Straw Hats confront Pudding - the fiancée of Sanji! But when they challenge her for Sanji`s heart, her answer shocks them! Meanwhile an ominous and mysterious message may spell doom for the Straw Hats...
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 788
sub.description:
The dangerous waters around the Whole Cake Island harbor terrifying creatures that pose a challenge for the Straw Hats! Meanwhile, Mama slips into a bout of her sickness and ravages her own land in search a specific pastry!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 789
sub.description:
Big Mom rampages through the Whole Cake Island in search for sweets - but when the kitchen can`t prepare them fast enough her own son steps in to curb the carnage, with deadly results. Only an old face coming across the waters brings Mom what she needs, even though he also brings ill tidings.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 790
sub.description:
As the Straw Hats draw closer to the Whole Cake Island, Pedro shares his sordid past in Big Mom’s territory - and hatches a plan to win back Sanji and take an item of great worth from the Emperor!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 791
sub.description:
Brook and Pedro head out in a submersible to infiltrate Big Mom`s stronghold! Meanwhile Luffy, Nami, Chopper and Carrot head into the island chasing the image of Sanji, only to be distracted by the endless supply of sweets and a second Luffy!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 792
sub.description:
Lost in the bewildering woods and chasing after Sanji, Nami and the others find there`s more than meets the eye in this upside down part of the Whole Cake Island! Meanwhile, Sanji confronts his brother!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 793
sub.description:
Luffy continues to move through the mysterious and dangerous woods, unaware of the danger that lurks in the trees! Meanwhile, Sanji confronts his father as the wounds of his childhood are laid bare!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 794
sub.description:
Sanji faces off against his father in a duel! His powerful kicks aim at protecting his hands, but the Germa Family has more in store for him yet! Meanwhile Luffy goes deeper into the Seducing Woods and falls for their powerful illusions!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 795
sub.description:
Big Mom has Caesar Clown at her whims - and despite his bilking her out of countless amounts of money - she is ready to continue her pursuit of maniacal world control! Meanwhile, Big Mom`s forces are on to the Straw Hats, and Pekoms faces a dire situation!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 796
sub.description:
Finally Nami finds Luffy and recounts her harrowing tale of battling Brulee! Meanwhile the mysterious half-buried man comes clean about his true identity! But this must all be put aside when one of Mom`s most powerful generals comes calling!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 797
sub.description:
The identity of the enigmatic Pound, the man half-buried in the woods, is revealed, but his deep connection to Big Mom might not be enough to save him! Nami`s past exploits, however, hold the key to keeping Mom`s minions at bay!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 798
sub.description:
Luffy squares off against Cracker, one of the Sweet 3 Generals, as Nami learns the truth about others in the Worst Generation who have come before to challenge Big Mom!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 799
sub.description:
Luffy continues to fight against Cracker, whose powers to manipulate his surroundings may prove more troublesome than he had thought! Meanwhile, Brook and Pedro infiltrate the Whole Cake Island - and must hatch a plan to avoid getting caught!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 800
sub.description:
The wind starts to go out of Luffy`s sails as he fights an endless army of Biscuit Warriors! Meanwhile, the oldest two Vinsmoke brothers come home from a war to see their long-missing young brother Sanji.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 801
sub.description:
Luffy starts to run out of steam as the Biscuit Warriors keep multiplying! If he can buy himself 10 minutes to recharge... Meanwhile, Sanji squares off against his family, but realizes they have some vital insurance to make sure he follows their scheme to marry Pudding.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 802
sub.description:
Luffy needs just 10 minutes to recharge! Nami comes to rescue with the help of the Homies! Meanwhile, Sanji learns the terrible truth of Germa`s power - and his father`s dark history!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 803
sub.description:
Nami challenges Cracker on her own! During the all-out fight, she loses her advantage and is close to defeat. Can Luffy bounce back in time? Meanwhile, Sanji`s tragic childhood is made clear.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 804
sub.description:
The terrible history of Sanji`s family continue to unfold. From a rare moment of compassion he is able to escape, only to face his father`s cruelty before setting out on his own.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 805
sub.description:
Luffy is in an all-out, all-you-can-eat battle! As Cracker`s endless stream of Biscuit Warriors marches on, Luffy`s endless appetite is put to the test. Meanwhile, Reiju helps Sanji to straighten himself out before he meets his fiancée.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 806
sub.description:
Luffy needs to think fast in order to turn the battle in his favor - filled with biscuits he debuts a new Gear Four attack that has lasting repercussions! Meanwhile, Chopper and Carrot find Sanji`s reflection, but can they get a message to him in time?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 807
sub.description:
Luffy finally catches up with Sanji! However, as a happy past plays before his eyes in which he, Sanji, and the crew deepened their bonds, a new page is turning in the history of the Straw Hats - and Sanji`s journey with the crew looks to be coming to an end!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 808
sub.description:
Luffy finally catches up with Sanji! However, as a happy past plays before his eyes in which he, Sanji, and the crew deepened their bonds, a new page is turning in the history of the Straw Hats - and Sanji`s journey with the crew looks to be coming to an end!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 809
sub.description:
Luffy makes a solemn promise to not move from his spot until Sanji returns to him. But as Mama`s army advances, that promise may prove a costly one. Meanwhile, Sanji and the Vinsmokes come face to face with Big Mom and his bride-to-be Pudding!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 810
sub.description:
Luffy stands his ground and waits for his friend to return! But the vengeful army washes over him - only a true friend can step in to turn the tide of battle! Meanwhile, Sanji and Pudding discuss their marriage - and come to a startling conclusion!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 811
sub.description:
Luffy puts his all into battling Big Mom`s vengeful army, however, their skills combined prove too formidable. Meanwhile, Sanji goes to Big Mom herself to bargain for the Straw Hats lives - with shocking results!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 812
sub.description:
Chopper and Carrot are captured by Brulee and strung up for dinner! But Chopper sees a chance to free himself! Meanwhile, Brook and Pedro launch a plan to reach the Ponegliffs - a daring game of chance!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 813
sub.description:
Pekoms creates a diversion for Brook to set his plan into action. Meanwhile Luffy continues to goad Big Mom into a fight, and Pudding begins to have stirrings of rebellion herself!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 814
sub.description:
Just when Luffy and Nami are in Big Mom`s grasp, Pudding arrives, but with news that they aren`t expecting - meanwhile Brook and Chopper both make headway getting out of their own jams!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 815
sub.description:
Sanji hopes his wedding with Pudding will solve the Straw Hat`s predicament - but Pudding secretly plans to to avoid the marriage, sharing a secret with Luffy. Meanwhile Brook comes face to face with Big Mom herself!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 816
sub.description:
Luffy tries desperately to free himself as the risk of his own well-being! Meanwhile, Chopper and Carrot continue to search the mirror universe, Brook squares off against Big Mom, and Pedro’s past is revealed!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 817
sub.description:
Luffy struggles to break himself free as Sanji falls deeper in love with the idea of marrying Pudding... But the mask falls off and the deadly charade of Big Mom is revealed as the depths of her treachery come to light!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 818
sub.description:
Brook continues his all-out struggle against Big Mom, but his secret weapon might not be enough to save him! Meanwhile an unexpected ally from the past comes to the rescue!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 819
sub.description:
Jimbei arrives on the scene and works to free Luffy and Nami! Meanwhile Sanji confronts his sister with the awful truth of Pudding, and she confides in him the powerful secret of their mother`s undying love!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 820
sub.description:
Brook finds himself totally at the whim of Big Mom, and comes face to face with her brutal love! Meanwhile, Pedro reveals his explosive plan to create a distraction!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 821
sub.description:
Chopper and Carrot use the mirror dimension to get in touch with Nami and Jimbei! Luffy makes it through more obstacles to learn that he just missed Sanji! Meanwhile, Sanji wonders alone about the best course of action.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 822
sub.description:
Brook hears Big Mom`s plan firsthand as she shares her intentions with Pudding in front of him! Meanwhile Big Mom`s agents believe most of the Straw Hats to be under control, but doubt besets Montd`Or.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 823
sub.description:
Nami and the others finally find Brook in the mirror dimension - but he`s in the most inopportune of places! Can they challenge the sleeping Mama and rescue their friend? Meanwhile, Luffy is waylaid on his way back to the rendezvous!
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 824
sub.description:
Luffy puts up a valiant fight in order to keep his word to Sanji! But will he be able to last until Sanji arrives at the rendezvous? Meanwhile, Jimbei shares the awful truth about the wedding with the other Straw Hats.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 825
sub.description:
Sanji and Luffy meet finally - and while he is happy to feed Luffy to replenish his energy, Sanji`s explanation of what actions he must take baffles Luffy! The crucial decision, to turn his back on his friends or his family, tears Sanji apart!
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 826
sub.description:
The newly reunited Luffy and Sanji hear from the rest of the Straw Hats in the mirror dimension! Then, Jimbei starts telling them about Capone “Gang” Bege and proposes a shocking plan to take down Big Mom!
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 827
sub.description:
The Straw Hats put Jimbei`s plan into action and approach Bege with the possibility of an alliance. But before they are granted an audience, they must make themselves presentable! At the same time, Nami learns about the terror of Big Mom from Lola`s twin sister!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 828
sub.description:
The proposed alliance between the Straw Hats and Bege unfolds! A gaseous blast from the past, Gastino, a member of Bege`s team, reveals the secret weapon that the team plans to use against the Emperor! But Gastino is not who he seems, and the bait in this trap is none other than Luffy himself!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Episode 829
sub.description:
