Conis helps Luffy and his mates launch their rescue mission, but the rubber-man senses something amiss. When he presses her for answers, a vengeful god takes a shot at the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Onward Crow! To the Sacrificial Altar!
sub.description:
Zoro dukes it out with a hungry Skyshark in the shadow of the Sacrificial Alter. On the other side of Upper Yard, Luffy, Sanji, and Usopp try to survive their visit to an island that wants them dead!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: 10% Survival Rate! Satori, the Mantra Master!
sub.description:
Luffy, Sanji, and Usopp tangle with Satori and his exploding, snake-filled Surprise Clouds. The sky priest may look like a dancing dango, but the impact of his mantra leaves the pirates bloodied and boatless.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Ordeal of Spheres! Desperate Struggle in the Lost Forest!
sub.description:
Usopp and Sanji try to regain control of the Crow, and Luffy stirs up a brutal barrage of bursting balls when he attacks Satori. Meanwhile, Chopper whistles for the Sky Knight to avoid becoming a sacrificial reindeer!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Chopper in Danger! Former God vs. Priest Shura!
sub.description:
Chopper fights bravely to stop Shura from incinerating the Going Merry, but the little reindeer is no match for a sky priest. Gan Fall is on his way, but will the dispossessed deity arrive in time?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Profound Mystery! Ordeal of String and Ordeal of Love?!?
sub.description:
When Gan Fall is badly burned during his battle with Shura, Chopper musters the courage for a death-defying leap of faith. Elsewhere, Luffy may have finally discovered a way to defeat Satori!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Light the Fire of Shandora! Wiper the Warrior!
sub.description:
The Shandorians prepare for an all-out attack on their priestly adversaries, Chopper meets the mysterious creatures that saved his life, and Nami makes an astonishing discovery about the origins of Upper Yard.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Jaya, City of Gold in the Sky! Head for God's Shrine!
sub.description:
While the Shandorians continue their battle for control of Upper Yard, the Straw Hats celebrate their happy reunion by swapping stories over a campfire and feasting on barbequed Skyshark!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Festival on the Night Before Gold-Hunting! Feelings for Varse!
sub.description:
Laki`s pursuit of precious Vearth causes one of her Shandorian comrades to be injured during the battle with Ohm. As night falls on Upper Yard, the Straw Hats dream of gold while dancing with wolves!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Enter God Eneru! Farewell to the Survivors!
sub.description:
The electrifying deity of Skypiea, God Eneru, grants his priests unlimited power in their hunt for the Straw Hats. Usopp has a plan to get the mysteriously-repaired Going Merry back in the water, but it involves using Chopper as bait!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Giant Snake Bares Its Fangs! The Survival Game Begins!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats scatter when their search for gold uncovers a giant python, and Gan Fall reveals the tragic story of Jaya`s arrival in the sky. Meanwhile, Wyper readies the Shandorians for a raid on Eneru`s shrine!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Deadly Reject! War Demon Wiper's Resolve!
sub.description:
As the heartless god of Upper Yard eagerly anticipates the dawning of Sky Warefare, the Shandorian forces are savagely snared by the Ordeal of String, and Luffy wanders into the fight of his life!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Fierce Mid-Air Battle! Pirate Zoro vs. Warrior Braham!
sub.description:
Zoro rushes to perfect a deadly technique known as the Flying Blade Attack. The move proves difficult to master, but it could be the key to the swordsman surviving a battle with the Shandorian warrior, Braham.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Roaring Burn Bazooka! Luffy vs. War Demon Wyper!
sub.description:
Sanji and Usopp are driven to their knees by the electrifying presence of god, Luffy is nearly incinerated by Wyper`s Burn Bazooka, and Nami joins Gan Fall in a fight against two killer clones!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Ordeal of the Swamp! Chopper vs. Sky Punk Gedatsu!
sub.description:
Chopper unleashes the fury of his Rumble Ball during a sticky slugfest with a swap cloud spewing priest of Upper Yard. Can the little reindeer discover his opponent`s lone weakness before it`s too late?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Unbeatable Powers! Eneru's True Form is Revealed!
sub.description:
Nami and the Knight of the Sky team up to obliterate two bumbling, balloon-shaped bad guys, and God Eneru relies on his astounding invincibility to torment a noble Shandorian warrior.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Mystical City! The Grand Ruins of Shandora!
sub.description:
Robin`s search for a mystical city of gold is interrupted by Yama, one of Eneru`s faithful servants. When the rampaging warrior destroys some ancient ruins, he provokes the wrath of Robin`s many fists of fury!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: 0% Survival Rate! Chopper vs Ohm, the Sword Wielding Priest!
sub.description:
Priest Ohm silences Chopper with an attack from which few - if any - ever recover. Meanwhile, Luffy begins to notice something strange about his cave-like prison, and four fearsome warriors prepare for battle!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Climb Giant Jack! Deadly Combat in the Upper Ruins!
sub.description:
Zoro, Gan Fall, Wyper, Ohm and a prizefighting pooch gather for a ferocious free-for-all at the site of the Upper Ruins. While the battle rages, Luffy tries to punch his way out of the belly of a poisonous python!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Ordeal of Iron! White Barbed Death Match!
sub.description:
Zoro and Wyper are out to beat down the same bad guys, but will they realize it soon enough to survive a white-barbed death match of doom? Deep in the belly of the python, Nami and Luffy enjoy what could be a short-lived reunion!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Bursting Slash! Zoro vs Ohm!
sub.description:
Eager to end their battle, Zoro aims the awesome destructive power of his 108 Caliber Phoenix at the sinister Priest Ohm! Elsewhere, god demands that Robin help him search for a legendary golden bell.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Collapsing Upper Ruins! The Quintet for the Finale!
sub.description:
God Eneru begins a deadly rampage aimed at exterminating the heavenly beings of Skypiea, and the ruins of Shandora become the scene of bloody contest where survival is the name of the game.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Showdown in the Ancient Ruins! Sky God Enel's Goal!
sub.description:
Gan Fall, Wyper, Zoro, and Robin join forces for an attack on God Eneru. Despite their furious onslaught, the four warriors prove powerless to harm the thunderous deity until Wyper utilizes the power of a mystical stone!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Ambition Towards the Endless Vearth! The Ark Maxim!
sub.description:
God Eneru makes a shocking recovery from wounds that should have ended his reign of terror. Zoro and Wyper muster the strength for one final stand, and Nami must choose between her friends - and survival.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: They Finally Clash! Pirate Luffy vs God Enel!
sub.description:
Luffy emerges from his serpentine tomb with one thing on his mind: revenge! As the rubber-man sets out to settle the score with God Eneru, Conis rushes to warn her people of their impending doom!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Maxim Surfaces! Deathpiea is Activated!
sub.description:
As the citizens of the sky run for their lives, Eneru issues in the dawn of Deathpiea! Luffy is determined to stop the madman, but first he must discover a way to lay hands on the heinous holy man!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy Falls! Eneru's Judgement and Nami's Wish!
sub.description:
A handful of gold sends Luffy hurtling towards his death, Sanji and Usopp mount a midair rescue mission, and Nami prepares for an electrifying showdown with God Eneru!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Two Awaken! On the Front Lines of the Burning Love Rescue!
sub.description:
Usopp arrives just in time to save Nami from a lethal thunderbolt, but even their combined powers are no match for Eneru. While they scramble for an escape route, Sanji stealthily searches for a way to sabotage god`s ark!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Capriccio for Despair! The Impending Doom of Sky Island!
sub.description:
Despite being slowed by an arm encased in gold, Luffy races up a giant beanstalk on a mission to settle the score with Eneru! Elsewhere, the people of Skypiea feel the jolt of god`s wrath!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Lead by a Bell's Sound! Tale of the Great Warrior and the Explorer!
sub.description:
A flashback offers a glimpse at that lives of two legendary figures in Skypiea`s history: Montblanc Noland and the ferocious warrior Kalgara!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Free From the Spell! The Great Warrior Sheds Tears!
sub.description:
The look back at the legend of Montblanc Noland and Kalgara the warrior continues with the story of how these two very different men suddenly found friendship - and then lost it just as quickly!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Eternal Friends! The Vowed Bell Echoes Across the Mighty Seas!
sub.description:
Montblanc Noland and the warrior Kalgara succeed in settling their difference before parting ways, but the laws of nature and man conspire to keep them apart - permanently!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Angel Island, Obliterated! The Horror of The Raigo's Advent!!
sub.description:
Eneru strikes Angel Island with a devastating lightning bolt, and Luffy continues his heroic climb up the giant beanstalk. The rubber-man refuses to stop until he rings the golden bell - no matter what the cost!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Knock Over Giant Jack! Last Hope for Escape!
sub.description:
While Eneru continues his thunderous barrage, Nami hatches a plan to give Luffy one more shot at a grudge match with god. Zoro`s at the center of the scheme, but he might not survive his mission!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Miracle on Skypiea! The Love Song Heard in the Clouds!
sub.description:
Nami`s quick thinking gets Luffy closer to god, and the Straw Hat captain launches himself into the center of a sinister storm! Can he find a way to destroy Eneru`s looming cloud of death?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Battle Ends! Proud Fantasia Echoes Far!
sub.description:
In the aftermath of Luffy`s epic battle with Eneru, sunny skies chase away the storms, and the cloud-dwelling citizens of Angel Island turn their attention to rebuilding their homeland.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: I Made it here! The Yarn the Poneglyphs Spin!
sub.description:
Robin attempts to decipher the riddle of a mysterious poneglyph, Usopp barters with the locals, and Luffy raids the priceless treasures of the legendary city of gold!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Off to the Blue Sea!! A Heartfelt Finale!!
sub.description:
With a little help from their new friends - and a giant octopus - the Straw Hats bid farewell to Skypiea and begin their decent back to the deep blue sea. Where they`ll land is anyone`s guess!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A State of Emergency is Issued! A Notorious Pirate Ship has Infiltrated!
sub.description:
After a frightening fall from the clouds, the Straw Hats find themselves trapped inside an impenetrable Marine stronghold. The crew gets separated, the Going Merry is impounded, and rumors of ghosts run rampant!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Sanji the Cook! Proving His Merit at the Marine Dining Hall!
sub.description:
While Nami searches for the Going Merry, Luffy and Sanji pose as famous chefs, only to end up competing in a cooking contest with a beautiful mistress of the galley!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Captured Zoro! Chopper's Emergency Operations!
sub.description:
Zoro is imprisoned and interrogated, and Chopper`s ill-chosen hiding spot lands him in the operating room along with a doctor who can`t stand the sight of blood!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Marines Dragnet Closes In! The Second Member Captured!
sub.description:
Luffy`s insatiable appetite betrays his true identity, and yet another member of his crew ends up in the brig when two Straw Hats try to fool Commander Jonathan with the same disguise!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy and Sanji's Daring Rescue Mission!
sub.description:
Commander Jonathan sets a Straw Hat trap, but Luffy and Sanji are willing to risk it all to help spring their mates. Will a souvenir from the sky save the day - or will their escape plan be scuttled by foul play?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Enter the Hot-Blooded Special Forces! Battle on the Bridge!
sub.description:
Luffy and his gang make a break for the docks, and Commander Jonathan deploys armed guards in an attempt to slow down the Straw Hats. Only one thing is certain: somebody is going down for the count!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Breaking Through the Siege! The Going Merry is Recovered!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats are surrounded, outnumbered, blasted with tear gas. Taking a pretty, young doctor hostage may be their only hope for surviving long enough for a Merry reunion!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Pirate Ship Disappears! Fortress Battle, Round #2!
sub.description:
Luffy and his crew were almost in the clear when Nami made a horrifying discovery: the Marines stole their gold! Now, the Straw Hats must sail straight into the thick of the fight to reclaim their lost riches!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Gold and Waver Recovery Operations!
sub.description:
Usopp hatches a plan for a moonlit raid on the Marine vault, but Commander Jonathan is has a nasty surprise waiting for the pirates! Meanwhile, Sanji and Nami attempt to recover the waver.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The One Fell Swoop Plan! Jonathan's Surefire Secret Tactic!
sub.description:
The extreme arrogance of a Marine special investigator clears a path for Luffy and company to make their escape! Unfortunately, the Straw Hats still have to find their gold before returning to the high seas!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Farewell, Marine Fortress! The Last Battle for Escape!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats may think they`re in the clear, but Commander Jonathan has one final trap waiting to ground the Going Merry! If Luffy`s crew is to escape, they`ll need a helping hand - or eight!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Great Adventure in Long Ring Long Land!
sub.description:
Luffy and his mates survive and near-death encounter with some mischievous sea monkeys only to land on a mysterious island where everything is much longer than it should be!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Davy Back with the Foxy Pirates!
sub.description:
After a loyal horse and his recently-returned master are assaulted by thugs, Luffy is drawn into a Davy Back Fight with the Foxy Pirates. The Straw Hat captain never backs down from a challenge, but this contest could cost him his crew!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Round 1! One Lap of the Donut Race!
sub.description:
The Davy Back Fight begins with a treacherous Donut Race around Ling Ring Long Land! The Straw Hats square off against the Foxy Pirates in a battle to see who loses a crew member!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Silver Fox Foxy! The Merciless Interference!
sub.description:
Nami uses her considerable skill as a navigator to put the Straw Hats on the verge of victory, but the captain of the Foxy Pirates has more than a few dirty tricks up his sleeve!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Round 2! Shoot It into the Groggy Ring!
sub.description:
Thanks to some foxy sabotage, Chopper has been lost to the enemy. The only hope for getting him back lies with Zoro and Sanji, but can they learn to work together in time to save the little reindeer?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Barrage of Red Cards in Groggy Ring!
sub.description:
Sanji and Zoro take a beating at the hands of the Groggy Monsters, but they won`t give up the fight. With a little luck – and some teamwork - they`ll emerge victorious from round two of the Davy Back Fight!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Round 3! The Round-and-Round Roller Race!
sub.description:
Round three of the Davy Back Fight is a rip roaring roller derby! Chopper`s fate still hangs in the balance, and the Straw Hats have a huge problem: Luffy doesn`t know how to skate!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Seriously Heated Race! Into the Final Round!
sub.description:
As the Davy Back Fight sprints toward a sensational finish, the Straw Hats find themselves on the brink of defeat! Luffy`s finally managed to stay on his skates, but the Foxy Pirates are notorious cheaters!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Screaming-Hot Bombardment! Pirate Dodgeball!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats somehow manage to defeat the Foxy Pirates and win back Chopper, but Luffy eagerly accepts the challenge of a rematch! What is the captain thinking? And will his crew mutiny?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Showdown on the Cliff! Red Light, Green Light!
sub.description:
A devious game of dodge ball costs the Straw Hats their archaeologist. Now, they`ll have to win an unusual uphill race to reclaim Robin and avoid losing another crew member!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Captains Square Off! The Final Combat Round!
sub.description:
Robin and Chopper have both been lost to the Foxy Pirates, and there`s only one match remaining in the Davy Back Fight! Luffy`s got a plan to get his mates back, but failure would mean the end of the Straw Hats forever!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Full-Blast Slow-Slow Onslaught Vs. Invulnerable Luffy!
sub.description:
Luffy and Captain Foxy go toe-to-toe in a brutal battle waged aboard a booby trapped boat. Luffy is fighting for his crew, but Captain Foxy`s dirty tricks have him on the ropes!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Epic, Heated Combat! The Fateful Final Conclusion!
sub.description:
Luffy`s epic battle with Captain Foxy reaches its riveting end, and a very old man with a very tall horse reunites with a face from very long ago.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Was It Lost? Stolen? Who Are You?
sub.description:
When Luffy and his mates lose their memory, Robin is the only Straw Hat who can remember their adventures together. Can she can she recover their recollections before the crew splits up?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Mysterious Boy With a Horn and Robin's Deduction!
sub.description:
Robin tries to hold the crew together while unraveling the mystery of the missing memories. Meanwhile, Nami and Zoro flashback to painful moments from their pasts.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Now, Let's Get Back Our Memories! The Pirate Crew Lands On the Island!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats finally discover the culprit behind their memory loss, but they`ve got bigger problems. The mysterious thief is determined to pit Zoro and Luffy against each other!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Zoro Bares His Fangs! A Savage Animal Stands in the Way!
sub.description:
Zoro and Luffy fight to the death, Nami attempts to orchestrate an uprising, and Sanji discovers he`s willing to kick a kid in order to get his memories back!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Last Counterattack by the Memory Thief Who Reveals His True Colors!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats finally regain their memories, but a much larger challenge looms on the horizon. The mysterious thief is about to transform into something even more powerful!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Proud Man! Silver Fox Foxy!
sub.description:
A terrible storm leads to another run in with the devious Captain Foxy! When Luffy makes the dangerous decision to help his old foe, it could spell disaster for the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Guy Who's the Closest to Invincible? And the Most Dangerous Man!
sub.description:
Luffy and his mates must survive another outrageous battle aboard the Captain Foxy`s booby-trapped boat, and even if they survive, something far worse is awaits them!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Navy Headquarters Admiral Aokiji! The Ferocity of an Ultimate Powerhouse!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats take time out to help a group of hungry castaways, but trouble looms on the horizon. An icy marine adversary is out to track down Robin!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Duel Between Rubber and Ice! Luffy vs. Aokiji!
sub.description:
Chopper and Usopp work feverishly to save Robin from her icy tomb, and Luffy looks to settle the score with Admiral Aokiji in a man-to-man fight to the finish!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Dashing Sea Train and the City of Water: Water Seven!
sub.description:
An encounter with a giant swimming frog leads to a close call with a seafaring train! Next up for the Straw Hats: drop anchor at a town full of water and seek out a shipwright!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Adventure in the City on the Water! Head to the Mammoth Shipbuilding Plant!
sub.description:
Luffy, Usopp, and Nami take a wild ride through Water Seven in search of a shipwright. Meanwhile, Chopper and Robin get separate during their quest to find a bookstore!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Franky Family and Iceburg!
sub.description:
Zoro is attacked by thugs who want to cash in on his bounty, Sanji gets lost on a grocery shopping expedition, and three suitcases full of cash mysteriously go missing!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Galley-La Company! A Grand Sight: Dock #1!
sub.description:
A carpenter and his talking pigeon help recover the Straw Hats` missing money, but the Franky Family won`t give up so easily. Luffy and Nami receive very bad news about their beloved boat!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Pirate Abduction Incident! A Pirate Ship That Can Only Await Her End!
sub.description:
Luffy and Nami refuse to believe that the Going Merry`s seaworthy days are finished, but for now, bigger problems loom on the horizon! Their money is missing again, along with Usopp!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Rescuing Our Friend! Raid On the Franky House!
sub.description:
Usopp bravely tries to recover the stolen money, but the Franky Family has him badly outnumbered. Zoro, Sanji, and Chopper set out on a rescue mission, but they`ll need Luffy to even the odds!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Big Fight Under the Moon! The Pirate Flag Flutters With Sorrow!
sub.description:
Usopp regains consciousness after his vicious beating, but he`s not at all happy to hear Luffy`s plans for the Going Merry. Temper flares and challenges are issued as the Straw Hats face their most uncertain hour.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy vs. Usopp! Collision of Two Men's Pride!
sub.description:
Luffy and Usopp battle to a brutal standstill in a heartbreaking duel between men who once called each other family. Can the Straw Hats find the strength to carry on without their sniper?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Severe Shock Hits the City of Water! Iceberg Targeted!
sub.description:
The Straw Hat split is overshadowed by an assassination attempt on the mayor of Water Seven! Luffy is eager to investigate, but the leader of the Franky Family is about to reappear!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Gum-Gum Human vs. Fire-Breathing Cyborg!
sub.description:
Luffy`s grudge match with Franky gets serious when his opponent turns out to be a cyborg! Iceberg awakes from his slumber only to hurl heinous accusations at the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Straw Hat Pirates Are the Culprits? The Protectors of the City of Water!
sub.description:
Luffy is branded an assassin and attacked by Iceberg`s strongest men! Meanwhile, Sanji and Chopper attempt to warn Usopp about an impending natural disaster!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Eternal Farewell? Nico Robin: The Woman Who Draws Darkness!
sub.description:
The citizens of Water Seven search for the Straw Hats, and a devastating storm threatens to sink the city. Chopper and Sanji pick up Robin`s trail, but they aren`t prepared for what they`ll find.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Capture Robin! The Determination of the Straw Hats!
sub.description:
Usopp prepares to ride out the storm aboard the Going Merry, Franky hatches a plan to force Luffy into a rematch, and the Straw Hats set out to uncover Robin`s dark secret.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Cannon Fire Is the Signal! CP9 Goes Into Action!
sub.description:
Robin and her CP9 brethren seek to settle unfinished business with Iceberg. The Straw Hats have a plan to clear their names, but the assassins are one step ahead of them.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: CP9 Takes Off Their Masks! Their Shocking True Faces!
sub.description:
Luffy makes his long awaited entrance, Iceberg has a shocking surprise in store for Robin, and the true identities of the masked assassins of CP9 are finally revealed!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Secret Bond! Iceberg and Franky!
sub.description:
CP9 listens to Iceberg`s blood to learn to the location of the blueprints, Usopp has another run in with Franky, and the remaining Straw Hats – plus a new friend – race to the rescue!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Come Back, Robin! Showdown With CP9!
sub.description:
Luffy and the gang come face to face with Robin and her CP9 comrades. The rubberman is prepared to fight for his friend, but he`s never faced foes like this!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Straw Hat Pirates Annihilated? The Menace of the Leopard Model!
sub.description:
Luffy, Zoro, and Nami are sent hurtling toward their deaths by the villains of CP9! Meanwhile, Usopp forges an unlikely friendship with Franky while waiting out a storm.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Man Who Is Loved Even by His Ship! Usopp's Tears!
sub.description:
Franky tries to convince Usopp that there`s no hope for the Going Merry, but the sniper - inspired by a mysterious moment from the past - remains loyal to his beloved boat
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Franky's Past! The Day the Sea Train First Ran!
sub.description:
A look back at Franky`s past reveals the amazing origins of the sea train – and paints a vivid picture of his younger days, spent alongside Iceberg and the legendary shipwright Tom!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Spandam's Scheme! The Day the Sea Train Shook!
sub.description:
Franky`s backstory continues! The sea train is a success, and it looks like Tom`s life is spared! Unfortunately, a government spy is searching for a reason to investigate Tom, and Franky provides the ammunition!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The End of the Legendary Man! The Day the Sea Train Cried!
sub.description:
Tom does the unthinkable in an attempt to protect his apprentices, but young Franky is unable to control his rage, leading to a showdown with a spy - and a train!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Truth Behind Her Betrayal! Robin's Sorrowful Decision!
sub.description:
Chopper`s heroism may mean the difference between life and death for Iceberg and Paulie, Nami learns the agonizing truth about Robin, and Sanji prepares to make his move!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Steam Whistle Forces Friends Apart! The Sea Train Starts to Run!
sub.description:
Nami makes a frantic dash for the Sea Train station, Chopper searches desperately for Zoro and Luffy, and Sanji plays it cool while waiting for the right time to spring into action.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Sanji Barges In! Sea Train Battle in the Storm!
sub.description:
Nami arrives at the train station a minute too late, Sanji makes his presence aboard the sea train known, and the search for Luffy and Zoro continues!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Nami's Soul Cries Out! Straw Hat Luffy Makes a Comeback!
sub.description:
Chopper and Nami risk their own lives in a desperate attempt to save Luffy and Zoro from a monstrous wall of water! Meanwhile, Sanji moves ever closer to a reunion with Robin.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Another Sea Train? Rocketman Charges Forth!
sub.description:
Luffy and Nami ask to borrow a ship so they can chase down the sea train, but the weather is too severe to set sail. Lucky for them, Iceberg and his friends are full of surprises!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Rescue Our Friends! A Bond Among Foes Sworn with Fists!
sub.description:
Luffy, Zoro, Chopper, and Nami rocket toward a rendezvous with the assassins of CP 9, but they`ll need to forge an alliance with some new friends to have any chance at survival!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Smash the Wave! Luffy and Zoro Use the Strongest Combo!
sub.description:
Zoro and Luffy go head-to-head with Mother Nature, and Sanji`s rescue mission is bolstered by Franky`s allegiance – and the arrival of the mysterious Sniper King!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Mysterious Man Appears?! His Name Is Sniperking!
sub.description:
Sniper King, a mysterious warrior from the island of snipers, lends a hand as Franky and Sanji try to fight their way to Robin.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Showdown Between Cooks! Sanji vs. Ramen Kenpo
sub.description:
Sanji mixes it up with a deranged cook, Franky dukes it out with the newest member of CP9, and the Sniper King gets creative in his attempt to reach Robin!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Rooftop Duel! Franky vs. Nero
sub.description:
Franky and Sanji continue to battle the thugs of CP9. Meanwhile, Luffy and the rest of the gang find themselves headed for a collision that could spell doom for everyone!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Clash! Demon-Slasher Zoro vs. Ship-Slasher T-Bone!
sub.description:
Zoro faces a fellow master of the blade, Sanji looks to end his fight with against a rampaging ramen master, and Franky finally lands a big blow against his CP9 foe!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Scramble over Robin! A Cunning Plan by Sniperking!!
sub.description:
The Sniper King hatches a daring escape plan, but the assassins of CP9 are more powerful than our heroes ever imagined. Meanwhile, Luffy and the gang run into a very familiar frog!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Judicial Island! Full View of Enies Lobby!
sub.description:
As their train approaches Enies Lobby, Franky`s kind words cut through Robin`s cold exterior. Luffy`s train is thrown off course, but the group gains a powerful new ally!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Landing Operations Start! Charge in, Straw Hats!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats hatch a plan to rescue Robin, but as usual, Luffy can`t wait to find a fight. Will his impulsive attack derail their mission?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy Cuts Through! Big Showdown on the Judicial Island!
sub.description:
Luffy manages to reach the main island, but the Franky Family`s assault is stopped short by a couple of angry giants!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Battle Against Giants! Open the Second Gate!
sub.description:
Luffy makes short work of a few hundred marines, the Franky Family takes down a giant, and the assassins of CP9 report back to Spandam!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Find a Way Out! Rocketman Takes Flight!
sub.description:
Zoro`s quick thinking - and a little help from a giant frog - sends the sea train soaring into the sky on a collision course with armed guards and their canine companions!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Catch Up with Luffy! The Straw Hats' All-Out Battle
sub.description:
Nami electrocutes the enemy with a Clima Tact attack, but the bad guys have the Straw Hats surrounded until the Franky Family shows up with a couple of sea monsters!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Robin Betrayed! The Motive of the World Government!
sub.description:
Zoro, Sanji, Nami, and Chopper try to catch up with their captain, Soge King is nowhere to be found, and Luffy runs head first into a battle with Blueno!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Give Robin Back! Luffy vs. Blueno!
sub.description:
Luffy shows off his new strength in a brawl with Blueno, Soge King befriends a giant, and a hulking sea beast makes the ultimate sacrifice.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Don't Stop! Hoist the Counterattack Signal!
sub.description:
While Luffy continues his battle with Blueno, Soge King`s giant companions make their presence felt, and the assassins of CP9 experiment with Devil Fruits!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Almost to Luffy! Gather at the Courthouse Plaza!
sub.description:
A blind Kingbull fights with his last breath to get the Straw Hats one step closer to their captain. Luffy kick his body into second gear to protect his friends from dangerous foes!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Everything is to Protect My Friends! Second Gear Activated!
sub.description:
Luffy batters a baffled Blueno with his powerful new fighting style, and the cowardly Spandam begins to panic at the sound of the Straw Hats approaching!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Give us your answer, Robin! The Straw Hats' Outcry!
sub.description:
Luffy and his crew are finally reunited and ready to rescue Robin, but the raven-haired beauty remains reluctant to rejoin her former mates despite Franky`s urging.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Robin's Past! The Girl was called a Devil!
sub.description:
Flash back to Robin`s days as a young girl, her dangerous pursuit of forbidden knowledge, and her encounter with a friendly giant.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Fated Mother and Daughter! The Mother's Name is Olvia!
sub.description:
Robin`s flashback continues with the heartbreaking arrival of her mother - and the government`s cruel and brutal invasion of a peaceful island!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Tragedy of Ohara! The Terror of the Buster Call!
sub.description:
Professor Clover reveals a startling and sinister theory about the World Government, Robin reunites with her mother, and a giant joins the fight!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Say You Want to Live! We Are Your Friends!!
sub.description:
The painful story of Ohara - and Robin`s younger years - draws to a tragic close. Luffy declares war on the World Government, and Robin finally changes her tune!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Jump Towards the Falls! Luffy's Feelings!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats are ready to begin the fight for Robin, but first, Luffy flashes back to memories of his childhood - and the man who made him want to become a pirate!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Ways of Men! Zoro's Techniques, Usopp's Dream!
sub.description:
Zoro remembers the first time he met Luffy, and Usopp recalls the events that led him to join the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Bond of Friendship Woven by Tears! Nami's World Map!
sub.description:
Nami`s heartbreaking past - and Luffy`s epic battle with Arlong - are recalled in this flashback to the early days of the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Parting Builds a Man's Character! Sanji and Chopper!
sub.description:
A flashback sheds light on how Sanji came to join the crew, and Chopper`s backstory is revealed through memories of a visit to a snow-covered island!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Everything is for Her Friends! Robin in the Darkness!
sub.description:
A flashback reveals Robin`s motives for cooperating with CP9, Nami`s shocking discovery about the archaeologist`s past, and Luffy`s determination to save his friend!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: I'm Not Gonna Hand Over the Blueprints! Franky's Decision!
sub.description:
Franky stands up to Spandam by destroying what the madman desires most, and the sound of the sea train spurs the Straw Hats to make a daring leap of faith!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Obtain the 5 Keys! The Straw Hat Pirates vs. CP9!
sub.description:
Luffy races to rescue Robin while the rest of the Straw Hats set off in search of the five keys needed to unlock the archaeologist!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Devil Fruit Powers! Kaku and Jabra Transform!
sub.description:
While Usopp and Zoro go head-to-head with a couple of animal assassins, Sanji teaches the most beautiful member of CP9 the secrets of making good tea!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: I Won't Kick Even If It Costs Me My Life! Sanji's Chivalry!
sub.description:
Luffy runs into trouble trying to sail his way to Robin, Usopp and Zoro end up handcuffed together, and Sanji`s inability to kick a women may lead to serious injury!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Fukurou's Miscalculation! My Cola is the Water of Life!
sub.description:
Chimney and Gombe show Luffy the secret passage that leads to Robin, and Franky puts on a display of raw punching power thanks to a few bottles of cola!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Uncontrollable! Chopper's Forbidden Rumble!
sub.description:
Determined not to be defeated by the heinous hair of a devious lion, Chopper risks life and limb by summoning the power of his Rumble Ball for a third time!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Boss Luffy Returns! Is It a Dream or Reality? Lottery Ruckus!
sub.description:
Travel back to ancient Japan for a madcap adventure starring the Straw Hats, some old friends and enemies, and a camel that eats lottery tickets!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Big Rice Cake Tossing Race at the Castle! Red Nose's Plot!
sub.description:
The madcap throwback continues as Luffy and the gang - along with a crowd of characters from the Alabasta arc - competes for a priceless treasure hidden inside a tasty snack!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Bubble Master Kalifa! The Soap Trap Closes in on Nami!
sub.description:
Nami battles a bathing beauty and her lethal bubbles, Chopper unleashes his inner beast, and Luffy inches ever closer to catching up with Robin!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Resounding Bad News! The Buster Call Invoked!
sub.description:
Franky has a painful encounter with monster Chopper, and Nami gets scrubbed too clean to fight! Meanwhile, Spandam accidentally invokes the deadly Buster Call!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Five Namis? Nami Strikes Back With Mirages!
sub.description:
Zoro uses Usopp as a decoy in his battle with the beasts, and Nami discovers the secret that could be the key to survival in her brawl with the bathing beauty!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Nami's Decision! Fire at the Out-Of-Control Chopper!
sub.description:
Franky and Nami come up with a plan to stop Chopper`s rampage, but it could prove deadly to the not-so-little reindeer. Usopp and Zoro are thrilled to finally be free of each other!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Hunter Sanji Makes An Entrance? Elegy for a Lying Wolf!
sub.description:
Usopp`s ill-advised attempt at bravery threatens to get him killed, but a familiar foot spares the sniper`s life. Luffy struggles to even strike a formidable foe, and Franky races to deliver some very important keys!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Fiery Kicks! Sanji's Full Course of Foot Techniques!
sub.description:
Sanji evens the playing field in his CP9 slugfest by introducing his wolfish opponent to the burning power of the devil`s leg!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Fierce Sword Attacks! Zoro vs. Kaku, Powerful Sword Fighting Showdown!
sub.description:
Zoro finally lands a blow against the killer giraffe, but Luffy still can`t find a way to break through against Lucci! Can Frank reach Robin before it`s too late!?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Demon God Zoro! An Incarnation Of Asura Born From Fighting Spirit!
sub.description:
Zoro unleashes a demonic nine sword fighting style on his giraffe opponent, Luffy buys time for Franky by ascending to second gear, and Robin refuses to give up hope of being rescued!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Spandam Frightened! The Hero on the Tower of Law!
sub.description:
Spandam cruely drags Robin ever closer to the gates of justice, but the battle takes a turn for the better when the Sniper King makes a surprise appearance!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Robin Freed! Luffy vs. Lucci, Showdown Between Leaders!
sub.description:
Luffy`s battle with Lucci reveals the powerful secrets of the rubber man`s second gear, and the Spandam`s thoughtless Buster Call begins with a brutal barrage of cannon balls.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Boss Luffy is the Culprit? Track Down the Missing Great Cherry Tree!
sub.description:
When an ancient tree is stolen by a madman with the power to freeze time, Luffy, Usopp, and Sanji track down the culprit in an attempt to save a village`s annual festival!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: I Can't Protect Anyone Unless I Win! Third Gear Activated!
sub.description:
Nami, Sanji, Usopp, Zoro, and company find themselves trapped in to tunnel filled with rapidly rising water. Meanwhile, Luffy musters the strength for one last stand in his battle with Lucci.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Shivering Past! Dark Justice and Rob Lucci!
sub.description:
Flashback to the dark past of Rob Lucci as the young boy learns to dispense a cold, cruel, and brutal brand of justice. Back in real time, Luffy`s battle with Lucci threatens to destroy the navy fleet.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Mysterious Mermaid Appears? As Consciousness Fades Away...
sub.description:
Luffy`s gigantic attack on Lucci takes a devastating toll on his body, Robin rejoins the fight, and the rest of the Straw Hats struggle to survive underwater!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Cannon Fire Sinks the Island! Franky's Lamentation!
sub.description:
Thanks to a little help from what appears to be a mermaid, the Straw Hats find themselves reunited aboard an escape vessel, but the fate of Luffy and the Franky Family is yet to be determined!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Wait for Luffy! Mortal Combat on the Bridge of Hesitation!
sub.description:
Luffy pushes his body to the breaking point in his battle with Lucci, and the rest of the Straw Hats try to fight off a fleet of Marines until their captain returns - if he ever does.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Fists Full of Emotion! Luffy Unleashes Gatling with All His Might!
sub.description:
Luffy lies battered and badly beaten, but Usopp`s desperate pleas inspire the rubber-man to mount one final, furious attack on Rob Lucci!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: From the Sea, a Friend Arrives! The Straw Hats Share the Strongest Bond!
sub.description:
With their leader crippled by exhaustion and their escape ship destroyed, the Straw Hats find themselves with only one treacherous option: throwing themselves into the sea!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Everyone Makes a Great Escape! The Road to Victory is for the Pirates!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats are rescued by the unexpected arrival of a dear old friend, but they`ll have to avoid a barrage of deadly cannonballs in order to survive!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Thank You, Merry! Snow Falls over the Parting Sea!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats bid a tearful farewell to the brave little ship that was their home for so very many adventures. Rest in peace, Merry!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Peace Interrupted! A Navy Vice Admiral with a Fist of Love!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats get some much needed rest and relaxation, Franky makes a big announcement, and Vice Admiral Garp tracks down his grandson!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Strongest Family? Luffy's Father Revealed!
sub.description:
Luffy`s friends are shocked to learn that his grandpa is a marine hero, but that`s nothing compared to how surprised they`ll be by his father`s true identity!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Its Name Is The New World! The Fate of the Grand Line!
sub.description:
Luffy gets the chance to catch up with his old friend Coby, Nami does some serious snooping, and Robin is paid a chilling visit from a terrifying face from her past.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Shanks Makes a Move! The Linchpin to the Reckless Era!
sub.description:
Shanks visits Whitebeard with a serious request, Franky and Iceberg begin construction on a ship for the Straw Hats, and news spreads of the events at Enies Lobby.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Girl in Search of Her Yagara! Great Search in the City of Water!
sub.description:
Luffy and Chopper risk their lives to help a heartbroken young girl track down her long lost pet!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Mothers are Strong! Zoro's Hectic Household Chores!
sub.description:
Zoro`s day takes a turn for the crazy when his search for a new sword is derailed by a couple of meddling orphans!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Sanji's Shock! Mysterious Old Man and His Super Yummy Cooking!
sub.description:
Sanji spends the day with a very old chef who teaches him the secret of packing amazing flavor into each and every dish!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Everyone Finally Has A Bounty! A Pirate Group Worth Over Six Hundred Million!
sub.description:
Franky and Iceberg stay up all night on a mission to finish a new ship for the Straw Hats, but the first light of day brings troubling news!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The King of Animals that Overlooks the Sea! The Dream Ship Magnificently Completed!
sub.description:
With their new ship completed, Luffy and the gang get ready to set sail, but first they`ll have to steal some underpants in order to secure the services of a shipwright!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Goodbye My Dear Underlings! Franky Departs!
sub.description:
A series of flashbacks to his younger days - and some painful persuasion by Robin - help Franky make the difficult decision to leave his friends and go to sea with the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Departing the City of Water! Usopp Mans Up and Brings Closure to the Duel!
sub.description:
Luffy and the Straw Hats are ready for their next adventure, but before they can move on they must await the return of Usopp - and avoid a barrage of cannon balls courtesy of Garp!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Wanted Posters Make It Around the World! Celebrations in Their Hometowns as the Ship Moves Forward!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats` new ship gets a name, and Franky shows off some of its special features as the gang goes sky high to avoid being sunk by the marines!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Most Heinous Power! Blackbeard's Darkness Attacks Ace!
sub.description:
Ace and Blackbeard go toe-to-toe in an epic clash of Devil Fruit powers that pits fire against darkness - and threatens to destroy an entire island!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Mysterious Band of Pirates! Sunny and the Dangerous Trap!
sub.description:
Luffy and his mates cross paths with a ragged gang of sailors. The Straw Hats are quick to offer assistance, but their new friends may be up to no good!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Sunny in a Pinch! Roar, Secret Superspeed Mecha!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats discover that their fishermen friends are actually pirates, but Chopper refuses to abandon a very sick patient.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Dream Sinking in the New World! The Disillusioned Pirate, Puzzle!
sub.description:
The captain of the Phoenix Pirates loses his will to fight, and the Straw Hats get trapped in a field of icebergs by some figure skating bounty hunters!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Assassins Attack! The Great Battle on Ice Begins!
sub.description:
Nami and Franky take a spin in the shark sub, Usopp and Sanji have a run in with a flock of deadly penguins, and Puzzle can no longer hide the fact that he`s alive!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Staw Hat's Hard Battles! A Pirate Soul Risking It All for the Flag!
sub.description:
Robin is shocked by her encounter with an adorable bounty hunter, Franky and Nami get trapped in a frozen shark, and Luffy`s quest to recapture his flag sends him sinking toward the bottom of the sea!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Hot Full Throttle! The Twin's Magnetic Power Drawing Near!
sub.description:
Luffy battles a set of magnetic twins, Sanji and Usopp fall victim to a pair of figure skating lovebirds, and Zoro has a drink with the man who stole the Straw Hat flag!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Mansion of Great Chaos! The Enraged Don and the Captured Crew!
sub.description:
Robin`s cola care package helps spring her friends from an icy prison, and Luffy`s bold words inspire a battered and beaten pirate to keep fighting!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Return of the Phoenix! The Dream of the Pirate Flag Sworn to a Friend!
sub.description:
While Luffy continues his battle with the magnetic twins, Chopper uses a rumble ball in his battle with a hockey player - and Robin tries to recover the Straw Hat flag!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Red Hot Decisive Battle! Luffy vs. The Scorching Don!
sub.description:
Luffy battles an opponent who`s too hot to handle, Robin gets attacked by a jungle, and Chopper makes a heroic dash for the Straw Hat flag!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Waiting in the New World! Farewell to the Brave Pirates!
sub.description:
Luffy`s red-hot battle with Papa threatens to destroy the entire icy island, and the rest of the Straw Hats need a little help from a former enemy to recover their flag!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Chopperman to the Rescue! Protect the TV Station by the Shore!
sub.description:
The most adorable hero the world has ever known - Chopperman - must battle a hideously evil villain to regain control of his favorite television station!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Plunging into the Devil's Sea! The Mysterious Skeleton Floating in the Fog!
sub.description:
While sailing through haunted waters, the Straw Hats encounter a ghost ship that`s home to a walking, talking skeleton!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Joy of Seeing People! The Gentleman Skeleton's True Identity!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats attempt to unravel the mystery of their new comrade, but the skeleton`s sad story is interrupted by a ghastly landing at the haunted island of Thriller Bark!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: One Unnatural Phenomenon After the Next! Disembarking on Thriller Bark!
sub.description:
After getting stranded at Thriller Bark, Chopper, Nami, and Usopp are chased by a three headed beast. Back on the boat, Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hats are terrorized by an unseen enemy!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Man Called a Genius! Hogback Makes His Appearance!
sub.description:
Chopper, Nami, and Usopp get scared out of their minds when they encounter a graveyard full of zombies! Meanwhile, the rest of the crew gets trapped in super creepy sea web!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Nami's in a Major Pinch! The Zombie Mansion and the Invisible Man!
sub.description:
An invisible man turns Nami`s bath time into a harrowing experience, and Usopp battles a hall full of haunted paintings with a handful of burning candles!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Zombie's Secret! Hogback's Nightmarish Laboratory!
sub.description:
While Usopp, Nami, and Chopper seek to unravel the secrets of the haunted mansion, Luffy and the gang do battle with an army of the undead!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: His Name is Moria! The Great Shadow-Seizing Pirate's Trap!
sub.description:
Luffy sets his sights on the shadowing-stealing monster known as Gecko Moria, and the zombie army prepares for a night attack led by their perverted, invisible leader!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Feast of the Zombie Song! The Night Raid's Bell is the Sound of Darkness!
sub.description:
Usopp, Chopper, and Nami get trapped in a coffin after being slashed by a zombie samurai. Meanwhile, Luffy and the rest of the Straw Hats make short work of some haunted paintings!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Bunch of Animals? Perona's Wonder Garden!
sub.description:
After escaping from their coffin prison, Usopp, Chopper, and Nami do battle with a garden full of adorably dead zombie animals!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Vanishing Straw Hat Crew! A Mysterious Swordsman Appears!
sub.description:
An undead warthog sets her sights on Nami, Zorro and Sanji vanish without a trace, Franky and Robin battle an unbeatable army, and Luffy gets captured!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Chivalry Remains! The Traitorous Zombie Protects Nami!
sub.description:
A penguin zombie starts acting an awful lot like Sanji, Nami continues running for her life, and Robin and Franky buy some time by blowing up a bridge!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Appearing from the Sky! That Man Is the Humming Swordsman!
sub.description:
Nami gives love advice to a zombie, Luffy finds himself face-to-face with Gecko Moria, and Robin gets caught in spooky spider web. Things look bleak for the Straw Hats until their skeleton friend lends a hand!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy's Emergency Situation! The Ultimate Shadow's Destination!
sub.description:
Brook strikes the final blow in his battle with the spider monkey, Gecko Moria`s devious plan is revealed, and Luffy`s escape attempt leads to the loss of something he can`t live without!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Warrior Known As the Devil!! The Moment of Oars' Revival
sub.description:
Brook tells Franky and Robin the secret to slaying zombies, and Gecko Moria reveals the terrifying monster that will be the recipient of Luffy`s shadow!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Awakening After 500 Years!! Oars Opens His Eyes!!
sub.description:
Luffy`s shadow is forced into the body of a monster, Usopp and Chopper get incinerated, and Nami is kidnapped by a zombie who wants to make her his wife!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Belief Worth Begging to Live for!! Brook Defends His Afro
sub.description:
Gecko Moria`s minions struggle with the burden of feeding a giant zombie brought to life by Luffy`s shadow. Meanwhile, Brook flashes back to a battle that almost cost him his beloved afro!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Man's Promise Never Dies!! To the Friend Waiting Under the Distant Sky
sub.description:
The freshly-revived trio of Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji discover that their shadows are missing, and Franky relates Brook`s story about a promise he made to a very special whale!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: I Swear to Go See Him! Brook and the Cape of Promise
sub.description:
Luffy and the Straw Hats flash back to the heartbreaking story of Laboon the abandoned whale, and Brook`s battle with the zombie samurai reveals the reason behind his intense afro love!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Food, Nami and Shadows!! Luffy's Enraged Counterattack
sub.description:
Luffy sets out to regain his shadow and convince Brook to join the crew. Meanwhile, Sanji races to stop Nami`s zombie wedding before it`s too late!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Usopp's the Strongest? Leave Anything Negative to Him
sub.description:
Usopp`s naturally negative personality makes him the only Straw Hat who stands a chance against Perona`s depressing army of ghosts, and Chopper prepares to do battle against his hero, Dr. Hogback!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The General Zombies Are Down in a Flash!! Oars Feels Like an Adventure!!
sub.description:
When Brook is overmatched by the zombie samurai, Zoro steps in to help the skeleton get his shadow back. Meanwhile, Luffy prepares for a battle with Gecko Moria, and Sanji interrupts an undead wedding!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Blazing Knight Sanji!! Kick Down the Fake Wedding
sub.description:
Despite his furious attempts, Luffy struggles to land a blow against Gecko Moria, but Sanji fares much better in his passionate attempt to defeat Nami`s beastly abductor!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Clear-Clear History? Sanji's Stolen Dream
sub.description:
Sanji takes a beating when his opponent suddenly turns invisible, Luffy finally manages to land a blow in his battle with Gecko Moria, and Usopp uses fire to ward off a zombie bear!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Save Me, Hero!! My Enemy Is the Immortal Princess
sub.description:
After getting the stuffing beat out of him by a zombie teddy bear, Usopp summons his sharp-shooting alter ego to help him discover the secret to defeating Perona!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Perona Is Terrified!! Usopp and Untruthful Share the Same U
sub.description:
Usopp reaches deep into his devious bag of tricks to even the odds in his battle with Perona. Meanwhile, Luffy can`t lay a finger on Gecko Moria, and a zombie is less than gentlemanly in his battle with Robin!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Slashes Dancing On the Rooftop!! Zoro vs. Ryuma's Showdown
sub.description:
While Franky and Brook watch in awe, Zorro and the zombie samurai wage a sword-slinging battle the likes of which the world has never seen before!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Chopper Is Furious!! Hogback's Evil Medical Practices
sub.description:
Chopper can no longer contain his fury over Dr. Hogback`s evil treatment of his zombie slaves. Meanwhile, Luffy prepares to face the zombie who`s wearing his shadow!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Oars Roars! Come Out, Straw Hat Crew
sub.description:
Moria`s mansion is reduced to ruins as the zombie with Luffy`s shadow stalks the Straw Hats! As the walls come tumbling down, Chopper puts the hurt on Hogback, and Nami vanishes right before Sanji`s eyes!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy Is the Enemy! The Ultimate Zombie vs. The Straw Hat Crew
sub.description:
One by one, the Straw Hats attack Oars, but the monstrous zombie appears too powerful to be defeated. Luffy`s got his sights set on Moria, but he`d better hurry if he wants to save his crew!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: You're Going Down, Absalom!! Nami's Lightning Attack of Friendship!!
sub.description:
Nami wakes up just in time to find out she’s about to marry a zombie, but the special occasion is interrupted by a very jealous warthog!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Knock Him Down!! Special Attack: Straw Hat Docking?
sub.description:
Nami attempts to track down some missing treasure, Brook searches the kitchen for a mystery ingredient, and a heroic team effort topples Oars!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Silent Assault!! The Mysterious Visitor, Tyrant Kuma
sub.description:
Nami has a horrifying run in with Bartholomew Kuma, Perona becomes the latest lady to vanish, and Chopper, Franky, and Usopp team up to strike a blow against Oars!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Oars + Moria! The Most Heinous Combination of Brains and Brawn
sub.description:
Kuma has an upsetting message for Moria, Luffy loses track of his intended target, and Zoro attempts to harness the power of a new sword during his battle with Oars!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Secret Plan to Turn the Tables! Nightmare Luffy Makes His Appearance
sub.description:
Brook arrives with the salt needed to stop Oars, but the monster shows off some special new abilities. Deep in the forest, Luffy makes some new friends who help him power up!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Straw Hat Crew Gets Wiped Out! The Shadow-Shadow's Powers in Full Swing
sub.description:
Brook joins the fight as the Straw Hats valiantly try to hold off Oars and Moria until Luffy returns. Unfortunately, even their combined powers are no match for these evil enemies!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Incredible Battle Starts! Luffy vs Luffy
sub.description:
Oars and Moria ruthlessly pummel the badly beaten Straw Hats. The situation looks bleak until the shocking arrival of Nightmare Luffy!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The End of the Battle Is Nigh! Pound in the Finishing Move
sub.description:
After Luffy’s shadow power disappears, he’ll need help from rest of the Straw Hats to land a devastating finishing blow in his battle against Oars.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Our Bodies Vanish! The Morning Sun Shines On the Nightmarish Island!
sub.description:
Moria gobbles up every shadow in sight to power up for a final showdown with Luffy. Can the Straw Hats save the day before the dawn reduces them all to ashes!?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Not Out of Danger Yet! Orders to Annihilate the Straw Hat Crew
sub.description:
The battle between Luffy and Moria reaches its epic end, and the gargantuan shadow of the towering brute known as Kuma causes a panic on the island!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: It Repels Everything! Kuma's Paw-Paw Power!
sub.description:
Kuma is ordered by the World Government to obliterate every living being on the island, but the Straw Hats – battered as they may be – refuse to go down without a fight!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Pain of My Crewmates Is My Pain! Zoro's Desperate Fight!
sub.description:
Zoro slashes against the Pacifista Kuma is meet with resistance harder than steel.  Unable to win with his swords he bets everything on a trade.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Promise from a Distant Day! The Pirates' Song and a Small Whale!
sub.description:
As the story of Kuma and Zoro is discussed, Brooks remembers back to when he was alive.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Brook's Past! A Sad Farewell with His Cheerful Comrade!
sub.description:
The continued story of Brooks the pirate and his friend Laboon.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Bink's Booze! The Song that Connects the Past with the Present!
sub.description:
Brooks shares the story of the final days of the Rumbar pirates and their final song.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A New Crewmate! The Musician, Humming Brook!
sub.description:
With a new official crewmate, the Straw Hat Pirates are ready to set sail.  Lola shares with Nami a unique item only available in the New World!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Slow-Slow Menace! 'Silver Fox' Foxy Returns!
sub.description:
While resting at a floating resort, Spa Island. The Straw Hat crew runs into a familiar old face and big trouble.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Great Scramble for Treasure! Collapse! Spa Island!
sub.description:
After Sayo is kidnapped, Luffy agrees to help Rina get her back.  His foolproof idea sends shockwaves through Spa Island.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Brook's Great Struggle! Is the Path to Becoming a True Comrade Rigorous?
sub.description:
Brook’s eagerness to become a trust comrade is backfiring immensely. What is causing his new anxiety and the crew survive much longer?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Arriving at Halfway Through the Grand Line! The Red Line
sub.description:
The Straw Hats have finally reached the red line with each member thinking back on the adventure.  Straws are picked to decided who will take the submarine to investigate the way to Fish-man Isle.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Hatred of the Straw Hat Crew: Enter Iron Mask Duval
sub.description:
After indirectly rescuing a unique pair, they beg the straw heats to help rescue a friend that has been kidnapped by Iron Mask Duval.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Fated Reunion! Save the Imprisoned Fish-man
sub.description:
Arriving at Duval’s base, it is obvious a trap, but when Camie’s friend is recognized as Hatchan, a former Arlong Pirate.  Luffy refuses to help so Camie and Pappgu attempt the rescue by themselves.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Tragedy! The Truth of the Unmasked Duval
sub.description:
The flying fish riders attack on the Straw Hats take place in the air and sea. Luffy is memorized by the flying fish as Zoro attempts to free Hatchan.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Explosion! The Sunny's Super Secret Weapon: Gaon Cannon
sub.description:
The secret of Duval is revealed!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Landing to Get to Fish-man Island: The Sabaody Archipelago
sub.description:
Enjoying takoyaki from a grateful Hatchan, he explains to the crew how to get to Fish-man Island.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Tyranny! The Rulers of Sabaody, the Celestial Dragons
sub.description:
Luffy and his crew stop at an island overflowing with bubbles to get their ship modified for underwater travel. But it`s not long before they stumble upon an outrageous explosion and attract unwanted attention.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: New Rivals Gather! The 11 Supernovas
sub.description:
Shakky explains why Sabaody Archipelago seems to be crawling with bounty hunters – eleven of the Grand Line`s most wanted pirates are currently ashore and two of them are in Luffy`s crew!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Target is Camie! The Looming Clutches of a Professional Kidnapper
sub.description:
A mysterious stranger keeps Zoro from tangling with a powerful Celestial Dragon, and Chopper goes bonkers when Camie disappears from the amusement park.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Rescue Camie! The Archipelago's Lingering Dark History
sub.description:
Camie was abducted by a dastardly gang of kidnappers, and her next stop is the auction house unless the Straw Hats can rescue her. To make it in time, they’ll have to hitch a ride on some flying fish!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Time Limit: The Human Auction Begins
sub.description:
With a little help from their fishy mates, the Straw Hats make it to the auction house in time to save Camie, but explosive elements prevent them from taking her back by force. Luckily, Nami’s concocted a very generous plan!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Fist Explodes! Destroy the Auction
sub.description:
Nami’s plan to save Camie goes belly up when a snot-nosed celestial dragon outbids the Straw Hats. Luffy and Zoro make an explosive arrival at the auction house and promptly open up a deadly can of worms.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Major Panic! Desperate Struggle at the Auction House
sub.description:
Luffy turns a mermaid auction into a pirate-style brawl when he knocks the snot out of a celestial dragon. With a fleet of marines out to get them, the Straw Hats will have to fight their way off the island!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Admiral Kizaru Takes Action! Sabaody Archipelago Thrown into Chaos
sub.description:
They saved Cami from the auction block, but now the Straw Hats are surrounded by a fleet of marines. Lucky for Luffy, Eustass Captain Kid and Trafalgar Law are ready to join the fight!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Break Through the Siege! The Navy vs. the Three Captains
sub.description:
The Straw Hats join forces with Kid’s crew and Trafalgar’s mates to make short work of the marines, but they’re in for a surprise when they encounter a Warlord of the Sea!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Roger and Rayleigh: The King of the Pirates and His Right Hand Man
sub.description:
Luffy and his crew duck the marines by hiding out at Rayleigh’s house. While Chopper tends to Hachi, Rayleigh entertains the Straw Hats with tales of his days as first mate on Gold Roger’s ship.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: No Escape!? Admiral Kizaru's Light Speed Kick!!
sub.description:
Admiral Kizaru has arrived to lead the marines on a mission to wipe out all pirates. Meanwhile, Luffy and his crew prepare for a deadly battle with one of the Warlords of the Sea!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Overwhelming! The Navy's Fighting Weapons, the Pacifistas
sub.description:
A groovy pirate belts out a tune that leaves Kizaru in pieces, but the admiral pulls himself together in time for a crushing Light Speed Kick. Luffy and Sanji try to protect the injured Zoro from a warlord lookalike.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: An Even Stronger Enemy Appears! The Battle Axe-Carrying Sentomaru
sub.description:
Luffy and the Straw Hats narrowly defeat a robot that resembles one of the Seven Warlords of the Sea. But before the dust settles on the field of battle, a far more deadly foe comes looking for a fight.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Admiral Kizaru's Fierce Assault! The Straw Hats Face Certain Death!
sub.description:
Zoro’s barely breathing, and Admiral Kizaru is ready to stomp him into oblivion. The battered and beaten Straw Hats could certainly use a powerful friend right about now.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Eliminated Friends: The Final Day of the Straw Hat Crew
sub.description:
One by one, the mighty paw-print of Bartholomew Kuma makes the Straw Hats disappear until only Luffy remains. To where did his mates vanish? And will he ever see them again?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Feudal Era Side Story: Boss Luffy Appears Again
sub.description:
Yesterday, the Straw Hats valiantly battled a warlord of the sea. Today, Boss Luffy and his friends at the Pinwheel Diner prepare to compete in the Great Portable Shrine Race!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Feudal Era Side Story: Defeat Thriller Company's Trap
sub.description:
Thriller Company sabotages the race for a sacred treasure, and the displaced Straw Hats must pull an all-nighter to rebuild their shrine and score some ancient gold!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Landing! The All-Female Island, Amazon Lily
sub.description:
Luffy finds himself stranded and starving on a strange island. The rubber-man’s amazing appetite puts his manhood in danger when he devours an array of exotic mushrooms!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Hurry Back to Your Friends! The Maiden Island Adventure
sub.description:
An army of scantily-clad Amazonian warriors want to investigate Luffy’s family jewels, but the captain of the Straw Hats is more interested in reuniting with his lost mates.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Everyone Falls in Love! Pirate Empress Hancock
sub.description:
The Amazonians chasing Luffy are loyal subjects of Boa Hancock, the curvaceous Warlord of the Sea. This stone-cold beauty is deadly, and she’s about to pick a fight with an entire fleet of marines!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Secret Hidden on the Backs – Luffy and the Snake Princess Meet
sub.description:
Luffy’s search for a seaworthy vessel leads to a “drop-in” on the Snake Princess during the royal bathing hour. The view is world-class, but it might turn the rubber-man to stone!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Heartless Judgment! Margaret is Turned to Stone!!
sub.description:
Boa Hancock makes Luffy fighting mad when she turns Margaret into a statue. The Snake Princess may have bitten off more than she can chew by challenging captain Straw Hat!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Difficult Fight for Luffy! The Snake Sisters' Haki Power!!
sub.description:
The Snake Princess pits Luffy’s Gum Gum abilities against the incredible Haki Power of her serpentine sisters in a fight to the death. Will Luffy survive long enough to save his statuesque friends?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: All-Out Special Power Battle!! Gum-Gum vs. Snake-Snake
sub.description:
Luffy kicks his attack mode into second gear to save a precious statue, and the snake sisters start to feel the Straw Hat heat. At the battle’s climax, Luffy makes an impression on his opponents.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Hancock's Confession – The Sisters' Abhorrent Past
sub.description:
News of Luffy’s run-in with the Celestial Dragons impresses the Snake Princess, so she tells him the story of her tortured past. Will his honorable nature speed Luffy toward a reunion with his crew?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Saving Ace! The Next Stop: the Great Prison!
sub.description:
Luffy is mobbed by a hoard of pretty amazons eager to touch a real live man. Granny Nyon offers him safe haven, but what she has to say might sink his plans for a Straw Hat reunion.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Love is a Hurricane! Hancock Madly in Love!
sub.description:
Boa Hancock`s illness threatens to sabotage Luffy`s rescue mission; however, the Snake Princess just can`t say "no" to the rubberman, so a plan to save Ace is quickly hatched.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Friends' Whereabouts – The Science of Weather and the Mechanical Island
sub.description:
While Luffy races to save Ace, Nami tries to survive life on Sky Island, and Franky dances up a snowstorm before making the switch from cola to tea!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! An Island of Giant Birds and a Pink Paradise!
sub.description:
Chopper narrowly avoids being served for dinner in a land inhabited by giant birds, and Sanji`s refined tastes land him a role as a leading lady on the island of "girlish hearts".
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Friends' Whereabouts – Bridging the Islands and Vicious Vegetations!
sub.description:
Nico Robin finds herself trapped on the island of Tequila Wolf: a miserable land where children are forced to work as slaves. Elsewhere, Usopp tries to survive a run-in with a man-eating plant!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! A Princess Negativity and the King of Demons!
sub.description:
Zoro is held against his will by the pink-haired princess of bad vibes, Brook gets mistaken for the king of darkness, and Luffy continues to eat his way toward a reunion with Fire-Fist Ace!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Deadly Infiltration! The Underwater Prison Impel Down!
sub.description:
Luffy and Boa arrive at Impel Down, but only thirty-three hours remain until Ace`s execution. To save him, the Snake Princess must find a way to hide Luffy during her full-body search!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Reunion in Hell?! The Man Who Ate the Chop-Chop Fruit!
sub.description:
Time is running out on Ace, so Luffy teams up with a scoundrel who`s going to pieces trying to escape Impel Down. There`s no love lost between Buggy the Clown and the Straw Hat captain, but they`d better work together if they want to survive.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Break Through the Crimson Hell! Buggy's Chaos-Inducing Plan!
sub.description:
Luffy must part ways with a priceless treasure map before Buggy the Clown agrees to lead him through the bloody tangle of Blade Trees and Spike Needle Grass that make up Impel Down`s Crimson Hell!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Strongest Man in the Prison! Poison Man Magellan Appears!
sub.description:
Luffy and Buggy the Clown could end up as hippo food if they aren`t careful in Impel Down`s Wild Beast Hell. Of course, the rubberman might find that a better fate than dealing with the prison`s putrid warden!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie! A Gold Lion's Ambition on the Move!
sub.description:
Luffy and his crew stumble upon a most peculiar village when they hitch a ride on a fire-breathing beetle. The natives are petrified of pirates, but they welcome the Straw Hats with open arms!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie! Little East Blue in Danger!
sub.description:
The citizens of Little East Blue throw a feast in honor of the Straw Hats, but when the Amigo Pirates try to capture Boss the beetle, Luffy and his crew will have to defend their new friends.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie! The Fierce Onslaught of the Amigo Pirates!
sub.description:
Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji prepare to do battle on behalf of Boss the beetle, but Captain Largo of the Amigo Pirates counters with a deadly arsenal of nets to put the Straw Hat brawlers on lock down!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Special Presentation Related to the Movie! Decisive battle! Luffy vs. Largo
sub.description:
Luffy kicks into second gear for his rematch with Largo, and Nami leads the islanders as they lay waste to the Amigo Pirates. Boss the Beetle may be safe for now, but someone sinister lurks behind the scenes.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Imprisoned Warlord! Jinbei, Knight of the Sea!
sub.description:
Luffy struggles to stay a step ahead of a prison patrol made up of hungry lions and poisonous scorpions! Meanwhile, Ace spends what could be his final hours swapping stories with a pirate who hates pirates.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Chief Jailer Saldeath's Trap! Level 3 - Starvation Hell!
sub.description:
While the guards struggle to squelch a violent prison uprising, Luffy and his fellow fugitives try to keep their cool in a level of Impel Down known as Starvation Hell!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Unleashed Swan! A Reunion with Bon Clay!
sub.description:
Boa Hancock uses her ample assets to buy some private time for a clandestine chat with Ace. Meanwhile, Luffy needs help from a graceful friend to escape the jaws of a hungry Sphinx!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Warden Magellan's Strategy! Straw Hat Entrapment Completed!
sub.description:
Luffy and Bon are on the verge of reaching Level 4, but they didn`t count on fighting a demonic, lightning-fast, devastatingly powerful Minotaur! To defeat this beast, they`ll need help from a human candle and a deranged clown!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: All Forces Have Gathered! The Battle on Level 4 - The Burning Heat Hell!
sub.description:
Luffy narrowly avoids a deadly dip in a boiling pool of blood, only to find himself face to face with Warden Magellan. Meanwhile, outside the prison walls, the marine fleet prepares for Whitebeard`s onslaught!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Mighty Magellan! Bon Clay Bugs Out!
sub.description:
Warden Magellan is a monster of a man with a penchant for poisoning prisoners. To rescue Ace, Luffy must go toe to toe with this toxic terror, but how do you defeat a foe who`s deadly to the touch?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Showdown Has Come! Luffy's Desperate Last Attack!
sub.description:
Luffy`s daring assault on the venomous warden of Impel Down leaves him struggling to stand up, but despite the lethal poison breaking down his body, the rubber-man kicks his rescue mission into second gear!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: For His Friend! Bon Clay Goes to the Deadly Rescue!
sub.description:
Luffy is at the end of the line - the only thing that can save him now is true friendship. But in a place like Impel Down can true friendship be found?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Paradise in Hell! Impel Down - Level 5.5!
sub.description:
No existing antidote can save Luffy from the poison coursing through his veins, yet Bon Clay refuses to give up. His final, fleeting hope is a mysterious miracle-worker rumored to have vanished into the Gates of Hell!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy's Treatment Begins! Ivan-san's Miraculous Power!
sub.description:
Bon is overjoyed to hear that Luffy is still alive, but his happiness quickly turns to shock when he learns that Ivan`s agonizingly painful "Healing Hormones" will cost the rubber-man ten years of his life!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Believe in Miracles! Bon Clay's Cries From the Heart!
sub.description:
Ace is scheduled to be executed in a matter of hours, and Luffy`s still hovering on the verge of death. It will take a miracle to save them both, but Bon would rather die than give up on his friend!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy's Back! Ivan-san Begins the Breakout Plan!
sub.description:
Luffy miraculously survived his brush with death, but he`s far too weak to finish rescuing Ace. Ivan is reluctant to lend a hormonal hand to the doomed rescue mission - until he learns of Luffy`s lineage!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Ace's Convoy Begins! Battle on the Lowest Floor - Level 6!
sub.description:
The quest to rescue Ace tuckers out thanks to a blast of sleeping gas! Ivan`s scissor-handed sidekick puts an end to nap time, but Luffy will have to join forces with a scar-faced foe from the past if he wants to complete his mission!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Ultimate Team Has Formed! Shaking Impel Down!
sub.description:
Luffy`s desperate attempt to rescue Ace is bolstered by two powerful new allies: the murderous Crocodile and the honorable fishman Jinbei. Meanwhile, Ivan sparks a prison riot to create a diversion for the rubber-man.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Even More Chaos! Here Comes Blackbeard Teach!
sub.description:
Luffy and his gang of outlaws cause a commotion on Level Four, Blackbeard`s arrival leads to the release of the prison`s most feared inmate, and Ace gazes upon the great blue sky for what could be the very last time!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Dangerous Encounter! Blackbeard and Shiryu of the Rain!
sub.description:
Ivan undergoes a curvaceous transformation to better battle sadistic Sadie, the commander of the Demon Guards. Meanwhile, Blackbeard and Shiryu head for a showdown on Level 1!
Source: crunchyroll
