sub.title: Stardust of Death! Diamante's Storm of Vicious Attacks!
sub.description:
Franky and Señor Pink end their harrowing duel in a manly way - but victory knocks the wind out of even the winner`s sails! Meanwhile, Diamante and Kyros struggle desperately on the Sunflower Field, each demonstrating their extreme prowess even in near defeat!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Trueno Bastardo! Kyros' Furious Strike!
sub.description:
Kyros, unbowed by Diamante`s vicious attacks, fights back with the anger and retribution of all of Dressrosa in order to fulfill his promise to protect Rebecca. If he is successful, only a few executives will remain, setting the stage for the Straw Hats` victory.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Moving Across the Ground! The Giant Statue Pica's Surprise Maneuver!
sub.description:
Pica loses his temper and turns his full wrath against King Riku, whom he hopes to destroy, ending the revolution against Doflamingo. Meanwhile, Zoro, who has been distracted by Pica and drawn far from the battle, has to hatch a plan to save the king!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Decisive Battle in Midair! Zoro's New Special Secret Technique Blasts!
sub.description:
With the lives of King Riku, Usopp, and the others on the old King`s Plateau in the balance, Zoro must dig deep and discover a powerful technique to counter Pica`s near-unstoppable onslaught. Meanwhile, King Riku ponders what it means to be a good king.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: So Long! Bellamy's Farewell Blow!
sub.description:
Zoro finishes off Pica, and those below his crumbling body rush to find shelter. Meanwhile, the Tontattas finish up demolishing the SMILE Factory, and Luffy`s hand is forced in his duel with Bellamy!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Law Dies - Luffy's Raging Onslaught!
sub.description:
Taking down Bellamy only enrages Luffy in his fight against Doflamingo, his anger multiplying when he finds Law`s lifeless body! Meanwhile, Doflamingo takes the next step to end the game he started, which will endanger everybody in Dressrosa!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Blade of Tenacity! The Gamma Knife Counterattack!
sub.description:
The Birdcage draws tighter and tighter around Dressrosa, threatening to destroy all life on the island kingdom! Meanwhile, Doflamingo stands down Luffy for a final confrontation, but a surprising twist shocks everyone on the top of the Royal Palace!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Collision of Haki! Luffy vs. Doflamingo!
sub.description:
Law`s attack proves powerful - but Doflamingo`s power has depths which he and Luffy haven`t bargained for. When Doflamingo makes his counterattack, Luffy stares him down with an amazing power.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Unassailable! The Stunning Secret of Trébol!
sub.description:
Trebol`s wrath is fully inflamed as Law summons enough energy to speak, denouncing the Doflamingo Family executives as pawns in Doflamingo`s game. But Law gathers enough energy to do more than just speak out.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Anger Erupts! I Will Take Everything upon Myself!
sub.description:
Cavendish has to make a difficult decision when the severely wounded Law begs him to be left behind. Meanwhile, seeing even his Second Gear or Third Gear attacks aren`t working against Doflamingo, Luffy decides to use his ultimate technique!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Fourth Gear! The Phenomenal Bounce-Man!
sub.description:
Luffy and Doflamingo duke it out while the Birdcage tightens its grip on Dressrosa! Zoro sets off with a plan to stop it from slicing apart the country, while Luffy`s Fourth Gear proves quite potent against Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Massive Counterattack! Doflamingo's Awakening!
sub.description:
The Birdcage continues its merciless constriction, sending the residents of Dressrosa fleeing towards the center of the island, while King Riku calls out to his people; survive long enough for Luffy to vanquish the last of the royal family - Doflamingo himself!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy! An All-Out Leo Bazooka!
sub.description:
Fourth Gear gives Luffy the power he needs to head off Doflamingo at every strike! But the energy required to keep Fourth Gear going starts to take a toll on Luffy. Will he have enough left to finish the job?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Flame Dragon King! Protect Luffy's Life!
sub.description:
Bounce-man`s power has drained Luffy, leaving him in need of a rest before he can reuse his Haki, but luckily the gladiators from the Colosseum have come around and are focusing on taking down Doflamingo! Sabo steps in at a crucial moment to defend his brother, Luffy!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Tears of Miracles! Mansherry's Fight!
sub.description:
With Luffy and so many of the Straw Hats` allies incapacitated, victory seems inevitable for Doflamingo - but the compassion of Mansherry may be enough to turn the tide and renew their hope - to stop the Birdcage!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: As Long as We Breathe! Stop the Deadly Birdcage!
sub.description:
With just over a minute to spare, everyone in Dressrosa turns their efforts towards slowing down the Birdcage as it squeezes the life out of the country! Meanwhile, Viola seeks Doflamingo out herself, for a shocking confrontation!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Dead or Alive! A Fateful Countdown!
sub.description:
Only a bit more time remains before Luffy returns to the scene! But as time slips by, those who had been roused by Princess Mansherry`s powers begin to falter! Meanwhile, Rebecca, under the control of Doflamingo, is about to attack Viola!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Attack on a Celestial! Luffy's King Kong Gun of Anger!
sub.description:
Luffy regains enough Haki to face off against Doflamingo, but his health is still poor. With the Birdcage closing in, is there a technique left in his repertoire that is strong enough to take down Doflamingo?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: To Be Free! Dressrosa's Delight!
sub.description:
With Doflamingo thoroughly quashed and the Birdcage collapsing, the people of Dressrosa shed tears of joy remembering the hardships they`ve endured, and the actions taken by Luffy and the others to free them.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Unheard-of! Admiral Fujitora's Surprising Decision!
sub.description:
Jesus Burgess of the Blackbeard Pirates tries to agitate Sabo, mocking Ace`s final words in order to unsettle him enough that he can try to steal the Flare-Flare Fruit! Meanwhile, people of Dressrosa beg King Riku to resume the crown when Navy Admiral Fujitora steps in and takes a stunning action!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Sending a Shock Wave! The Worst Generation Goes Into Action!
sub.description:
Repercussions of Doflamingo`s defeat reverberate around the world! Fujitora`s actions put the Navy in a tight spot, and the "Worst Generation" beings to stir into action!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Birth of the Legend! The Adventures of the Revolutionary Warrior Sabo!
sub.description:
The combatants in the battle for Dressrosa can finally begin to recoup, but those who stay awake are treated to the story of how Sabo joined the Revolutionary Army!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Brothers' Bond! The Untold Story Behind Luffy and Sabo's Reunion!
sub.description:
Sabo recounts his surprising reunion with Luffy at the Colosseum as the Straw Hats and the others continue to recoup. Meanwhile, Fujitora gambles on how to make his next move - and the odds are in Luffy`s favor!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Strongest Creature! One of the Four Emperors - Kaido, King of the Beasts!
sub.description:
As Sabo departs, our attention shifts to the other Straw Hats waging a fierce battle on a mysterious island. And a new drama is set into motion as ill portents fall from the sky!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Fujitora Takes Action! The Complete Siege of the Straw Hats!
sub.description:
As Luffy and the others begin to come to their senses, major players in the Navy arrive to search Dressrosa for the Straw Hats! Also, Rebecca`s history is whitewashed with a fake cover story - but why?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A State of Emergency! Rebecca Is Kidnapped!
sub.description:
Fujitora`s flirting with chance has turned out poorly for the Straw Hats as the full Navy force bears down on Dressrosa searching for the pirates! Luffy and the others make a mad dash for the east port to get off the island, but not without finishing up a piece of business...
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Bond Between Father and Daughter! Kyros and Rebecca!
sub.description:
Rebecca has precious little time to follow Luffy`s lead and make it to Kyros. Can she make it in time? Meanwhile, Fujitora is closing in on Bartolomeo and the other Colosseum warriors while Trafalgar Law faces the shadows of his past!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Men's Pride! Luffy vs. Fujitora, Head-to-Head!
sub.description:
Law and Sengoku share memories of Corazon, and the secret of Trafalgar Law`s name. Meanwhile, Fujitora uses the destruction caused by the battle in Dressrosa as a weapon, and squares off one-on-one with Luffy!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: No Way Out! Admiral Fujitora's Ruthless Pursuit!
sub.description:
The people of Dressrosa show their appreciation to the Straw Hats one last time by foiling Fujitora`s strategy. As Luffy and the others are able to finally make their break from the island, however, an unbelievable new chapter opens in the story of the Straw Hat Pirates!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Sons' Cups! The Straw Hat Fleet is Formed!
sub.description:
With newfound allies won in the battle at Dressrosa, and as the Navy watches, Luffy and the Straw Hats depart Dressrosa for open water. But will Luffy accept the oath of allegiance given by his new fleet?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Numerous Rivals Struggle Amongst Themselves! The Raging Monsters of the New World
sub.description:
While the Straw Hats are underway, Doflamingo has serious predictions for the upset of the world order! Meanwhile, the recent actions in Dressrosa have led to surprising results!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Silver Fortress! Luffy and Barto's Great Adventure!
sub.description:
While heading to the next island, Zou, Luffy’s appetite causes them trouble and he and Bartolomeo find themselves entangled in the scheme of a pirate lord who can manipulate silver.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: An Underground Maze! Luffy vs. the Tram Human!
sub.description:
The Tram-Man arrives! And has Luffy, Bartolomeo and Desire on the run! The deeper the three fall into the pit, however, the more clear it becomes that Bill`s group hides a terrible secret!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Sword Technique Heats Up! Law and Zoro Finally Appear!
sub.description:
Luffy, Bartolomeo, and Desire make their way up the mineshaft, but Bill`s assassin, Peseta, has other plans! Just when the going gets tough, help arrives, and Zoro battles the assassin head on!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Desperate Situation! Luffy Fights a Battle in Extreme Heat!
sub.description:
Luffy, Desire, and Bartolomeo go up against Bill! But the mad, Smelt-Smelt man becomes deranged and lets his true power unfurl! Do Luffy and the others have any hope of exposing Bill`s self-serving aims and turning his gang against him?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Curtain-up on a New Adventure! Arriving at the Phantom Island, Zou!
sub.description:
Bartolomeo recounts the formation of the Straw Hats, sharing their moving story with the rest of his crew! Meanwhile, the mysterious island of Zou approaches in the distance, obscured by fog. But when the haze clears, no one is expecting what they see!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The New Warlord! The Legendary Whitebeard's Son Appears!
sub.description:
Luffy and the others arrive at the mysterious land of Zou, and find the Sunny. But when they board, they find the other Straw Hats have already disembarked. Thus, Luffy, Zoro, Robin and the others take on the challenge of climbing the monstrous elephant!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Deadly Elephant Climb! A Great Adventure on the Back of the Giant Elephant!
sub.description:
Finally scaling the elephant`s back, the Straw Hats continue their search for the other half of their crew! But the mysterious "island" on the back of the elephant may hold more danger than they bargained for, as they learn they are not alone!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Battle Begins! Luffy vs. the Mink Tribe!
sub.description:
Luffy pushes deeper into the mysterious forest on the elephant’s back, but he`s treading in territory where is not welcome! Meanwhile, Usopp and the others make a startling discovery in a ruined city!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Garchu! The Straw Hats Reunite!
sub.description:
Luffy and the others survive the Rain-Ruption and learn of its vital role in maintaining life on Zou. They continue on towards the fortress learning more about the mysterious Mink Tribe, and are finally reunited with the others - but is that the whole story?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Start to Counterattack! Great Moves by the Twirly Hat Crew!
sub.description:
Luffy and the others are unexpectedly welcomed at the fortress and treated well by the Minks, although they have to navigate some cultural differences… And Nami starts sharing what happened to them after they left Dressrosa.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Threat Descends! The Beast Pirates, Jack!
sub.description:
Luffy and the others learn about the dangerous intruders who have come to Zou, and why the island is wrecked! Afterwards, Luffy`s loose lips get them into trouble!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The King of the Day! Duke Dogstorm Appears!
sub.description:
Duke Dogstorm - the Straw Hats finally meet the ruler of this strange land, and learn more about the battle that took place here; and the mysterious system by which the island is ruled!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The King of the Night! Master Cat Viper Emerges!
sub.description:
Day turns to night as the Minks keep up their onslaught against the invading Beast Pirates! But Jack`s amazing Devil Fruit power may end the elephant island once and for all!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Exterminated Capital! The Twirly Hat Crew Arrive!
sub.description:
Night and day, Jack faces the fury of the two sworn defenders of Zou, but while they put up a good fight, the Minks aren`t able to subdue Jack, especially after he brings out his secret weapon...
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Time Limit Closes in! The Bond Between the Mink Tribe and the Crew!
sub.description:
In the aftermath of Jack`s deadly attack on the island of Zou, Chopper and Sanji rush in to save the fallen Mink Tribe - but they will need the help of Caesar to overcome the poisonous effects of the gas!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Delinquent Comes Home! Emperor Big Mom's Assassins!
sub.description:
More of the dramatic happenings on Zou are revealed as we learn that Jack`s pirate band were not the only visitors to the elephant island! And what about the mysterious fate of Sanji?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Truth Behind the Disappearance! Sanji Gets a Startling Invitation!
sub.description:
The mystery of Sanji`s disappearance deepens as Luffy learns that Big Mom`s lackeys have caught up with him and the rest - and carry with them an invitation from Big Mom that simply can`t be refused!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: To My Buds! Sanji's Farewell Note!
sub.description:
Sanji`s dire situation has become clear, but instead of rallying against Big Mom`s crew, he submits to go along with them to bring an end to this situation. But being separated from one of his crew is more than Luffy is willing to tolerate!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Let's Go and Meet Master Cat Viper!
sub.description:
There`s only one key to finding out what happened to Sanji - and Luffy and the others make their way towards finding out more about their friend`s disappearance, but on their way the indigenous fauna give them trouble!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy's Decision! Sanji on the Brink of Quitting!
sub.description:
Luffy hatches a plan to help Sanji, but he`ll have to go alone to avoid an all-out war with Big Mom. Meanwhile, Kin`emon and Kanjuro finally arrive at Zou, unwittingly setting the stage for the Minks` thirst for revenge!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Volatile Situation! The Dog and the Cat and the Samurai!
sub.description:
The samurai have landed! And they make their way into the country of Zou unaware of the welcome they will receive by the Minks! The Straw Hats try their best to stop the fight - but as day meets night and Cat Viper and Dogstorm face each other, tensions run high in the elephant country!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Third One! Raizo of the Mist, the Ninja, Appears!
sub.description:
Revelations abound as the true nature of the Wano clan and their relationship with the Minks is revealed! Momonosuke`s role is greater than any had imagined! But even more shocking - the visage of Raizo the Ninja!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Red Stone! A Guide to the One Piece!
sub.description:
The mysteries of ninjutsu enthrall the Straw Hats as Raizo, the implausible ninja, makes his true powers known! Meanwhile, a mysterious artifact points the way towards the end of the Grand Line!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Secret of the Land of Wano! The Kozuki Family and the Ponegliffs!
sub.description:
The mystery of the Ponegliffs is revealed - their true significance, and the story of their creation, leads closer to the Straw Hats than they might have imagined!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Vow Between Two Men! Luffy and Kozuki Momonosuke!
sub.description:
More mysteries of the Kozuki Clan are revealed - and the samurai propose an alliance to help topple Kaido! But Luffy`s response will shock the crew... and force the young daimyo to take responsibility!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Legendary Journey! The Dog and the Cat and the Pirate King!
sub.description:
Dogstorm and Cat Viper share their story of being on the journey with Oden and Roger but are interrupted by Nami who is concerned about the sea route. Meanwhile, Jack is plotting to bring down the Mokomo Dukedom again!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Nightmare Returns! The Invincible Jack's Fierce Attack!
sub.description:
The plans are set! The Straw Hats divide and conquer, one group heading to save Sanji, the others to the Land of Wano! But in the final moments before their departure, the tremendous elephant island begins to quake!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Battle to Defend Zou! Luffy and Zunesha!
sub.description:
After being aggressively attacked by Jack`s fleet, the monstrous Zunesha comes to life and beckons to those on its back! But can the Straw Hats understand its cry? And realize in time what the elephant island needs from them?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Save Zunesha! The Straw Hat's Rescue Operation!
sub.description:
With the skirmish with Jack now over, the Straw Hats move on to trying to bandage the great elephant`s wounds! But just as the whole island puts the plan into action, unseen danger lurks on horizon!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Saying Goodbye and Descending from the Elephant! Setting Out to Take Back Sanji!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats and the others split up into four teams, each on different missions! Some from the Mink Tribe insist on leaving with Luffy’s team! Meanwhile, Usopp makes a weapon for Nami that seems to work like magic!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: To the Reverie! Princess Vivi and Princess Shirahoshi!
sub.description:
Luffy`s team sets out from Zou on their way to win back Sanji! But they didn`t realize there is one more crewmember than they have bargained for! Meanwhile, the leading families and leaders of the world make their way to Mariejois for the pivotal world meeting!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: To the Reverie! Rebecca and the Sakura Kingdom!
sub.description:
Carrot stows away! And settles in with the Straw Hats as they make their way to rescue Sanji! Meanwhile, in the Sakura Kingdom - formerly the Drum Kingdom, Dalton and Kureha are getting ready for the Reverie so as their former enemy in his newly-built kingdom…
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Kaido Returns! An Imminent Threat to the Worst Generation!
sub.description:
News of the raid on the Revolutionary Army reaches Luffy! But that`s the least of their worries as they face a storm and a sudden lack of provisions! Meanwhile, Emperor Kaido, furious at the loss of Joker, fumes with anger at the reckless generation of upstarts!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Hungry Front! Luffy and the Navy Rookies!
sub.description:
Sneaking in to the Navy island facility to replenish their food supply, Luffy and the others risk being caught out in the open! Will their infamy make them easy to spot by the hotheaded Navy recruits around them?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Implacable Three! A Big Chase After the Straw Hats!
sub.description:
The jig is up as Luffy and the others make a daring dash to avoid the furious Navy! Can they escape without having to turn to fight - and after they`ve had a chance to raid the cabinets for food?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Devil's Fist! A Show Down! Luffy vs. Grount!
sub.description:
Making a mad dash for the Submerge with the food they stole, Luffy and the others have to get through some of the Navy`s upstart soldiers! Grount, whose arm holds incredible power, summons his training to challenge Luffy!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Sanji's Homecoming! Into Big Mom's Territory!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats continue to suffer from blazing heat and a perilous food crisis! As the seas finally calm, fishing is their only hope! Meanwhile, Sanji arrives in Big Mom`s territory and keeps his cool - until he sees his bride-to-be!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Zero and Four! Encountering Germa 66!
sub.description:
Luffy is in danger as the venomous fish poison courses through his body! With no antidotes on board, the Straw Hats must rely on a mysterious ship for help - a ship that bears a truly surprising crew!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Deadly Poison Crisis! Luffy and Reiju!
sub.description:
On the edge of life and death, Luffy`s only hope rests with Sanji`s siblings! But even though they refuse to share an antidote, they may be able to save Luffy`s life yet, giving him enough energy to plunge right back into trouble...
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Totto Land! Emperor Big Mom Appears!
sub.description:
Arriving on Cacao Island, Luffy and Chopper are in heaven as everything before their eyes is edible! But in this most heavenly of places, there are rules to be obeyed - and consequences for breaking them! Luckily someone is on the lookout for the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Emperor's Daughter! Sanji's Fiancée – Pudding!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats confront Pudding - the fiancée of Sanji! But when they challenge her for Sanji`s heart, her answer shocks them! Meanwhile an ominous and mysterious message may spell doom for the Straw Hats...
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Massive Attack! Mom's Hunger Pangs!
sub.description:
The dangerous waters around the Whole Cake Island harbor terrifying creatures that pose a challenge for the Straw Hats! Meanwhile, Mama slips into a bout of her sickness and ravages her own land in search a specific pastry!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Capital City Falls?! Big Mom and Jimbei!
sub.description:
Big Mom rampages through the Whole Cake Island in search for sweets - but when the kitchen can`t prepare them fast enough her own son steps in to curb the carnage, with deadly results. Only an old face coming across the waters brings Mom what she needs, even though he also brings ill tidings.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Emperor's Castle! Arriving at the Whole Cake Island!
sub.description:
As the Straw Hats draw closer to the Whole Cake Island, Pedro shares his sordid past in Big Mom’s territory - and hatches a plan to win back Sanji and take an item of great worth from the Emperor!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Mysterious Forest Full of Candies! Luffy vs. Luffy?!
sub.description:
Brook and Pedro head out in a submersible to infiltrate Big Mom`s stronghold! Meanwhile Luffy, Nami, Chopper and Carrot head into the island chasing the image of Sanji, only to be distracted by the endless supply of sweets and a second Luffy!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Mom's Assassin! Luffy and the Seducing Woods!
sub.description:
Lost in the bewildering woods and chasing after Sanji, Nami and the others find there`s more than meets the eye in this upside down part of the Whole Cake Island! Meanwhile, Sanji confronts his brother!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Seafaring Kingdom! Germa's King Judge!
sub.description:
Luffy continues to move through the mysterious and dangerous woods, unaware of the danger that lurks in the trees! Meanwhile, Sanji confronts his father as the wounds of his childhood are laid bare!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Battle Between Father and Son! Judge vs. Sanji!
sub.description:
Sanji faces off against his father in a duel! His powerful kicks aim at protecting his hands, but the Germa Family has more in store for him yet! Meanwhile Luffy goes deeper into the Seducing Woods and falls for their powerful illusions!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Giant Ambition! Big Mom and Caesar!
sub.description:
Big Mom has Caesar Clown at her whims - and despite his bilking her out of countless amounts of money - she is ready to continue her pursuit of maniacal world control! Meanwhile, Big Mom`s forces are on to the Straw Hats, and Pekoms faces a dire situation!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Land of Souls! Mom's Fatal Ability!
sub.description:
Finally Nami finds Luffy and recounts her harrowing tale of battling Brulee! Meanwhile the mysterious half-buried man comes clean about his true identity! But this must all be put aside when one of Mom`s most powerful generals comes calling!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Top Officer! The Sweet 3 General Cracker Appears!
sub.description:
The identity of the enigmatic Pound, the man half-buried in the woods, is revealed, but his deep connection to Big Mom might not be enough to save him! Nami`s past exploits, however, hold the key to keeping Mom`s minions at bay!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: An Enemy Worth 800 million! Luffy vs. Thousand Armed Cracker!
sub.description:
Luffy squares off against Cracker, one of the Sweet 3 Generals, as Nami learns the truth about others in the Worst Generation who have come before to challenge Big Mom!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: An All-out Duel! Gear Four vs. the Bis-Bis Ability
sub.description:
Luffy continues to fight against Cracker, whose powers to manipulate his surroundings may prove more troublesome than he had thought! Meanwhile, Brook and Pedro infiltrate the Whole Cake Island - and must hatch a plan to avoid getting caught!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The First and the Second Join! The Vinsmoke Family!
sub.description:
The wind starts to go out of Luffy`s sails as he fights an endless army of Biscuit Warriors! Meanwhile, the oldest two Vinsmoke brothers come home from a war to see their long-missing young brother Sanji.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Benefactor`s Life! Sanji and Owner Zeff!
sub.description:
Luffy starts to run out of steam as the Biscuit Warriors keep multiplying! If he can buy himself 10 minutes to recharge... Meanwhile, Sanji squares off against his family, but realizes they have some vital insurance to make sure he follows their scheme to marry Pudding.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: An Angry Sanji! The Secret of Germa 66!
sub.description:
Luffy needs just 10 minutes to recharge! Nami comes to rescue with the help of the Homies! Meanwhile, Sanji learns the terrible truth of Germa`s power - and his father`s dark history!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Past That He Let Go Of! Vinsmoke Sanji!
sub.description:
Nami challenges Cracker on her own! During the all-out fight, she loses her advantage and is close to defeat. Can Luffy bounce back in time? Meanwhile, Sanji`s tragic childhood is made clear.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: To the East Blue! Sanji`s Resolute Departure!
sub.description:
The terrible history of Sanji`s family continue to unfold. From a rare moment of compassion he is able to escape, only to face his father`s cruelty before setting out on his own.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Battle of Limits! Luffy and the Infinite Biscuits!
sub.description:
Luffy is in an all-out, all-you-can-eat battle! As Cracker`s endless stream of Biscuit Warriors marches on, Luffy`s endless appetite is put to the test. Meanwhile, Reiju helps Sanji to straighten himself out before he meets his fiancée.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Power of Satiety! A New Gear Four Form: Tank Man!
sub.description:
Luffy needs to think fast in order to turn the battle in his favor - filled with biscuits he debuts a new Gear Four attack that has lasting repercussions! Meanwhile, Chopper and Carrot find Sanji`s reflection, but can they get a message to him in time?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Heartbreaking Duel! Luffy vs Sanji! - Part 1
sub.description:
Luffy finally catches up with Sanji! However, as a happy past plays before his eyes in which he, Sanji, and the crew deepened their bonds, a new page is turning in the history of the Straw Hats - and Sanji`s journey with the crew looks to be coming to an end!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Heartbreaking Duel! Luffy vs Sanji! - Part 2
sub.description:
Luffy finally catches up with Sanji! However, as a happy past plays before his eyes in which he, Sanji, and the crew deepened their bonds, a new page is turning in the history of the Straw Hats - and Sanji`s journey with the crew looks to be coming to an end!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Storm of Revenge! An Enraged Army Comes to Attack!
sub.description:
Luffy makes a solemn promise to not move from his spot until Sanji returns to him. But as Mama`s army advances, that promise may prove a costly one. Meanwhile, Sanji and the Vinsmokes come face to face with Big Mom and his bride-to-be Pudding!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The End of the Adventure! Sanji`s Resolute Proposal!
sub.description:
Luffy stands his ground and waits for his friend to return! But the vengeful army washes over him - only a true friend can step in to turn the tide of battle! Meanwhile, Sanji and Pudding discuss their marriage - and come to a startling conclusion!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: I`ll Wait Here! Luffy vs. the Enraged Army!
sub.description:
Luffy puts his all into battling Big Mom`s vengeful army, however, their skills combined prove too formidable. Meanwhile, Sanji goes to Big Mom herself to bargain for the Straw Hats lives - with shocking results!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Invading the Chateau! Reach the Road Ponegliff!
sub.description:
Chopper and Carrot are captured by Brulee and strung up for dinner! But Chopper sees a chance to free himself! Meanwhile, Brook and Pedro launch a plan to reach the Ponegliffs - a daring game of chance!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Fateful Confrontation! Luffy and Big Mom!
sub.description:
Pekoms creates a diversion for Brook to set his plan into action. Meanwhile Luffy continues to goad Big Mom into a fight, and Pudding begins to have stirrings of rebellion herself!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Shout of the Soul! Brook and Pedro`s Lightning Operation!
sub.description:
Just when Luffy and Nami are in Big Mom`s grasp, Pudding arrives, but with news that they aren`t expecting - meanwhile Brook and Chopper both make headway getting out of their own jams!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Goodbye! Pudding`s Tearful Determination!
sub.description:
Sanji hopes his wedding with Pudding will solve the Straw Hat`s predicament - but Pudding secretly plans to to avoid the marriage, sharing a secret with Luffy. Meanwhile Brook comes face to face with Big Mom herself!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The History of the Left Eye! Pedro vs. Baron Tamago!
sub.description:
Luffy tries desperately to free himself as the risk of his own well-being! Meanwhile, Chopper and Carrot continue to search the mirror universe, Brook squares off against Big Mom, and Pedro’s past is revealed!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Moist Cigarette! The Night Before Sanji`s Wedding!
sub.description:
Luffy struggles to break himself free as Sanji falls deeper in love with the idea of marrying Pudding... But the mask falls off and the deadly charade of Big Mom is revealed as the depths of her treachery come to light!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Undaunted Soul! Brook vs. Big Mom!
sub.description:
Brook continues his all-out struggle against Big Mom, but his secret weapon might not be enough to save him! Meanwhile an unexpected ally from the past comes to the rescue!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Sora`s Wish! Germa`s Failure: Sanji!
sub.description:
Jimbei arrives on the scene and works to free Luffy and Nami! Meanwhile Sanji confronts his sister with the awful truth of Pudding, and she confides in him the powerful secret of their mother`s undying love!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: To Reach Sanji! Luffy`s Vengeful Hell-bent Dash!
sub.description:
Brook finds himself totally at the whim of Big Mom, and comes face to face with her brutal love! Meanwhile, Pedro reveals his explosive plan to create a distraction!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Chateau in Turmoil! Luffy, to the Rendezvous!
sub.description:
Chopper and Carrot use the mirror dimension to get in touch with Nami and Jimbei! Luffy makes it through more obstacles to learn that he just missed Sanji! Meanwhile, Sanji wonders alone about the best course of action.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Deciding to Say Goodbye! Sanji and His Straw-Hat Bento!
sub.description:
Brook hears Big Mom`s plan firsthand as she shares her intentions with Pudding in front of him! Meanwhile Big Mom`s agents believe most of the Straw Hats to be under control, but doubt besets Montd`Or.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Emperor Rolls Over! Rescue Brook Mission!
sub.description:
Nami and the others finally find Brook in the mirror dimension - but he`s in the most inopportune of places! Can they challenge the sleeping Mama and rescue their friend? Meanwhile, Luffy is waylaid on his way back to the rendezvous!
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: The Rendezvous! Luffy, a One-on-One at His Limit!
sub.description:
Luffy puts up a valiant fight in order to keep his word to Sanji! But will he be able to last until Sanji arrives at the rendezvous? Meanwhile, Jimbei shares the awful truth about the wedding with the other Straw Hats.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: A Liar! Luffy and Sanji!
sub.description:
Sanji and Luffy meet finally - and while he is happy to feed Luffy to replenish his energy, Sanji`s explanation of what actions he must take baffles Luffy! The crucial decision, to turn his back on his friends or his family, tears Sanji apart!
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Sanji Comes Back! Crash! The Tea Party from Hell!
sub.description:
The newly reunited Luffy and Sanji hear from the rest of the Straw Hats in the mirror dimension! Then, Jimbei starts telling them about Capone “Gang” Bege and proposes a shocking plan to take down Big Mom!
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: A Secret Meeting! Luffy vs. the Fire Tank Pirates!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats put Jimbei`s plan into action and approach Bege with the possibility of an alliance. But before they are granted an audience, they must make themselves presentable! At the same time, Nami learns about the terror of Big Mom from Lola`s twin sister!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Deadly Pact! Luffy & Bege`s Allied Forces!
sub.description:
The proposed alliance between the Straw Hats and Bege unfolds! A gaseous blast from the past, Gastino, a member of Bege`s team, reveals the secret weapon that the team plans to use against the Emperor! But Gastino is not who he seems, and the bait in this trap is none other than Luffy himself!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy Engages in a Secret Maneuver! The Wedding Full of Conspiracies Starts Soon!
sub.description:
Now, the assassination plan of Big Mom is all set and everyone starts preparing for the Tea Party. Montd`Or finds one of his crewmates, Bobbin the Disposer, dead, and suspects Sanji and Luffy of the crime. He goes to check if Sanji is in his room, just as Sanji is running to get back so as not to arouse suspicion.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Family Gets Together! The Hellish Tea Party Starts!
sub.description:
The day has arrived! Guests from the criminal underground pour in in droves, but some have their own agendas to settle! Big Mom’s sons, however, stand in their way and show them what they’ve got! Meanwhile, Luffy is preparing for his own plan!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Broken Couple! Sanji and Pudding Enter!
sub.description:
Final preparations abound on all sides and multiple plots start to come together! But can Sanji keep his nerve and go through with the plan? Or will Pudding`s beauty prove too enchanting?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Deadly Kiss! The Mission to Assassinate the Emperor Kicks Off!
sub.description:
All plans go into action as the moment of the wedding arrives - but as the veil is lifted on Pudding`s grotesque face, all hell breaks loose and unexpected circumstances mean chaos breaks out at the altar! Meanwhile, Luffy charges in, adding to the mayhem!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Returning the Sake Cup! The Manly Jimbei Pays His Debt!
sub.description:
The plan is launched! Big Mom falls to pieces as the wedding - and the wedding cake - are destroyed and a slew of Luffys are wreaking havoc around the site. But just when Luffy gets in trouble, Jimbei confronts Big Mom bravely!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Mission Failed?! The Big Mom Pirates Strike Back!
sub.description:
The plan is in full swing however - Big Mom is pushed past the edge of sanity and can`t even bring herself to act. Meanwhile, her children make a move against Germa and Pudding takes up her original aim of killing Sanji!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Run, Sanji! SOS! Germa 66!
sub.description:
The plot is in full swing as Luffy dashes towards Big Mom to show her the broken portrait again! Sanji makes an effort to free his family and wins the respect of his sister and Big Mom loses her wits!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Mom`s Secret! The Giant`s Island Elbaph and a Little Monster!
sub.description:
The tragic and sad history of Big Mom is revealed! From abandonment, rescue, and again to ruin, Big Mom`s voracious hunger has brought her into conflict with others from the very beginning!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Birth of Mom! The Day That Carmel Vanished!
sub.description:
Linlin enrages the Giants as she slays their respected warrior - but Mother throws herself on their mercy and begs for clemency for her beloved Linlin, forcing the troupe to leave Elbaph for good. But the kindness Mother shows belies a dark and twisted secret...
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Launcher Blasts! The Moment Of Big Mom`s Assassination!
sub.description:
Linlin, destroyed at the disappearance of Mother, falls in with a new cohort and finds a reason to go on living, proving herself a mighty force to be reckoned with! The Straw Hats’ plan goes awry and all hope looks to be lost!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Evil Army! Transform! Germa 66!
sub.description:
Bege and the Straw Hats are on the defensive as the full force of Mom`s troops are brought down on them! As they retreat into a fortress, Germa 66 springs in to action! However, Bege has bad news for his allied forces.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Cutting the Father-Son Relationship! Sanji and Judge!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats and Germa 66 are cornered in Bege`s stronghold - with the full force of the Big Mom Pirates pinning them down, it`s only a matter of time before their defenses crack. The only way out seems to be to make a break for it.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Escape from the Tea Party! Luffy vs. Big Mom!
sub.description:
The plan is executed to sneak the Straw Hats out of Big Mom`s castle while hidden inside Bege! But the irascible Luffy can`t resist getting in at least one punch against his foe! Meanwhile the Tamate Box slips into the hands of some surprising agent!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Execution Begins! Luffy`s Allied Forces Are Annihilated?!
sub.description:
The full might of the Big Mom Pirates proves too much for the Straw Hats and Germa 66. With no other options, they decide to turn and fight, even though it means their total annihilation! But the mysterious Tamate Box comes in to play and shakes up the playing field - literally!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Chateau Collapses! The Straw Hat`s Great Escape Begins!
sub.description:
The Whole Cake Chateau starts crumbling while everyone is trying to escape for their lives! Luffy and the others get away and move on to the next stage of their escape which involves some parting of ways. Meanwhile, Big Mom’s children notice their mother’s change of behavior at the worst possible moment.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Spear of Elbaph! Onslaught! The Flying Big Mom!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats continue their mad dash to the Sunny! As Big Mom rages, her underlings decide to turn her Hunger Pang attacks against the Straw Hats! The Whole Cake Island scrambles to remake the cake to calm down Big Mom!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Pudding`s Determination! Ablaze! The Seducing Woods!
sub.description:
Kingbaum puts his life on the line ferrying the Straw Hats towards the Seducing Woods! But Big Mom`s word trumps him in this terrifying forest, and soon enough she catches up! Meanwhile, Pudding puts her plan to rebuild the cake into action - and reveals her surprising motivations!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Lightning Counterattack! Nami and Zeus the Thundercloud!
sub.description:
Zeus pursues the Straw Hats as Nami keeps him occupied. She has a shocking surprise in store for him, however, that might stop Big Mom in her tracks! Meanwhile, Brook and Chopper find the Shark Submerge in a strange situation.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Coincidental Reunion! Sanji and the Lovestruck Evil Pudding!
sub.description:
Big Mom is relentless in her pursuit of the Straw Hats! Even being buried alive doesn`t stop her! The plan to recreate the cake to stop her onslaught progresses and Pudding’s changeable heart confuses all those looking on!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Save the Sunny! Fighting Bravely! Chopper and Brook!
sub.description:
Mama`s onslaught continues as Pudding keeps battling the contradictory urges in her head - to kill or kiss Sanji! Meanwhile, Brook and Chopper are at Perospero`s mercy - and are being reduced to sweetened versions of themselves!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Before the Dawn! Pedro, the Captain of the Guardians!
sub.description:
Sandwiched between Big Mom and her advancing fleet, the only hope is the Sunny`s Coup-de-Burst! But can the Straw Hats prepare it in time? Meanwhile, Pedro comes face to face with his past, and embraces a dramatic end to be sure that the tides of time continue to flow!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: I`ll Be Back! Luffy, Deadly Departure!
sub.description:
The last chance the Straw Hats have is the Coup de Burst! Pedro has made the ultimate sacrifice to give them this one chance to escape, but Big Mom`s naval forces are closing in and poised to knock them out! Luffy has to put himself on the line again to save his crew!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Man with a Bounty of Billion! The Strongest Sweet General, Katakuri!
sub.description:
Nami and the others who escaped the Whole Cake Island by Pedro’s sacrifice mourn over his death. Jimbei, however, keeps his calm which makes Brook lose his temper. Meanwhile, Luffy confronts the formidable Sweet General Katakuri in the Mirroworld.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Hard Battle Starts! Luffy vs. Katakuri!
sub.description:
Pudding and Sanji arrive at Cacao Island and begin to remake the only cake that will calm Big Mom! But their fake nuptials get in the way as they bicker like a married couple! Meanwhile, Luffy has lost the battle of his life - and the flame goes out of him... until the Sunny becomes the target of a new threat!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Green Room! An Invincible Helmsman, Jimbei!
sub.description:
Luffy keeps the forces out to destroy the Straw Hats at bay, however the crew needs to destroy all the mirrors - the final link that secure his safe return - on the ship in order to save themselves! At the same time, the ship is on a course for disaster, with Jimbei at the helm!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Threat of the Mole! Luffy`s Silent Fight!
sub.description:
Nami and the others start breaking all the mirrors on the Sunny in order to keep their enemies out while she and Luffy discuss where to rendezvous – but little do they know the plan is overheard! Meanwhile, Luffy’s grueling battle against Katakuri intensifies!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The End of the Deadly Battle?! Katakuri`s Awakening in Anger!
sub.description:
Both powerful combatants and strong users of Haki, Luffy and Katakuri are a dead match for each other. Every move is matched by their opponent! Elsewhere, the Big Mom Pirates square off against Germa! With so much at stake, Luffy falls to Katakuri, spelling his doom!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Forbidden Secret! Katakuri`s Merienda!
sub.description:
Katakuri retires to his sanctuary to enjoy the merienda - a chance for him to savor the sweetness of his crew of chefs and replenish his Haki! But he`s not the only one who`s doing eating, as Straw Hat uses his mouth to get out from under the mochi mountain crushing him!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy Fights Back! The Invincible Katakuri`s Weak Point!
sub.description:
Luffy discovers the secret to Katakuri`s unearthly fighting ability, and just might have a solution for how to stop him! Meanwhile at the Sweets Factory, Pudding receives a call from Brulee who has bad news for the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Another Crisis! Gear Four vs. Unstoppable Donuts!
sub.description:
Luffy runs out of his Haki and has to buy some time - in the most peculiar way! Meanwhile the Big Mom Pirates mobilize their entire fleet to squelch the pirate threat, and the replacement cake nears completion!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Rebellious Daughter, Chiffon! Sanji`s Big Plan for Transporting the Cake!
sub.description:
When Chiffon comes under attack, Sanji must choose between defending her or revealing himself to his enemies! Meanwhile, Luffy uses Brulee as a human shield to avoid the wrath of Big Mom!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Man`s Way of Life! Bege and Luffy`s Determination as Captains!
sub.description:
Bege arrives on the scene, seemingly willing to risk it all to bring down the Big Mom Pirates in a blaze of glory, but of course he has a trick up his sleeve! Meanwhile Luffy keeps on the move to regain his Haki, but begins to ponder just how far his limits can be pushed!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Cake Sank?! Sanji and Bege`s Getaway Battle!
sub.description:
Sanji and Bege get together and get off of Cacao Island successfully but their plan is in jeopardy as Oven begins to boil the sea itself! As Chiffon and the others who are on the ship are cornered, a surprising savior comes in to fight Oven!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Sulong! Carrot`s Big Mystic Transformation!
sub.description:
A vicious pincer attack bears down on the Straw Hats! Three fleets converge and try to squeeze the life from them! Daifuku himself take the lead! But Carrot draws on a deep power within and springs in to action under the light of the moon!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Break Through! The Straw Hat`s Mighty Sea Battle!
sub.description:
The much anticipated wedding cake is on its way, but there is a debate at the last minute! Shouldn`t this opportunity be used to slip poison into Big Mom`s meal to topple the Emperor of the Sea? Meanwhile, Carrot`s unearthly ability based on the power of the moon saves the day!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Finally, They Clash! The Emperor of the Sea vs. the Straw Hats!
sub.description:
Luffy, through sheer force of will, can almost use his Haki to battle Katakuri! Meanwhile, the Sunny catches fire while the Straw Hats try to kick out Big Mom but that’s when Jimbei steps up to the plate and takes a swing at her!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Dark King`s Direct Precepts! The Battle Against Katakuri Turns Around!
sub.description:
Luffy tries to enhance his Haki to foresee Katakuri’s next move but Katakuri’s attacks keep pulling him down! However, when he summons every bit of wisdom from his training with Rayleigh, he remembers something important that could turn the tables for him!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Finally He Returns! Sanji, the Man Who`ll Stop the Emperor of the Sea!
sub.description:
The cake is finally prepared and brought before Big Mom! With the end of her vicious rampage in sight, there is a chance for the Straw Hats to flee! Big Mom`s crew is forced to decide who to attack! Meanwhile, Luffy grows ever closer to using his Haki!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Lurking in the Darkness! An Assassin Targeting Luffy!
sub.description:
Hiding her presence, Flampe shoots her blowgun at Luffy to support her dear brother Katakuri. Meanwhile, Oven launches a dastardly plan to fence Luffy in - by destroying every mirror on the island! And Smoothie is on the tail of the Sunny as it makes its way towards Cacao Island!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: One Man`s Determination! Katakuri`s Deadly Big Fight!
sub.description:
Katakuri notices his sister Flampe is sneakily providing poison needle back up in the shadows. Becoming enraged, he takes unexpected action that surprises everyone. Meanwhile, Smoothie increases her size and closes in on the Sunny.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Wake Up! The Color of Observation Able to Top the Strongest!
sub.description:
Luffy leans on his training to bring out the power of his Haki! Meanwhile the children of Big Mom gather as a massive force ready to smash Luffy and the Straw Hats. Their resentment at being embarrassed fuels their desire to get revenge!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Fist of Divine Speed! Another Gear Four Application Activated!
sub.description:
Luffy and Katakuri are locked in a duel to end all duels! Their powers ensure that each blow could be the last! Luffy must rely on his training, let all his thoughts out, and keep pushing on! Meanwhile, Sanji is about to land at Cacao Island!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Finally, It`s Over! The Climax of the Intense Fight Against Katakuri!
sub.description:
Luffy`s dramatic battle finally draws to a close! But even if he is able to pull out victory in the last moment, can he remember the key to escaping the Mirrorworld?! Meanwhile, the whole host of the Big Mom Pirates watch the lonely mirror to see who will come through!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Desperate Situation! The Iron-tight Entrapment of Luffy!
sub.description:
Luffy emerges safely! And Pekoms` bravery ensures he and the Straw Hats have a fighting chance! But can they withstand the full force of the Big Mom Pirates? At the last moment - a surprise explodes onto the scene!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Pulling Back from the Brink! The Formidable Reinforcements: Germa!
sub.description:
Sanji tries his best to save himself and his captain, Luffy! But the arrival of Germa has complicated matters. Whose side do these powerful superhumans fight on? In the end, sisterly love will see Sanji saved!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Last Hope! The Sun Pirates Emerge!
sub.description:
Luffy and Sanji are safe! But the critical moment approaches - the fate of Totto Land rests on the taste of the wedding cake! Will it be sweet release or bitter defeat? Meanwhile, a cunning pincer attack leaves the Straw Hats hopelessly trapped. Only old, reliable comrades can save the day!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Captivating Flavor! Sanji`s Cake of Happiness!
sub.description:
With the help of the Sun Pirates, the Straw Hats see their chance to escape! And the Sun Pirates bid farewell to their former captain. Mama finally tastes the Wedding Cake and the results are positively scrumptious!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Man of Humanity and Justice! Jimbei, a Desperate Massive Ocean Current
sub.description:
The Big Mom Pirates fooled! The Straw Hats have eluded their would-be tormentors with the help of the Sun Pirates! However, as the fleet of the Big Mom Pirates is still coming after them, Jimbei makes a crucial decision to help the Sunny to get away.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Parting Time! Pudding`s Last Wish!
sub.description:
At a great cost of energy and life, the Straw Hats make it out of Totto Land. Left behind in their wake are allies and friends, and would-be lovers. As the sea opens before them, what price has been paid for their escape?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The World Is Stunned! The Fifth Emperor of the Sea Emerges!
sub.description:
Luffy`s recent exploits make their way around the world! The reputation of this mighty pirate begins to grow as all eyes look towards the Straw Hats` next move! Also - German 66 leaves an artifact behind which excites the crew!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: To the Reverie! The Straw Hats` Sworn Allies Come Together!
sub.description:
As the royals make their way to the Reverie, the mighty Navy takes all precautions to make sure they don`t fall prey to kidnappings! At the vanguard is Koby, who glimpses Luffy`s exploits and remembers their shared past. Meanwhile, Luffy is confronted with a staggering change to his bounty!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Sabo Goes into Action! All the Captains of the Revolutionary Army Appear!
sub.description:
A vicious pirate group led by Pinkbeard who describes himself as one of Blackbeard’s affiliates attacks a town in the Kingdom of Lulucia while their king and able-bodied soldiers have gone to the Reverie. And four bizarre individuals come to help. They’re the captains of the Revolutionary Army.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Going into Action! The Implacable New Admiral of the Fleet - Sakazuki!
sub.description:
At New Marineford, Sakazuki, the new Admiral of the Fleet, hears the news about Luffy and recalls the tumultuous Paramount War that haunts the Navy! That game-changing war has repercussions that last into the present!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Paramount War! The Inherited Will of the King of the Pirates!
sub.description:
Nobles from around the world gather for the Reverie as the echoes of the Paramount War resound! Among them are Shirahoshi and her family from the Ryugu Kingdom under the sea. Meanwhile, Admiral Fujitora has a conversation with his new colleague, Admiral Ryokugyu.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: One Step Forward for Her Dream! Shirahoshi Goes Out in the Sun!
sub.description:
Stelly, Sabo’s adopted brother and now the king of the Goa Kingdom, walks up to Garp who is escorting the royal family of the Fish-Man Island, with an air of importance and something up his sleeve. Meanwhile, Shirahoshi sees the surface world for the first time.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: I Miss Him! Vivi and Rebecca`s Sentiments!
sub.description:
Shirahoshi and her family finally reach the Holyland of Mariejois! But all the unexpected attention confuses her. Meanwhile, Vivi from Alabasta meets Leo and Rebecca from Dressrosa, and tells them the story of her journey with the Straw Hats.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: In the Dark Recesses of the Holyland! A Mysterious Giant Straw Hat!
sub.description:
Vivi reunites with Dalton and Dr. Kureha from the Sakura Kingdom and they share their memories of the Straw Hats with Shirahoshi and Rebecca. Meanwhile, a shadowy figure descends a long staircase at the castle in the Holyland and opens a mysterious door.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Holyland in Tumult! The Targeted Princess Shirahoshi!
sub.description:
Shirahoshi crosses the fancy of a Celestial Dragon, and those living gods are not open to having their whims disobeyed! As she is dragged away, King Neptune comes to her rescue, risking life and limb by defying the Celestial Dragon, but luckily an old friend of the Ryugu Kingdom is on hand and tries to defuse the situation!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: An Explosive Situation! Two Emperors of the Sea Going After Luffy!
sub.description:
The Emperors of the Sea, Big Mom and Kaido decide to team up against Luffy! Meanwhile, Garp hears about the wild exploits of his grandson, all while a mysterious outsider visits the highest authority in the world!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Sabo Enraged! The Tragedy of the Revolutionary Army Officer Kuma!
sub.description:
After sneaking into the Land of the Gods, Sabo sees the shocking figure of his friend – Kuma! Abused by the World Government as a pawn in their games, Kuma, who was made an example of what happens when you disobey the gods!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Finally, It Starts! The Conspiracy-filled Reverie!
sub.description:
The Reverie has begun! The representative kings and queens first discuss what to do with Straw Hat Luffy. Meanwhile the Revolutionary Army confirms its desire to save Kuma! All while they recount how the Straw Hats have grown from upstarts into world players!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Marco! The Keeper of Whitebeard`s Last Memento!
sub.description:
In order to recruit a strong ally towards bringing down Kaido, Cat Viper and his crew stop by Whitebeard’s homeland to see Marco, the 1st division commander of the Whitebeard Pirates.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Climbing up a Waterfall! A Great Journey Through the Land of Wano`s Sea Zone!
sub.description:
Luffy and the others become excited as they see familiar faces in a newspaper article about the Reverie while they close in on the Land of Wano. But this dangerous and foreboding land is as inaccessible as it is mysterious! The sea itself is a barrier!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Land of Wano! To the Samurai Country Where Cherry Blossoms Flutter!
sub.description:
A mysterious country, a rampaging slasher, ancient samurai rituals of seppuku - and Zoro in the crosshairs! When a street assault occurs, all signs point to Zoro! Meanwhile, Luffy finally arrives at the Land of Wano but all his friends are nowhere to be found.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Otama Appears! Luffy vs. Kaido`s Army!
sub.description:
Stranded alone on the beach, Luffy tries to gather his bearings only to be confronted by some mysterious, and dangerous, local fauna! And then, he meets a little girl named Otama! Meanwhile, Zoro makes trouble for the others who are trying to blend in!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: He`ll Come! The Legend of Ace in the Land of Wano!
sub.description:
Otama`s gratitude towards Luffy knows no bounds! But the feast she cooks him exhausts her food stores completely! As she suffers from poor drinking water, her companion tells the story of the mysterious outsider she waits for - Ace!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Side Story! The World`s Greatest Bounty Hunter, Cidre!
sub.description:
Ambushed and outgunned by a skilled bounty hunter Cidre’s group, the Straw Hats rely on the Sunny`s Coup de Burst to escape! But they end up stranded without cola! A nearby soda island offers a solution - but Luffy is quickly in over his head! Luckily a vivacious old friend is nearby!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Side Story! Clash! Luffy vs. the King of Carbonation!
sub.description:
Luffy and Boa Hancock square off against the Cidre Guild! These unscrupulous bounty hunters have one thing in mind - profit at any cost! When the battle looks won, Cidre gears up in a menacing power suit!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Save Otama! Straw Hat, Bounding Through the Wasteland!
sub.description:
Otama recounts her promise to Ace while Luffy rushes her to medical attention. But just as they reach the wasteland, a familiar face comes into view! But Kaido`s underlings show up too!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Headliner! Hawkins the Magician Appears!
sub.description:
Otama’s temperature is going up and Luffy has no time to waste! However, Hawkins, one of Kaido’s Headliners, blocks their way by showing his unique powers and skills which can harm his own men.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Defeat Is Inevitable! The Strawman`s Fierce Attack!
sub.description:
Luffy and Zoro have been stalled by Hawkins but their fortune looks bright as they are guided by a woman who Zoro had saved. She leads them to a teahouse and to an herbal remedy for the river poison. All the while, old acquaintances look on from a distance!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Greatest Day of My Life! Otama and Her Sweet Red-bean Soup!
sub.description:
Otama`s life is saved by Otsuru at her teahouse. The proud Otama finds it hard to take more kindness. The group learns of the Okobore Town - living on the cast-offs of the officials! Then, suddenly, they were attacked by the Shogun’s men!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Charging into the Enemy`s Territory! Bakura Town: Where Officials Thrive!
sub.description:
Otama has been kidnapped by the Gifters! She is taken to a flourishing town called Bakura Town where a creepy-looking Headliner was expecting her. Luffy and Zoro rush to rescue her along with a samurai, Okiku!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Yokozuna Appears! The Invincible Urashima Goes After Okiku!
sub.description:
As Luffy, Zoro, and Okiku bounce through Bakura Town on Komachiyo’s back, looking for the kidnapped Otama, a sumo wrestler comes flying towards them! Interested, they go down to watch sumo but the undefeated yokozuna Urashima has been expecting Okiku there and shows his brutal nature!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Climactic Sumo Battle! Straw Hat vs. the Strongest Ever Yokozuna!
sub.description:
Luffy challenges Urashima, the strongest yokozuna in the Land of Wano, to a sumo match! Urashima even uses illegal moves to beat Luffy at any cost! Meanwhile, Holdem tells Otama that he knows she committed a crime and he has to punish her for it.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy Rages! Rescue Otama from Danger!
sub.description:
After sending the yokozuna Urashima flying, Luffy and his clan continue their search for Bakura Town’s boss to save Otama! They finally find the boss, Holdem, one of the Beast Pirates’ Headliners, and Otama who is hanging in the mouth of a lion in Holdem’s stomach.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Taking Back Otama! A Fierce Fight Against Holdem!
sub.description:
Facing Holdem who is holding Otama as hostage, Luffy prepares for a fight but Okiku tries to stop him by sharing who is really ruling the region. Meanwhile, Basil Hawkins who is also working for Kaido and chasing after Luffy, is confronted by a mysterious figure.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Duel! The Magician and the Surgeon of Death!
sub.description:
Taking down Holdem, Luffy rescues Otama and tries to catch up to Zoro and Okiku who stole the food treasure ship and started a mad dash to get out of the town! Meanwhile, Trafalgar Law’s attempt to silence Basil Hawkins fails when he hears bad news about his alliance.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Romance Dawn
sub.description:
This is a story of Luffy in an alternate reality. While sailing on the sea by himself, a strange bird crashes into his small boat. He looks up to find a giant ship where a girl named Ann has been captured. It seems like the bird belongs to her.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Coming of the Treasure Ship! Luffytaro Returns the Favor!
sub.description:
Zoro and the others dash out of BakuraTown on the treasure ship filled with food! Luffy catches up to them bringing ahuge bucket of fresh water! Then, they distribute the food and the water to thepeople of Okobore Town who were thirsty and hungry.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Mysterious Grave Markers! A Reunion at the Ruins of Oden Castle!
sub.description:
Luffy arrives at the ruins of Oden Castle following Law and finds the graves of his friends, Kin’emon and the others. As Law starts telling the already-stunned Luffy about the creepy story of Kin’emon’s ghost, Luffy sees it coming towards him!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Legendary Samurai! The Man Who Roger Admired!
sub.description:
Kin’emon tells Luffy and the others about how Kozuki Oden made Kuri into a peaceful region and became its Daimyo. However, he was set up by Kaido and Kurozumi Orochi and executed. Kin’emon and his fellow vassals ran to Oden Castle in flames to save Oden’s wife Toki and children but Toki told him a shocking truth.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Bringing Down the Emperor of the Sea! A Secret Raid Operation Begins!
sub.description:
Kin’emon and the others crossed through time by the power of Kozuki Toki, Momonosuke’s mother, and arrived at the Land of Wano 20 years later, a totally different country before their eyes. However, discovering that there were still their allies there, they started preparing to take down Kaido and Orochi who ruined the country.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Strongest Man in the World! Shutenmaru, the Thieves Brigade Chief!
sub.description:
Ashura Doji, one of the allies Kin’emon wants to search for, has become the head of a thieves brigade and they now raid Okobore Town taking away the food that Luffy gave to the people. Ashura Doji, under the name Shutenmaru, then faces Kaido’s right-hand man and gets into a fierce fight!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Everyone Is Annihilated! Kaido`s Furious Blast Breath!
sub.description:
The drunken Kaido flies above Okobore Town in his dragon form and threatens Shutenmaru and all the people in the town. Luffy, Law, Kin’emon, and Okiku start running towards the town to rescue them. However, Kaido heads towards the ruins of Oden Castle where they left their crew behind.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Finally Clashing! The Ferocious Luffy vs. Kaido!
sub.description:
After Luffy sees Kaido shattering the ruins of Oden Castle where he left his friends, he becomes enraged and attacks Kaido! Soon after, he finds out Kaido even assaulted Otama who was riding on Speed’s back to her home. Furious, Luffy reveals himself to Kaido and starts to retaliate!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Destructive! One Shot, One Kill: Thunder Bagua!
sub.description:
An infuriated Luffy strikes blow after blow on the drunken Kaido. When he activates Gear Four Bounce-Man and launches even more powerful attacks, Kaido fights back and knocks him out with just one blow. Law tries to rescue Luffy but is interrupted by Hawkins and now Kaido approaches Luffy, unconscious on the ground.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Living Hell! Luffy, Humiliated in the Great Mine!
sub.description:
Luffy gets beaten by Kaido and is sent to a great mine where prisoners are made to work in forced labor. There, he finds an unexpected reunion. Meanwhile, Okiku is rushing to the ruins of Oden Castle in order to confirm the safety of the Straw Hats and the others.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Holyland in Tumult! Emperor of the Sea Blackbeard Cackles!
sub.description:
On Gloom Island in the Grand Line, Perona finds out that her captain, Gecko Moria, is alive and she is about to leave Dracule Mihawk who let her stay there for the last two years. Meanwhile, Moria raids the Pirate Island of Fullalead with his zombie army to take back his friend from Blackbeard.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: It`s On! The Special Operation to Bring Down Kaido!
sub.description:
Dogstorm fights against Shutenmaru to ally with him for their operation but Shutenmaru still rejects their call. Meanwhile, Sanji and the others are on their mission to recruit like-minded people who become skeptical as they receive the secret message from the Kozuki Clan.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Rampage! The Prisoners: Luffy and Kid!
sub.description:
In the Excavation Labor Camp, Luffy competes against Kid by hauling stones for food and they both get tons of it. However, Dobon, a vice warden, becomes furious when he finds out all their provisions are gone, and gives Luffy and Kid a new sentence: death.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Great Sensation! Sanji`s Special Soba!
sub.description:
Sanji’s Special Soba becomes very popular but some gang members come to disturb his business and knock over a customer’s bowl. Infuriated, Sanji takes them down and gives the customer, a little girl named Toko, another serving. Later, Sanji and his friends find out that Toko is an attendant to an important figure in the Land of Wano.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luxurious and Gorgeous! Wano`s Most Beautiful Woman: Komurasaki!
sub.description:
Wano’s top courtesan Komurasaki is in procession and slowly makes her way to Orochi Palace. There is a crowd of people on the street as well as Sanji and the others. While everyone is fascinated by her, some seeking vengeance get in the Oiran’s way.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Tale of Chivalry! Zoro and Tonoyasu`s Little Trip!
sub.description:
Zoro who has been wandering around the Land of Wano since he got separated from his friends meets a sycophant named Tonoyasu. Tonoyasu paid for Zoro’s sushi and to pay him back, Zoro gambles at dice. However, he realizes that the dealer and the others are cheating.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A State of Emergency! Big Mom Closes In!
sub.description:
Zoro is taken to the sycophant Tonoyasu’s poor hometown, Ebisu Town where people laugh away their misfortune. On the other hand, Wano’s Shogun – Orochi has a lavish banquet while Big Mom is closing in on the country at a furious speed.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Capitol in an Uproar! Another Assassin Targets Sanji!
sub.description:
As the Big Mom Pirates approach the Land of Wano, Kaido’s subordinates led by King and Queen try to get rid of them. Meanwhile, in the Flower Capital, another member of the Animal Kingdom Pirates, Page One, attacks every soba restaurant in the city, in search of Sanji.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Dashing! The Righteous Soba Mask!
sub.description:
Sanji faces Page One, a Headliner of the Animal Kingdom Pirates, who questions the soba cook’s true identity. Sanji uses Germa’s device for the first time and transforms himself into Stealth Black while dubbing himself Soba Mask.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Desperate Situation! Orochi`s Menacing Oniwabanshu!
sub.description:
While the banquet grows livelier at Orochi’s Castle, Robin is confronted by his ninja force called Oniwabanshu. In the meanwhile in Kuri, Chopper, Tama, and Momonosuke train themselves preparing for the incoming battle but are interrupted when they find someone washed up on the beach.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Pandemonium! The Monster Snake, Shogun Orochi!
sub.description:
At the banquet, the Shogun Orochi starts to talk about his late old enemy which bores the attendees. Suddenly, the Oiran’s child attendant Toko bursts with laughter and won’t stop. Orochi becomes furious and attacks her, but an unexpected person stands in his way.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Flower Falls! The Final Moment of the Most Beautiful Woman in the Land of Wano!
sub.description:
In order to save her child attendant Toko, the top Oiran Komurasaki stands up to the Shogun Orochi, but the yakuza boss Kyoshiro interrupts and does something that no one expected. Meanwhile, Robin is trying to get out of Orochi’s Castle with the help of Nami and Brook.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Bond Between Prisoners! Luffy and Old Man Hyo!
sub.description:
Nami, Robin, and the others got away from Oden’s Castle and now discuss what they have found out about the enemy so far. Meanwhile, Chopper’s group sets off to rescue Luffy from the Excavation Labor Camp where, at the same time, Luffy is in big trouble.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Lead Performer! Queen the Plague Emerges!
sub.description:
At the Excavation Labor Camp in Udon, Luffy tries to save Old Man Hyo and stands up to Vice Warden Daifuku and Warden Babanuki with his physical strength weakened by the Sea Prism Stone cuffs. Then when a Lead Performer of the Animal Kingdom Pirates, Queen the Plague, comes to the camp, Luffy makes an escape!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Climb Up! Luffy`s Desperate Escape!
sub.description:
Luffy and Old Man Hyo try to climb up the wall and break out of the Excavation Labor Camp, but Queen the Plague stands in their way and gives them a hard time! Meanwhile, Nami and Robin experience a public bathhouse along with Shinobu and come to know about the Land of Wano’s great yakuza boss.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Dead or Alive! Queen`s Sumo Inferno!
sub.description:
Luffy fights quite a few Queen’s men at once in the deadly sumo match while protecting Old Man Hyo! Meanwhile, Nami, Robin, and Shinobu are cornered as Hawkins comes to raid the bathhouse. However, someone who they don’t expect to be there pops up from nowhere to save them.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Gyukimaru! Zoro Fights a Duel on Bandit`s Bridge!
sub.description:
Luffy deals with the endless supply of opponents trying to figure out the way to use Haki that Rayleigh taught him a while ago. Meanwhile, Zoro faces Gyukimaru who is accusing him of stealing Shusui, however, their duel is interrupted by a woman’s scream.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: A Big Turnover! The Three-Sword Style Overcomes Danger!
sub.description:
The duel between Zoro and Gyukimaru is interrupted by Kamazo, Orochi’s assassin who came after a little girl Toko. Without Shusui, Zoro has a hard time fighting the two at the same time, but he finds an unlikely third sword to take down the enemies.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Zoro, Stunned! The Shocking Identity of the Mysterious Woman!
sub.description:
Luffy’s next enemies in the deadly sumo match in the Excavation Labor Camp are two tough Gifters. Much to Old Man Hyo’s surprise, Luffy keeps practicing using Haki properly at the same time as he fights them. Meanwhile, the wounded Zoro wakes up to find out the stunning identity of the mysterious woman he saved.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Get the Hang of It! The Land of Wano`s Haki: Ryuo!
sub.description:
Hiyori tells Zoro a stunning story of escaping the incident 20 years ago and surviving until the present day. Meanwhile, Luffy stills struggles to master the Haki of the Color of Arms, but a surprising person steps up and gives an example.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Tonoyasu! Ebisu Town`s Most Loved!
sub.description:
Luffy continues training himself to use Haki with Old Man Hyo’s help, but the battle is suddenly suspended and shortly thereafter Raizo appears in front of them. Meanwhile, Nami, Usopp, and the others are wondering who Tonoyasu, Ebisu Town’s hero, really is.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Shaking the Nation! The Identity of Ushimitsu Kozo the Chivalrous Thief!
sub.description:
Ushimitsu Kozo the great thief who robbed from the rich and gave to the poor gets caught and his true identity stuns Orochi and the others. When Toko hears the news, she gets very upset and so is Zoro when he hears the reason.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Straw Hats Run! Save the Captive Tonoyasu!
sub.description:
Tonoyasu has been strung up and is soon-to-be executed. The people of the Land of Wano recognize who he really is and start raising their voice while the Straw Hats rush to save him. Then, Tonoyasu starts addressing the nation and the corrupt Shogun Orochi.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Zoro`s Fury! The Truth About the Smile!
sub.description:
By the time Kin’emon and the others notice that Yasuie is trying to sacrifice his life to save their raid plan, it was all too late. Ebisu Town`s people laughing out loud annoys Zoro, but when Hiyori tells him the reason behind it, he is in for a shock!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Toko`s Tears! Orochi`s Pitiless Bullets!
sub.description:
Hiyori and Shinobu tearfully tell the Straw Hats the truth behind Ebisu Town residents` cheerfulness and smiles, which infuriates them. When Yasuie’s daughter, Toko, runs to her father’s body, Orochi recognizes who she is and takes a shot at her!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Straw Hats Step In! An Uproarious Deadly Battle at the Execution Ground!
sub.description:
Zoro and Sanji start fighting against Orochi’s clan. Nami and the rest of the Straw Hats join them. Meanwhile, at the Excavation Labor Camp, a new criminal, Hitokiri Kamazo, has arrived. And someone else who is brought to the site reveals the shocking truth about Kamazo.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy`s Determination! Win Through the Sumo Inferno!
sub.description:
Zoro keeps fighting Kyoshiro, but Orochi’s Oniwabanshu comes to back Kyoshiro up. Meanwhile, at the Excavation Labor Camp, Queen announces the restart of the Sumo Inferno with a new cruel rule which is painful not only to Luffy, but also to Drake and Killer.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Storm Has Come! A Raging Big Mom!
sub.description:
Kin’emon apologizes Ashura Doji AKA Shutenmaru for goading Holdem to attack Atamayama where Ashura’s hideout was located, and asks him to join the fight against Kaido. Meanwhile, Chopper and his group finally arrived at the Excavation Labor Camp and Big Mom forces her way in to find her favorite soup!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Grudge over Red-bean Soup! Luffy Gets into a Desperate Situation!
sub.description:
Craving red-bean soup, Big Mom attacks Queen, the Animal Kingdom Pirates’ Lead Performer who reins over Udon. However, when she finds out that the pot is empty, she turns her wrath against the one who ate it all: Luffy.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Stop the Emperor of the Sea! Queen`s Secret Plan!
sub.description:
After finding out that Luffy ate the whole pot ofthe red-bean soup that she was looking for, Big Mom becomes infuriated and goesafter him. Meanwhile, Queen, the Lead Performer, comes up with a plan to stopthe rampaging Big Mom.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Brutal Ammunition! The Plague Rounds Aim at Luffy!
sub.description:
Queen hastily ties up the sleeping Big Mom and carries her to Onigashima leaving Udon to Babanuki. Babanuki uses a weapon that Queen made to threaten inmates and make them catch Luffy, but a mysterious figure emerges from the forbidden cell to save Luffy.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Start Fighting Back! Luffy and the Akazaya Samurai!
sub.description:
Kawamatsu the Kappa is freed and stands up against Babanuki and his underlings! Listening to Old Man Hyo’s suggestion, Raizo and Kiku reveal their true identities which give the desperate prisoners not only a shock but also some hope.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: We`re Here to Win! Luffy`s Desperate Scream!
sub.description:
Luffy faces those who are infected by the Plague Rounds and the non-infected prisoners who submit to the authority of Udon. To open their eyes, Luffy takes a measure that will risk his life. However, the Chief Warden Babanuki has something up his sleeve.
Source: Crunchyroll

sub.title: Warriors` Dream! Luffy`s Conquer of Udon!
sub.description:
The freed prisoners in Udon refuse to fight alongside Luffy because he is a pirate. Raizo and Old Man Hyo try their best to convince them, but an unexpected person stands up to bring the prisoners hope after taking down Kaido!
