Luffy and Bon are on the verge of reaching Level 4, but they didn`t count on fighting a demonic, lightning-fast, devastatingly powerful Minotaur! To defeat this beast, they`ll need help from a human candle and a deranged clown!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: All Forces Have Gathered! The Battle on Level 4 - The Burning Heat Hell!
sub.description:
Luffy narrowly avoids a deadly dip in a boiling pool of blood, only to find himself face to face with Warden Magellan. Meanwhile, outside the prison walls, the marine fleet prepares for Whitebeard`s onslaught!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Mighty Magellan! Bon Clay Bugs Out!
sub.description:
Warden Magellan is a monster of a man with a penchant for poisoning prisoners. To rescue Ace, Luffy must go toe to toe with this toxic terror, but how do you defeat a foe who`s deadly to the touch?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Showdown Has Come! Luffy's Desperate Last Attack!
sub.description:
Luffy`s daring assault on the venomous warden of Impel Down leaves him struggling to stand up, but despite the lethal poison breaking down his body, the rubber-man kicks his rescue mission into second gear!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: For His Friend! Bon Clay Goes to the Deadly Rescue!
sub.description:
Luffy is at the end of the line - the only thing that can save him now is true friendship. But in a place like Impel Down can true friendship be found?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Paradise in Hell! Impel Down - Level 5.5!
sub.description:
No existing antidote can save Luffy from the poison coursing through his veins, yet Bon Clay refuses to give up. His final, fleeting hope is a mysterious miracle-worker rumored to have vanished into the Gates of Hell!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy's Treatment Begins! Ivan-san's Miraculous Power!
sub.description:
Bon is overjoyed to hear that Luffy is still alive, but his happiness quickly turns to shock when he learns that Ivan`s agonizingly painful "Healing Hormones" will cost the rubber-man ten years of his life!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Believe in Miracles! Bon Clay's Cries From the Heart!
sub.description:
Ace is scheduled to be executed in a matter of hours, and Luffy`s still hovering on the verge of death. It will take a miracle to save them both, but Bon would rather die than give up on his friend!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy's Back! Ivan-san Begins the Breakout Plan!
sub.description:
Luffy miraculously survived his brush with death, but he`s far too weak to finish rescuing Ace. Ivan is reluctant to lend a hormonal hand to the doomed rescue mission - until he learns of Luffy`s lineage!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Ace's Convoy Begins! Battle on the Lowest Floor - Level 6!
sub.description:
The quest to rescue Ace tuckers out thanks to a blast of sleeping gas! Ivan`s scissor-handed sidekick puts an end to nap time, but Luffy will have to join forces with a scar-faced foe from the past if he wants to complete his mission!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Ultimate Team Has Formed! Shaking Impel Down!
sub.description:
Luffy`s desperate attempt to rescue Ace is bolstered by two powerful new allies: the murderous Crocodile and the honorable fishman Jinbei. Meanwhile, Ivan sparks a prison riot to create a diversion for the rubber-man.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Even More Chaos! Here Comes Blackbeard Teach!
sub.description:
Luffy and his gang of outlaws cause a commotion on Level Four, Blackbeard`s arrival leads to the release of the prison`s most feared inmate, and Ace gazes upon the great blue sky for what could be the very last time!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Dangerous Encounter! Blackbeard and Shiryu of the Rain!
sub.description:
Ivan undergoes a curvaceous transformation to better battle sadistic Sadie, the commander of the Demon Guards. Meanwhile, Blackbeard and Shiryu head for a showdown on Level 1!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: No Price Too High! Serious Hannyabal!
sub.description:
Luffy`s bone-crushing battle with the Vice Warden of Impel Down is interrupted by the sudden appearance of Blackbeard. When the rubber-man hears what the warlord has to say - heads will roll!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Jet Pistol of Anger! Luffy vs. Blackbeard!
sub.description:
Even in Second Gear, Luffy is no match for Blackbeard`s vortex, but the rubber-man rebounds by knocking out a Demon Guard with one ferocious pistol-punch. Elsewhere, Warden Magellan vows to finish Luffy once and for all!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Stop Magellan! Ivan-san's Esoteric Technique Explodes!
sub.description:
Ace is to be executed in a matter of hours, and Magellan`s toxic breath is singeing the back of Luffy`s neck. Ivan uses a devastating Death Wink to buy some time, but the warden`s Poison Hydra may be more than he can handle!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Magellan's Tricky Move! A Foiled Escape Plan!
sub.description:
Luffy dons a suit of waxy armor in preparation for his rematch with Warden Magellan. Outside the prison walls, Jimbei turns a door into a boat, so Crocodile and Buggy can commandeer an escape vessel!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Escapee Team in Trouble! The Forbidden Move: Venom Demon!
sub.description:
Magellan takes his toxic attack to the next level by unleashing the hideous and deadly Venom Demon! If Jimbei and Crocodile don`t return with a rescue ship soon, Luffy won`t survive long enough to save Ace!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Come, Final Miracle! Break Through the Gate of Justice!
sub.description:
Luffy and his merry band of escapees are safely onboard the rescue ship, but they`re not out hot water just yet. A fleet of marines is bombarding them with cannon balls, and an impenetrable gate looms on the horizon!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: To the Navy Headquarters! Off to Rescue Ace!
sub.description:
Luffy and Ivan mourn the loss of Bon Clay, and Captain Buggy`s reputation gets a boost when a phone call from the Marines reveals the secrets of his past.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! The Weatheria Report and the Cyborg Animals!
sub.description:
While Luffy continues his rescue mission, Nami learns a lesson about how to turn rain into cash, and Franky wakes up in a freezing forest full of ferocious cyborg animals!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! A Cheeper of Giant Birds and a Pink Showdown!
sub.description:
Sanji tries to fight his way off a most peculiar island, but his frilly battle costume threatens to awaken his inner maiden. Elsewhere, Chopper tries to avoid being served in a hot pot!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! Revolutionaries and the Gorging Forest's Trap
sub.description:
Nico Robin lends her many hands to an overmatched gang of revolutionaries in a frigid land of eternal suffering, and Usopp bulks up to avoid becoming a snack for a hungry, hungry island!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Friends' Whereabouts! A Huge Tomb and the Panty Debt!
sub.description:
Zoro`s attempt to reunite with his friends leads him a massive tomb and a host of shadowy swordsmen. Elsewhere, Brook uses his status as Satan to get an eyeful of undergarments!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Special Retrospective Before Marineford! The Vow of the Brotherhood!
sub.description:
While the marines prepare for Ace`s execution, Luffy looks back on all the good times he shared with his brother, and Jimbei reveals the shocking details of the day Fire Fist Ace went down in defeat!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Special Retrospective Before Marineford! The Three Navy Admirals Come Together!
sub.description:
Luffy and his gang continue on their way to Marineford, but once he arrives, the rubber-man must defeat both Navy Admirals and Warlords of the Sea before he can save Ace!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Ticking Down to the Time of Battle! The Navy's Strongest Lineup in Position!
sub.description:
Citizens and soldiers alike prepare for all-out war as Ace is led to the site of his execution. While the world watches, the true identity of the condemned man`s father is shockingly revealed!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Vast Fleet Appears! Here Come the Whitebeard Pirates!
sub.description:
Flashbacks reveal the agonizing sacrifice made by Ace`s mother in order save his life - and the secret behind his connection to Luffy. Back in the present, Whitebeard makes a unexpected entrance!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Beginning of the War! Ace and Whitebeard's Past!
sub.description:
As a massive seaquake rocks Marineford, Ace recalls the ups and downs of his life as a pirate, including his first encounter with Whitebeard - and the unthinkable betrayal that led to his capture!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Force That Could Destroy the World! The Power of the Tremor-Tremor Fruit!
sub.description:
Whitebeard begins his attack with a tsunami-spawning sea quake, but the marines counter with a blast of frigid air that turns the tidal wave into an iceberg! Will Luffy and his crew arrive in time to join the battle?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: An All-Consuming Inferno!! Admiral Akainu's Power!
sub.description:
Fire meets ice as mythical warriors, erupting admirals, legendary pirates, and a giant giant go head to head in the biggest, baddest battle of all time! There`s only one thing missing: Monkey D. Luffy!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Descendant of the Beast! Little Oars Jr. - Full Speed Ahead!
sub.description:
A towering giant of a giant known as Little Oars Jr. carves a path of death and destruction as he fights to save Ace. The monstrous mauler is within arm`s reach of his friend when he`s intercepted by the seven warlords of the sea!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Justice For the Winners! Sengoku's Strategy in Action!
sub.description:
In the wake of Little Oars Junior`s tragic defeat, Admiral Sengoku hatches a devious plan to speed up the countdown to Ace`s execution. The situation looks beyond bleak until a hero enters the fray from on high!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Straw Hat Team Arrives! Tension Grows at the Battlefield
sub.description:
Luffy appears on the field of battle with a ferocious sense of urgency. Ace could be executed at any minute, and the rubber-man`s refusal to back down impresses even the most feared men in all the world!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Even If It Means Death! Luffy vs. the Navy; The Battle Starts!
sub.description:
Luffy leaps into action, attacking the Naval forces with a frantic display of brutality. Meanwhile, Ace watches in horror as an army of zombies rises up to attack his brother!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Hard Battles, One After Another! Devil Fruit Users vs. Devil Fruit Users!
sub.description:
Supernatural powers take center stage in the battle to save Ace as Luffy and his uniquely talented allies throw down with the Navy`s own arsenal of Devil Fruit Eaters!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Kuma's Transformation! Ivan-san's Blow of Anger!
sub.description:
A gift from Boa Hancock and Ivan-san`s Galaxy Wink get Luffy closer to Ace than ever, but a sword-wielding foe from the past threatens to derail the rescue mission!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Great Swordsman Mihawk! Luffy Comes Under the Attack of the Black Sword!
sub.description:
Luffy runs into a lethal roadblock in the form of Hawk-Eye Mihawk. The legendary swordsman is determined to halt Luffy`s onslaught, but Ivan-san, Boa Hancock, and Jimbei aren`t ready to give up the fight!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Extermination Strategy in Action! The Power of the Pacifistas!
sub.description:
Luffy and his pirate brethren have their hands full with an ominous army of unbeatable Kumas! While the inhuman minions march onward, Whitebeard encounters a former ally!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Akainu's Plot! Whitebeard Entrapped!
sub.description:
Whitebeard is betrayed - and brutally stabbed - by one of his own men! In the wake of this unthinkable act of treason, allegations about the legendary pirate bring the battle to a halt!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Encircling Walls Activated! The Whitebeard Pirates Backed into a Corner!!
sub.description:
Whitebeard shrugs off his injuries and leads a ferocious charge into the heart of the enemy`s defenses, but three deadly Admirals join forces to silence his shock wave attack as the pirates find themselves surrounded by impenetrable walls!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Execution Order Issued! Break Through the Encircling Walls!
sub.description:
With the ice melting beneath his feet, Luffy begins a desperate final charge towards his soon-to-be-executed brother. Should his rescue attempt fail, death will surely embrace them both!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Moving Into the Final Phase! Whitebeard's Trump Card for Recovery!
sub.description:
Crocodile`s unexpected assistance creates an opening for Luffy to advance, and Whitebeard has a surprise lurking beneath the ice that might swing the momentum in favor of the pirates!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy at the End of his Tether! An All-Out Battle at the Oris Plaza!
sub.description:
The battle rages on and the bodies pile up as Whitebeard squares off against an Admiral, Luffy gets knocked cold, and the legendary Vice-Admiral Garp finally enters the fray!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Power That Will Shorten One's Life! Energy Hormone, Redux!
sub.description:
While awaiting his execution, Ace flashes back to a trouble youth spent seeking the truth about his father. Meanwhile, Luffy begs Ivan for a potentially-deadly treatment that will allow him to continue fighting!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: To Live Up to a Promise! Luffy and Coby Collide!
sub.description:
Luffy makes short work of face from his past, and Whitebeard struggles to withstand the full force of the Marine onslaught. With the executioner`s swords hovering above Ace`s head, Straw Hat Luffy discovers a new ability!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Scaffold at Last! The Way to Ace Has Opened!
sub.description:
Whitebeard orders his men to help Luffy clear a path to the execution scaffold, but someone close to the Rubber-man rises up to derail the rescue mission at the last second!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Each on Different Paths! Luffy vs. Garp!
sub.description:
Luffy must defeat the man who taught him how to fight - his own grandfather - in order to save Ace. Battling his own flesh and blood won`t be easy, but a waxy ally is there to provide back up!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Ace Rescued! Whitebeard's Final Order!
sub.description:
Ace is finally free from the execution scaffold! Luffy and his brother make a fearsome team as they blaze a path toward salvation. Ravaged by the war, Whitebeard wistfully commands his men to make the journey to the New World without him!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Power That Can Burn Even Fire! Akainu's Ruthless Pursuit!
sub.description:
Despite Whitebeard`s order to retreat, Ace is drawn back to the battlefield by the cruel taunts of a Marine adversary. Luffy watches in horror as his brother makes what could be his last stand!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Looking for the Answer! Fire Fist Ace Dies on the Battlefield!
sub.description:
An eerie silence falls over the battlefield as Luffy and Ace share a heartbreaking final moment together. With his dying breath, Ace begs his brother to convey a message to his fellow pirates.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Navy Headquarters Falls! Whitebeard's Unspeakable Wrath!
sub.description:
Anguished cries echo across the battlefield in the wake of Ace`s tragic death. Luffy - paralyzed by grief - must be carried to safety, but Whitebeard summons the strength for one last ferocious attack!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Ending the Matter! Whitebeard vs. The Blackbeard Pirates!
sub.description:
Whitebeard’s children watch in horror as the old man faces off the villainous Blackbeard pirates. Though his injuries are mounting and the odds are stacked against him, Whitebeard never, ever runs away from a fight!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Show Begins! Blackbeard's Plot is Revealed!
sub.description:
The world reacts to Whitebeard`s death with shock and awe. Meanwhile, Jimbei risks his life to save Luffy and Blackbeard reveals the depraved depths of his nefarious nature!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Insatiable Akainu! Lava Fists Pummel Luffy!
sub.description:
While Blackbeard and his men seek to sink Marineford, Jimbei and Luffy`s desperate attempt to flee is thwarted by Akainu`s fiery fists. The situation appears dire until a former enemy lends a sandy hand!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Desperate Scream! Courageous Moments That Will Change the Future
sub.description:
Trafalgar Law and the Heart Pirates offer Luffy a submarine escape route, Blackbeard continues his reckless rampage, and a puny pink-hair marine changes the world with a scream!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Here Comes Shanks! The War of the Best is Finally Over!
sub.description:
The Heart Pirates head for the bottom of the ocean as Trafalgar Law prepares to operate on Luffy and Jimbei. Meanwhile, the arrival of Shanks brings the bloodshed to a sudden halt!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Mighty Leaders Face Each Other Down! Heralding the New Era!
sub.description:
The world rejoices in the wake of Whitebeard`s death, and a host of powerful pirates vie for his position. Meanwhile, Luffy`s friends fear that Ace`s death may be more than the rubber-man can handle - if he ever wakes up!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Landing at the Maiden Island! The Harsh Reality Falls Upon Luffy!
sub.description:
Power-hungry pirates terrorize innocent citizens once protected by Whitebeard, and Luffy`s nightmarish awakening sends him on a reckless rampage that could land him in an early grave!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Strongest Tag-Team! Luffy and Toriko's Hard Struggle!
sub.description:
One Piece X Toriko Crossover
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy and Ace! The Story of How the Brothers Met!
sub.description:
A flashback to the younger days of Luffy and Ace reveals their unusual upbringing under the not-so-watchful eye of villainous mountain bandits!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Here Comes Sabo! The Boy at the Gray Terminal!
sub.description:
The flashback continues as Ace robs a ruthless gang of pirates, and Luffy is left to take the fall! Will Ace and his friend Sabo let Luffy be tortured to death - or will they risk their high seas dreams to save him?!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: I Won't Run! Ace's Desperate Rescue Operation!
sub.description:
Ace and Sabo race to rescue Luffy from the clutches of a murderous gang of pirates! Sabo wants to grab Luffy and make a break for it, but Ace refuses to back down from a fight - even when he`s outnumbered!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: To The Sea Someday! The Pledge of the Three Brats!
sub.description:
When a nobleman recognizes Sabo in the streets, Luffy and Ace learn the painful secret of their friend`s past. As a sign of solidarity, the three boys pledge to become pirates, and hoist a toast to brotherhood!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Leaving the Dadan Family for Good?! The Kids' Hideout Has Been Built!
sub.description:
After another beating from Garp, Luffy and his friends take to the jungle and build a pirate hideout at the top of an enormous tree. First order of business: booby trap the new place!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy Becoming an Apprentice?! A Man Who Fought Against the King of the Pirates!
sub.description:
Luffy and his friends vow to defeat the giant tiger that`s been stealing their food, Ace gets angry when his father`s identity is revealed, and Sabo`s parents hire pirates to track down their son!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Battle against the Big Tiger! Who is Going to be Captain?!
sub.description:
Luffy, Ace, and Sabo take pirate lessons from a mysterious old scallywag who just might know the secret to defeating the big tiger - and becoming a good captian!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Freedom Taken Away! The Nobles' Plot Closing in on the Brothers!
sub.description:
The brothers are captured by a gang of pirates, and Sabo is handed over to his noble father, where the boy quickly discovers a sinister plot to destroy Gray Terminal forever!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Fire Has Been Set! The Gray Terminal in Crisis!
sub.description:
While flames spread across Gray Terminal, Sabo makes a desperate attempt to escape the trappings of his noble birth and save his brothers. Meanwhile, Luffy and Ace must fight to avoid an untimely end!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Where can freedom be found? A Sad Departure of a Boy!
sub.description:
Luffy is spared from a fiery death by an unlikely rescuer, but Ace refuses to leave Gray Terminal until he settles the score with Bluejam. Meanwhile, Sabo makes waves with a last ditch escape attempt!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Take Good Care of Him! A Letter from the Brother!
sub.description:
Luffy and Ace receive troubling reports of a Celestial attack on Sabo`s ship. Ace is eager to seek out the responsible parties and extract revenge, but a letter from his absent brother tempers his eagerness to fight!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: To Live Up to the Promise! Departures of Their Own!
sub.description:
In the wake of Sabo`s death, Luffy and Ace grow stronger than ever by continuing their daily routine of nonstop fighting. As the years pass, each brother prepares to set sail in search of future adventures!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: I Want to See Them! Luffy's Mournful Cry!
sub.description:
Garp takes a beating from a heartbroken mountain bandit, and a big, blue friend helps Luffy drown his despair in the newfound desire to reunite with his mates!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Straw Hats in Shock! The Bad News Has Reached Them!
sub.description:
One by one, the Straw Hats are crushed to learn the tragic fate of Fire Fist Ace. Despite their own unique problems, the crew members` thoughts immediately turn to their crestfallen captain.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Reunited with Dark King Rayleigh! Decision Time for Luffy!
sub.description:
Luffy is determined to reassemble his scattered crew, but a powerful old friend forces him to rethink his plans. Meanwhile, Usopp fights to escape an island that wants to have him for lunch!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Back to Our Captain! A Jail Break at the Sky Island and the Incident on the Winter Island!
sub.description:
Desperate to reach Luffy, Nami risks her life to escape from an island of weather wizards. Meanwhile, Franky rides a carbonation high through the ice and snow in search of a seaworthy vessel!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Encounter! The Great Swordsman Mihawk! Zoro's Self-Willed Deadly Struggle!
sub.description:
Zoro`s escape attempt is thwarted by a gang of sword-slinging baboon bullies, and Brook uses music to end a feud between irate islanders with unequal arms!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Disaster for Sanji! The Queen's Return to the Kingdom!
sub.description:
Chopper hitches a ride on a giant bird, Luffy makes a shocking return to Marineford, and Sanji finds himself fighting the most beautiful man he`s ever seen!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Unexpected Relanding! Luffy, to Marineford!
sub.description:
Luffy, along with Jimbei and Dark King Rayleigh, causes quite the commotion upon his return to Marineford. Meanwhile, powerful pirates all across the globe wreak havoc on the innocent!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: With Hopes It Will Reach My Friends! Big News Spreading Fast!
sub.description:
Luffy hopes to send a message to his mates by way of a clue hidden in a newspaper article. Meanwhile, the Flying Fish Riders protect the Straw Hat`s ship from scandalous scavengers!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Pirates Get on the Move! Astounding New World!
sub.description:
Trafalgar Law waits for the right moment to make his move, Blackbeard is pursued by powerful marines, and Chopper makes a surprising return to the land of gargantuan birds!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Living through Hell! Sanji's Fight for His Manhood!
sub.description:
Nami uses her feminine charms to learn about the New World weather, Franky moves into Dr. Vegapunk`s laboratory, and Sanji must fight to stay out of a cute dress!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: I Will Get Much, Much Stronger! Zoro's Pledge to his Captain!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats continue preparations for their voyage to the New World as Robin heads for a meeting with the Revolutionary Dragon, Usopp aspires to become King of the Snipers, and Zoro begs his mortal enemy to train him!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy's Training Begins! To the Place We Promised in 2 Years!
sub.description:
Dark King Rayleigh takes Luffy to a deadly, deserted island for two years of intense battle training! If the Straw Hat captain wants to survive in the New World, he`ll have to hone his hidden powers!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Beginning of The New Chapter! The Straw Hats Reunited!
sub.description:
After two years of rigorous training, the new and improved Straw Hats make their way to Sabaody Archipelago, but their long-awaited reunion is spoiled by a villainous gang of imposters!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: An Explosive Situation! Luffy vs. Fake Luffy!
sub.description:
Luffy picks a fight with himself, Chopper falls in with a dubious crowd of imitation pirates, and Zoro causes a commotion when he falls asleep on the wrong ship!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Navy Has Set Out! The Straw Hats in Danger!
sub.description:
Chopper struggles to make sense of the changes his "friends" have undergone in the last two years, and the Navy mobilizes in an attempt to stop the pirate posers. Will the real Straw Hats please stand up?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Big Guns Assembled! The Danger of the Fake Straw Hats!
sub.description:
Chopper and Usopp flip over Franky`s new body, Brook must choose between rock-n-roll stardom and the life of a pirate, and Luffy wanders into a very dangerous crowd!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Battle is on! Show Them What You Got From Training!
sub.description:
While the rest of the Straw Hats prepare to set sail, Luffy gets a chance to show off his new powers in a brutal throw down between notorious pirates, navy soldiers, and deadly Pacifistas!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Everyone Together! Luffy, Setting Out for the New World!
sub.description:
Luffy and his crew are finally reunited, but before they can set sail, they`ll need help from Dark King Rayleigh, Boa Hancock, and all the friends they`ve made in the last two years!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Surprising Fact! The Man Who Guarded the Sunny!
sub.description:
As word of the Straw Hat resurrection spreads through the Navy, Luffy and his crew get acclimated to their underwater environment, and Franky reveals the startling identity of the man who protected their ship!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Deadly Combat under the Sea! The Demon of the Ocean Strikes!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats are attacked by a rival gang of pirates, but that may be the least of their worries. Luffy and his crew are on a collision course with a cantankerous Kraken!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Lost in the Deep Sea! The Straw Hats Get Separated!
sub.description:
After their quarrel with the Kraken, the Straw Hats find themselves in hot water as Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji turn up missing, and the rest of the crew runs short on air!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Undersea Volcanic Eruption! Drifting to the Fish-Man Island!
sub.description:
Thanks to a little help from a friend, Luffy saves his mates from a ghost ship captained by a deranged Dutchman! Unfortunately, their happy reunion is cut short by a volcanic eruption! Can the Hats take the heat?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Landing at the Fish-Man Island! Beautiful Mermaids!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats finally make it to Fish-Man Island, but their reputation precedes them, leading to trouble with the New Fish-Man Pirates! Only a daring maneuver can get them out of hot water, but there`s no guarantee they`ll survive!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Excitement Blow-out! Sanji's Life Under Threat!
sub.description:
When Sanji gets up close and personal with a mesmerizing mermaid, his extreme fondness for the female form lands him in a life and death situation. Could the Straw Hat chef die from a nosebleed?!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Fish-Man Island Will Be Annihilated?! Sharley's Prophecy!
sub.description:
After two generous donors save Sanji from death by nosebleed, Luffy and Usopp take a tour of the island. But their welcome is worn out when a mystic mermaid has a terrifying vision - that Fish-Man Island will be destroyed at the hands of a Straw Hat!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The King of the Fish-Man Island! Neptune, the God of the Sea!
sub.description:
After reuniting with Nami, Luffy and the gang are invited to the royal palace of Neptune, god of the sea! Meanwhile, the New Fish-Man Pirates exploit the power of a designer steroid in order to terrorize humans!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Ryugu Palace! Taken by the Shark that They Saved!
sub.description:
A trio of unsuspecting mermaids find themselves in hot water after releasing a bad guy from his barrel of a prison. Over at the royal palace, Luffy gets up close and personal with the Mermaid Princess!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Coward and a Crybaby! The Princess in the Hard Shell Tower!
sub.description:
Luffy`s lightning reflexes spare the Mermaid Princess from a grisly death, Neptune`s army attempts to apprehend the Straw Hats, and Captain Vander Decken forges a sinister undersea alliance!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: It's an Emergency! The Ryugu Palace is Occupied!
sub.description:
With their backs against the wall, the Straw Hats are forced to take King Neptune and his men hostage. On the other side of the palace, Luffy and the Mermaid Princess make plans to visit the Sea Forrest!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Ryugu Palace in Shock! The Kidnapping of Shirahoshi!
sub.description:
Luffy accidentally "kidnaps" the Mermaid Princess, an old friend issues a grave warning to Chopper and Sanji, and the New Fish-Man Pirates prepare for a raid on Ryugu Palace!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Hordy's Onslaught! The Retaliatory Plan Set Into Motion!
sub.description:
Captain Vander Decken and Hordy Jones manage to successfully breach the defenses of Ryugu Palace. Meanwhile, Jimbei waits patiently for Luffy to arrive at the Sea Forest.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Battle in the Ryugu Palace! Zoro vs. Hordy!
sub.description:
Robin ventures into the forest in search of ancient secrets, Zoro takes to the water for a slicing, dicing showdown with Hordy Jones, and Luffy is branded a royal kidnapper by an angry mob of fish folk!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Keep Shirahoshi Safe! Decken Close Behind!
sub.description:
Luffy, Chopper, and Sanji are taken prisoner by a fish mob just as Vander Decken launches an attack the princess! Elsewhere, Zoro continues his battle with Hordy, and Nami hitches a ride on a mermaid to escape the crumbling palace!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Straw Hats Defeated?! Hordy Gains Control of the Ryugu Palace!
sub.description:
Zoro and Neptune fight bravely, but they`re no match for Hordy and his pill-popping minions. Back at the ship, Luffy reunites with Jimbei, who reveals something sinister about his past.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Haunting Ties! Nami and the Fish-Man Pirates!
sub.description:
The New Fish-Man Pirates continue their bloody and violent uprising, and Jimbei begins the story of how he unleashed the monster known as Arlong on the unsuspecting citizens of the East Blue.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Hero Who Freed the Slaves! An Adventurer Tiger!
sub.description:
Jimbei continues his story with tales of fish-men taken as slaves, Queen Otohime`s fierce devotion to her people, the legend of Fisher Tiger, and the sinister rise of Arlong.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Kizaru Appears! A Trap to Catch Tiger!
sub.description:
Arlong`s violent tendencies are condemned by Fisher Tiger, and the arrival of a young human girl teaches the Fish-Man Pirates a lesson in compassion.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Team is Formed! Save Chopper
sub.description:
One Piece X Toriko Crossover
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Death of a Hero! A Shocking Truth of Tiger!
sub.description:
The great pirate Fisher Tiger keeps his promise to a young slave girl, but the adults in her village are determined to make him pay for his act of honor.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Sun Pirates Split! Jimbei vs Arlong!
sub.description:
In the wake of Fisher Tiger`s tragic death, the once-mighty Sun Pirates are splintered by an ongoing quarrel between Jimbei and Arlong. Meanwhile, Queen Otohime`s ceasless quest to help her people begins to take its toll.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Shaking Fish-Man Island! A Celestial Dragon Drifts In!
sub.description:
Tensions run high when a slave-owning Celestial Dragon washes up on Fish-Man Island. His former captives cry for out for blood, but Queen Otohime sees it as a chance to mend fences between the gilled and non-gilled!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Sudden Tragedy! A Gunshot Shuts Down the Future!
sub.description:
After an agonizing absence, Queen Otohime returns to her people with exciting news. Unfortunately, a horrific act of violence derails the queen`s mission and changes life on Fish-Man Island forever.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Back to the Present! Hordy Makes a Move!
sub.description:
Jimbei reaches the heartbreaking conclusion in the story of Queen Otohime, Nami does something completely unexpected, and Hordy Jones makes a foreboding appearance!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Kingdom Quivers - Neptune's Execution Command
sub.description:
Hordy announces his sinister plans for Fish-Man Island. Luffy and Shirahoshi are ready to fight, but Jimbei wants to wage this war on his own!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Rift Opens Up! Luffy vs. Jimbei!
sub.description:
Luffy and Jimbei come to blows over how to handle Hordy`s uprising. Back at the palace, Brook embarks on an out of body experience with hopes of saving his mates!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Something Has Happened to Hordy! The True Power of the Evil Drug!
sub.description:
Jimbei and Luffy continue their standoff, the New Fish-Man pirates go on a rampage, and Hordy begins to experience startling side effects from his pill-popping habit!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Battle is on! At Conchcorde Plaza!
sub.description:
Hordy`s rampant use of the energy steroid makes him bigger, stronger, and scarier than ever before! The Fish-Man princes join the battle, but even they may not be strong enough to stop Hordy`s onslaught!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Surprising Confession! The Truth Behind the Assassination of Otohime!
sub.description:
Jimbei and Shirahoshi are captured by the enemy, and Hordy makes a shocking revelation to the population of Fish-Man Island!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Shirahoshi's Tears! Luffy Finally Shows Up!
sub.description:
Shirahoshi reveals that she knew the truth about her mother`s murder all along, and Luffy makes a bone-crushing entrance when the princess needs him most!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Great Clash! The Straw Hat Crew vs. 100,000 Enemies
sub.description:
Hordy announces his plan for turning humans into slaves, the people of Fish-Man Island throw their support behind a new champion, and Luffy amazes even his own friends!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Deadly Attacks One After Another! Zoro and Sanji Join The Battle!
sub.description:
Luffy and the gang show off how much stronger they`ve become by issuing a brutal beat down to Hordy and his ferocious Fish-Man Pirates! Can anything stop the Hats?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Unveiled! The Secret Weapons of the Sunny!
sub.description:
Hordy`s men keep attacking, but the Straw Hats have new weapons at their disposal! Franky unleashes the fury of the Black Rhino, and Luffy turns the tables on Hordy with a little help from his Kraken!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Iron Pirate! Here Comes General Franky!
sub.description:
Franky dazzles Usopp and Chopper by transforming into a gigantic fighting robot, Hordy tries to blackmail the Kraken, and Luffy introduces his fist to the Fish-man`s face!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Noah Closing in! The Fish-Man Island Facing Destruction!
sub.description:
Luffy shows off even more new powers as he brutally pummels Hordy, but the main attraction proves to be an ancient and immense pirate ship that`s heading straight for Fish-Man Island!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Hurry up, Luffy! Shirahoshi's Life in Jeopardy!
sub.description:
Shirahoshi summons the courage to risk everything to save her world, Luffy puts his own life in peril by venturing into the ocean, and Hordy`s devious nature fully comes to the surface.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Fierce Fight Begins! Luffy vs. Hordy!
sub.description:
Luffy sets the stage for a final battle with Hordy, Sanji kicks a giant in defense of Nami`s honor, and Zoro puts his blades to the ultimate test against a steroid-powered fighting fish!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Massive Confused Fight! The Straw Hats vs. the New Fish-Man Pirates!
sub.description:
While Luffy and Shirahoshi try to prevent Fish-Man Island from being crushed, the rest of the Straw Hats square off against the meanest Fish-Man Pirates in the deep blue sea!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy Loses the Fight?! Hordy's Long Awaited Revenge!
sub.description:
Luffy is the only one who can stop Hordy, but he`ll need air to survive the fight, so Shirahoshi`s big brother risks his own life in heroic attempt to get Luffy a bigger bubble!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Shocking Fact! The True Identity of Hordy!
sub.description:
While the rest of the Straw Hats continue to fight bravely, Luffy tries to find a way to save the island, and the horrible truth about Hordy`s hatred for humans is finally revealed!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Back to Zero! Earnest Wishes for Luffy!
sub.description:
Hordy`s twisted past takes center stage in a Fish-Man flashback. Meanwhile, Shirahoshi`s brother begs Luffy to save his beloved homeland and wipe out the anti-human element!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy's All-Out Attack! Red Hawk Blasts!
sub.description:
Luffy`s fist of fire puts Hordy down for the count, and the rest of the Straw Hats try to make short work of the remaining Fish-Man Pirates. Meanwhile, a very big boat looms overhead!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Coming To An End! The Final Decisive Battle Against Hordy!
sub.description:
While the rest of the Straw Hats try to make short work of their enemies, Luffy summons the strength for one last brutal attack on Hordy. Now, about that giant boat...
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Stop, Noah! Desperate Elephant Gatling!
sub.description:
After defeating Hordy, Luffy turns his attention to stopping the Noah from crushing Fish-Man Island. Straw Hats and Fish-Men alike watch as Luffy tries to obliterate a boat with a barrage of brutal blows!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: To the Future! The Path to the Sun!
sub.description:
Fish-Man Island was saved by the timely arrival of the Sea Kings, but all is not well. Luffy lost a lot of blood in his battle with Hordy, and fish-to-human transfusions are strictly forbidden!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Secret Revealed! The Truth about the Ancient Weapon!
sub.description:
Jimbei must decide whether or not to join the Straw Hats, and the grateful citizens of Fish-Man Island host a fabulous banquet in honor of their human heroes!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Straw Hats Stunned! The New Fleet Admiral of the Navy!
sub.description:
Luffy and his crew learn of epic battle between Aokiji and Akainu, a forgotten foe tries to kidnap the mermaid princess, and Hordy`s gang finally gets what`s coming to them!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: She Loves Sweets! Big Mom of the Four Emperors!
sub.description:
When Luffy, Zoro, and Sanji stumble upon a couple of Big Mam`s henchmen extorting sweets from the peaceful people of Fish-Man Island, the Straw Hats make a new - and very powerful - enemy!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Many Problems Lie Ahead! A Trap Awaiting in the New World!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats prepare to depart Fish-Man Island, a lion and a caribou come to blows over booby-trapped treasure, and Vice Admiral Smoker makes his presence felt in the New World!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Finally Time to Go! Goodbye, Fish-Man Island!
sub.description:
Luffy and his crew bid farewell to their new friends before setting off in search of the greatest adventures the New World has to offer!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: To the New World! Heading for the Ultimate Sea!
sub.description:
Luffy and Usopp’s extreme deep sea fishing adventure lands the crew in the middle of a deadly whirlpool, but an unexpected encounter with a pod of giant whales may bail the Straw Hats out of hot water!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Z's Ambition! Lily the Little Giant!
sub.description:
Luffy`s arrival in the New World is marked by violent weather and the discovery of a tiny stowaway. When the Straw Hats agree to help their new friend, it could lead to big trouble with the Marines!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Z's Ambition! A Dark and Powerful Army!
sub.description:
Nami hatches a plan to save Lily`s father, but the arrival of an ex-marine madman throws a monkey wrench into the rescue mission.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Z's Ambition! A Great and Desperate Escape Plan!
sub.description:
Luffy and Zoro find themselves locked in battle with their latest foes, but Nami`s knowledge of the sea may be the key to escaping this scrum alive!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Z's Ambition! Luffy vs. Shuzo!
sub.description:
Shuzo`s squad of manned torpedoes targets the Straw Hats and the giants! The crazed captain tests Luffy`s mettle in a showdown on land, but the wily pirate pulls off a supersized surprise in hopes to stomp out the madman for good.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Arriving! A Burning Island - Punk Hazard!
sub.description:
A desperate cry for help leads the Straw Hats to Punk Hazard, an island engulfed in flames and inhabited by a mythic beast that could make short work of Luffy and the gang!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Battle in the Heat! Luffy vs. The Giant Dragon!
sub.description:
Luffy and Zoro put their strength to the ultimate test in a battle with a dragon. Meanwhile, a band of mysterious intruders make their gassy presence felt aboard the Sunny!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Straw Hats Stunned! Enter: A Samurai's Horrifying Severed Head!
sub.description:
Luffy gets up close and personal with a torso-less Samurai! Elsewhere, Nami, Sanji, Chopper, and Franky find themselves imprisoned with the pieces of a human face!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Startling! The Secret of the Island is Finally Revealed!
sub.description:
Luffy makes friends with a Centaur, Franky uses a cola-powered laser to break out of the clink, and Sanji takes a chance on a body-less Samurai!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Save the Children! The Straw Hats Start to Fight!
sub.description:
Nami`s soft spot for children prompts her to call off the escape and declare war on anyone who makes a kid cry. Meanwhile, Luffy and the gang take a banana boat to the icy side of the island!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Swordplay Showdown! Brook vs. the Mysterious Torso Samurai!
sub.description:
Luffy`s group finds themselves up against a gang of centaurs, Brook battles the torso of a surly samurai, and Captain Smoker encounters someone highly unexpected!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Warlord! Trafalgar Law!
sub.description:
Nami and Chopper seek a safe exit for the children, Luffy`s group hopes to avoid a perilous plunge into icy waters, and Captain Smoker faces off against Trafalgar Law!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: In a Real Pinch! Luffy Sinks into the Ice-cold Lake!
sub.description:
Luffy`s group takes a deadly plunge into icy waters, and Trafalgar Law uses his unique abilities to rearrange Nami`s group and cast our heroes into chaotic confusion!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Collision! Law vs. Vice Admiral Smoker!
sub.description:
While Luffy and his mates race toward a reunion, Admiral Smoker struggles to survive a heart-stopping showdown with Trafalgar Law!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Meeting Again After Two Years! Luffy and Law!
sub.description:
Luffy is excited to once again cross paths with Trafalgar Law, but a reunion with his mixed up crew - and the loss of his extra legs - quickly dampens the captain`s enthusiasm!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Worst in the World! A Scientist of Terror - Caesar!
sub.description:
While Captain Smoker determines his next move, a very large pirate with alligator legs tells Luffy and the Straw Hats the true story of Punk Hazard`s mysterious transformation!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: History's Strongest Collaboration vs. Glutton of the Sea
sub.description:
Featured characters of One Piece, Toriko and Dragon Ball enter the IGO tournament in order to gain the Carat meat, which is said to be the most tasteful in the world. However, it leads in a tie between Goku, Toriko and Luffy. Meanwhile, Zoro, Zebra and Vegeta meet accidentally in a remote part of the race, and start fighting.
Source: http://onepiece.fandom.com/

sub.title: Chopper's Fury! The Master's Inhumane Experiment!
sub.description:
The giant children fly into a mysterious rage, and Chopper discovers the true reason for their unusual condition! Meanwhile, Zoro, Brook, and Sanji cross paths with a dangerous duo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: To Annihilate the Straw Hats! Legendary Assassins Descend!
sub.description:
The story of how Trafalgar Law arrived at Punk Hazard is revealed, and the Yeti Cool Brothers set their sights on a showdown with the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Save Nami! Luffy's Fight on the Snow-Capped Mountains!
sub.description:
Luffy tries to chase down the Yetti Cool Brothers, but Franky`s still trapped in Chopper`s Body makes his mission extremely difficult. Just when all appears lost, an unexpected ally lends a hand!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Formed! Luffy and Law's Pirate Alliance!
sub.description:
Luffy agrees to an alliance with Trafalgar Law, but the Straw Hats refuse to leave the island until the children are safe. Meanwhile, the gaseous master unleashes something very deadly!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Capture M! The Pirate Alliance's Operation Launches!
sub.description:
Zoro, Sanji, and Brook continue their search for the samurai, Trafalgar tries to sneak Chopper into the laboratory, and Luffy boldly challenges the Master!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: On the Verge of Annihilation! A Deadly Monster Comes Flying In!
sub.description:
Luffy`s battle with his old nemesis Smoker is interrupted by the arrival of a terrifying toxic blob - and the evil genius who created the monster!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: An Intense Battle! Caesar Exercises His True Power!
sub.description:
Sanji puts Nami`s beautiful body at risk to save the torso of a Samurai, and Luffy appears to have gained the upper hand in his battle with Ceasar - until the gas bag unleashes something sinister!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Samurai Who Can Cut Fire! Foxfire Kin'emon!
sub.description:
Trafalgar Law finds trouble in the form of an old acquaintance, Chopper investigates the Master`s lab, and the mysterious Samurai shows what he can do with a full body!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Shocking! The True Identity of the Mystery Man Vergo!
sub.description:
The Master gathers his young test subjects, shocking secret identities are finally revealed, and the poisonous purple blob continues its march across the island!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Save the Children! The Master's Evil Hands Close in!
sub.description:
Nami and Usopp get an unexpected helping hand in their fight to save the children, Chopper plots a daring escape attempt, and the Master markets his greatest weapon!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Shaking Up the New World! Caesar`s Horrendous Experiment!
sub.description:
A desperate need for candy leads the children to return to the lab, and Caesar plans to show the world the new and improved version of Smiley!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Deadliest Weapon of Mass Destruction in History! Shinokuni!
sub.description:
Luffy and the Straw Hats find themselves pursued by a deadly cloud of purple gas that turns everything living thing in its path into petrified statues of ash!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Launching the Counter Attack! Luffy and Law`s Great Escape!
sub.description:
Law`s got a trick up his sleeve that could mean the difference between life and death. Zoro and company reunite with Nami and Sanji, but can they reach safety before being swallowed by a poisonous cloud!?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Get to Building R! The Pirate Alliance`s Great Advance!
sub.description:
Finally reunited and returned to their proper bodies, the Straw Hats fall in line as Luffy and Law lead the charge to settle the score with Caesar - and save the children!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Tashigi`s Tears! G-5`s Desperate Breakthrough Plan!
sub.description:
Caesar hatches a plan to forever silence his enemies, Chopper races through the compound in search of the drugged children, and Tashigi`s men make the ultimate sacrifice!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Treacherous Vice Admiral! Demon Bamboo Vergo!
sub.description:
Luffy races toward Caesar in the hopes of delivering a beating, Sanji saves a damsel in distress, and Chopper tries to prevent the children from eating the drugged candy!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Fierce Battle Gets Heated! Luffy vs. Caesar!
sub.description:
Sanji and Vergo slug it out in a cloud of toxic gas, Law finds the room that could ruin the New World, and Luffy hopes to bring Caesar`s reign of terror to a brutal end!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Mastermind Underground! Doflamingo Makes His Move!
sub.description:
Doflamingo orders Vergo to stop Law in his tracks, Luffy battles a deadly snowbird, and the rest of the Straw Hats attempt to survive the fiery breath of an angry dragon!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy Dies from Exposure?! The Spine-chilling Snow Woman Monet!
sub.description:
Luffy goes down fast after Monet puts a chill into him, and Trafalgar Law makes a desperate attempt to reclaim his heart during an electric battle with Vergo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Fists Collide! A Battle of the Two Vice Admirals!
sub.description:
Smoker attacks Vergo for assaulting his men, Luffy meets something strange in the trash heap, and a flashback reveals the true depths of Caesar`s madness!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Small Dragon! Momonosuke Appears!
sub.description:
Luffy befriends a dragon that used to be a human boy, and Captain Smoker continues his brutal battle with the villainous Vergo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Deadly Fight in a Blizzard! The Straw Hats vs. the Snow Woman!
sub.description:
Luffy hitches a ride on a dragon, Mocha tries to keep the Master`s candy away from her friends, and Zoro pits his steel against snow in a battle with Monet!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Showing Off His Techniques! Zoro`s Formidable One-Sword Style!
sub.description:
To survive his battle with Monet, Zoro must overcome his unwillingness to cut a woman. Elsewhere, Luffy puts a hungry dragon on his back and tries to punch his way out of the basement!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: To Save Her Friends! Mocha Runs at the Risk of Her Life!
sub.description:
Chopper, Nami, and Robin watch in horror as Mocha makes a heartbreaking sacrifice in a courageous attempt to save the lives of her friends!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Brownbeard in Grief! Luffy Lands a Furious Blow!
sub.description:
Brownbeard heroically attempts to expose Caesar as a villain, the horrific truth about Punk Hazard is finally revealed, and Luffy puts the hurt on his gaseous enemy!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Surprising Outcome! White Chase vs. Vergo!
sub.description:
Luffy makes Caesar pay for his crimes against the children, and Smoker risks his life for a chance to see Vergo fall in battle!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Caesar`s Defeat! The Powerful Grizzly Magnum!
sub.description:
Law reaches the end of his epic battle with Vergo, and Luffy looks to land a devastating final blow on the murderous gasbag Caesar!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Raid! An Assassin from Dressrosa!
sub.description:
Word of Luffy and Law`s alliance spreads throughout the world, Chopper and Brook race to stay ahead of the deadly gas, and Joker sends a team to rescue Caesar!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Running Wild! Invincible General Franky!
sub.description:
Franky battles a lethal beauty, Caesar tries to strike a final blow against Smoker, and Monet detonates an explosive surprise that could spell doom for the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Critical Situation! Punk Hazard Explodes!
sub.description:
As the Straw Hats and company flee the crumbling laboratory, Caesar`s desperate act of vengeance thwarts Joker`s plan to forever silence his enemies!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Capture Caesar! General Cannon Blast!
sub.description:
Franky continues his battle with Buffalo and Baby 5, Nami uses a mighty gust of wind to save the children from a deadly cloud of gas, and Usopp takes a shot at capturing Caesar!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Touching Reunion! Momonosuke and Kin`emon!
sub.description:
A dragon regains his boyish form, a noble warrior once feared dead makes a shocking resurrection, and bitter enemies set aside their differences to enjoy a well-deserved feast!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: It`s Time to Say Goodbye! Leaving Punk Hazard!
sub.description:
The weary marines and the rescued children get teary-eyed as they say goodbye to the Straw Hats. Meanwhile, Law enters into treacherous negotiations with Joker!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The G-5 Wiped Out! Doflamingo`s Sudden Attack!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats set a course for Dressrosa, Law explains his alliance with Luffy, and Smoker`s refusal to reveal a secret earns him a serious beating from Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Intense! Aokiji vs. Doflamingo!
sub.description:
Smoker`s life is spared by the arrival of an old friend. Law reveals some shocking news about Caesar`s partnership with Doflamingo, and Momonosuke uses his youth to get cozy with Robin and Nami!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Caesar Goes Missing! The Pirate Alliance Makes a Sortie!
sub.description:
Smooth seas stretch out before the Straw Hats as they leave Punk Hazard far behind. While they fear Donflamingo`s return and prepare to face him, another powerful foe lies in wait - one whose power could be their downfall!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy Dies at Sea?! The Pirate Alliance Comes Apart!
sub.description:
Breed uses his evil abilities to turn Chopper into a pet - and force Luffy and Law to fight to the death.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Major Turnaround! Luffy`s Angry Iron Fist Strikes!
sub.description:
After Law discovers the secret to Breed`s power, Luffy and his old friend the Kung Fu Dugong give the animal-abusing madman a beasty beat down!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Startling! The Big News Shakes Up the New World!
sub.description:
As the world reacts to Doflamingo`s shocking announcement, Law and the Straw Hats plot the next move in their daring alliance, and a face from the past returns!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Explore! A Kingdom of Love and Passion: Dressrosa!
sub.description:
The Straw Hats and their friends set out to explore Dressrosa, a land full of beautiful women, delicious food, and live toys that walk amongst the living.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Full of Enthusiasm! The Corrida Colosseum!
sub.description:
A blind warrior lays a beat down on a gang of masked thugs, Zorro chases the thief who stole his sword, and Luffy finds himself tempted by the promise of a fiery fruit!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Dangerous Love! The Dancer Girl: Violet!
sub.description:
Zoro continues his hunt for the fairy who stole his sword, Sanji is smitten by a beautiful dancer, and Luffy prepares to fight for the Devil Fruit that belonged to his brother!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Formidable, Unknown Warrior! Here Comes Lucy!
sub.description:
Sanji falls further under the spell of his new lady friend, and Luffy makes quite an impression as he gets to know the fighters competing for Ace`s Devil Fruit.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Pirate Noble! Cavendish!
sub.description:
A gorgeous gladiator tells Luffy the story of the world`s greatest warrior, a masked mauler literally destroys the competition, and the Navy makes its presence felt!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Fateful Reunion! Bellamy the Hyena!
sub.description:
An old nemesis sees through Luffy`s disguise, Zoro finally catches up to the sword-stealing fairy, and Sanji`s skill at sniffing out snipers impresses his new lady friend!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Super Rookie! Bartolomeo the Cannibal!
sub.description:
Bartolomeo and Bellamy take center stage in the latest round of the battle royal, but a slugger with a serious punch threatens to steal their thunder. Meanwhile, Luffy is targeted by an angry behemoth!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Big Names Duke It Out! The Heated Block B Battle!
sub.description:
An old enemy of Garp`s reveals Luffy`s true identity, landing the Straw Hat captain in hot water with one of his fellow competitors. Meanwhile, the battle in Block B gets supremely brutal!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Deadly Blow! The Astonishing King Punch!
sub.description:
Franky`s new robot friend promises to reveal the tragic secrets of Dressrosa, and a regal brawler prepares to throw a powerful punch that could destroy the entire colosseum!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Fishing Fish Strike! Across the Deadly Iron Bridge!
sub.description:
While Law, Robin, Usopp, and Caesar attempt to survive a Fighting Fish attack, Sanji learns the heartbreaking truth about the beautiful woman who stole his heart!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Explore! Fairies` Island - Green Bit!
sub.description:
Luffy`s turn to fight in the epic colosseum battle draws near, Zoro has an interesting encounter with a surprisingly strong fairy, and the thoughts in Sanji`s head shock his lady captor!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Unknown World! The Tontatta Kingdom!
sub.description:
Sanji learns some disturbing news that could mean trouble for his friends, Luffy prepares for a fight, and Robin is captured by a village full of little people!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Stratagem of the Century! Doflamingo Makes His Move!
sub.description:
Despite Sanji`s attempt to warn him, Law finds his life in danger after being ambushed by Doflamingo. Meanwhile, Luffy is unable to hide his true identity once the fists start flying!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Shaking Heaven and Earth! Admiral Fujitora`s Power!
sub.description:
After his plan falls apart, Law must fight for his life against two powerful opponents. Elsewhere, Sanji bids a touching goodbye to his special lady friend, and Luffy tangles with Brutal Bull!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Blow of Anger! A Giant vs. Lucy!
sub.description:
Nami, Chopper, and Brook are grotesquely transformed by a hideous woman who fancies herself an artist. Back at the colosseum, Luffy gets serious when his new friend falls victim to a giant attack!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Destruction Cannon Blasts! Lucy in Trouble!
sub.description:
Zoro and his fairy friend argue over directions, Trafalgar Law finds himself outnumbered in his battle with Doflamingo, and Luffy`s latest opponent packs an explosive punch!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Legendary Pirate! Don Chinjao!
sub.description:
While Nami, Chopper, and Brook attempt to take back the Sunny, Luffy and the monstrous mauler Don Chinjao take their brutal grudge match to a legendary level!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Light and Shadow! Darkness Behind Dressrosa!
sub.description:
Luffy`s battle with Don Chinjao heats up, Franky learns the tragic truth behind Dressrosa`s mysterious toy population, and Robin and Usopp prepare to join their little friends in battle!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Making a Sortie! The Legendary Hero Usoland!
sub.description:
Luffy continues his battle with Don Chinjao, Franky and Zoro are reunited in the land of the little people, and Law is wounded in a revealing, face-to-face showdown with Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Fierce Battle Coming to the End! Lucy vs. Chinjao!
sub.description:
A flashback reveals the story of how Garp changed Chinjao`s world forever. Back in the present, Luffy and his opponent trade ferocious blows that literally rock the colosseum!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy and the Gladiator of Fate: Rebecca!
sub.description:
During a break between battles, Luffy is attacked by an angry rival, but a beautiful gladiator with mysterious motives offers him food - and a place to rest.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Protect You to the End! Rebecca and the Toy Soldier!
sub.description:
In the moments before battle, the beautiful gladiator Rebecca flashes back to the tragic events of her childhood and the toy soldier who became her constant companion.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Last - and Bloodiest - Block! Block D Battle Begins!
sub.description:
The bloodthirsty crowd hurls insults at Rebecca as the battle of Block D begins. On the other side of the island, Law finds himself on the losing end of his battle with Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Decisive Battle! Giolla vs. the Straw Hats!
sub.description:
Brook`s trickery springs the Straw Hats from their artistic prison, but their failure to cuff the culprit means they`ll need help from a cola-powered cannon to emerge victorious!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Beautiful Sword! Cavendish of the White Horse!
sub.description:
Cavendish wins over the female fans during the Block D battle, Luffy keeps an eye on Rebecca, and Sanji heads toward a heated collision with Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Big Clash! Sanji vs. Doflamingo!
sub.description:
Sanji`s battle with Doflamingo is interrupted by Law`s sudden arrival, and Rebecca continues her impressive showing in the battle of Block D!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Rebecca`s Special Attack! Back-to-the-Water Dance!
sub.description:
Law begins a deadly, face-to-face battle with Doflamingo, Zoro enlists the aid of a star struck gladiator, and Rebecca continues to impresses Luffy with her unique fighting style!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Most Violent Fighter! Logan vs. Rebecca!
sub.description:
Luffy learns the truth about life in Dressrosa under Doflamingo`s reign. Meanwhile, Rebecca needs help from a friend to survive her bone-crushing battle with Logan!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Big Surprise! A True Identity of the Toy Soldier!
sub.description:
Rebecca`s battle continues, a madman turns a gladiator into a play thing, and the brave little toy soldier reveals his painful past – and the tragic truth behind King Riku`s fall from power!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Horrible Past! The Secret of Dressrosa!
sub.description:
Luffy learns the truth about life in Dressrosa under Doflamingo`s reign. Meanwhile, Rebecca needs help from a friend to survive her bone-crushing battle with Logan!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Nightmare! The Tragic Night of Dressrosa!
sub.description:
Rebecca continues her valiant stand in the arena of battle, Luffy is reunited with Zoro, and the heartbreaking story of how Doflamingo conquered Dressrosa continues!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Showdown Between the Warlords! Law vs. Doflamingo!
sub.description:
Law`s power begins to fade, making him an easy target for Doflamingo`s vicious attacks. Meanwhile, Franky begs Luffy to let him fight alongside Soldier and the little people!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Two Great Rivals Meet Each Other! Straw Hat and Heavenly Demon!
sub.description:
Luffy sets his sights on a showdown with Doflamingo in a desperate attempt to save Law`s life. Sanji, Nami, Chopper, and Brook are attacked by a very deadly foe!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Luffy Astonished! The Man Who Inherits Ace`s Will!
sub.description:
Soldier reveals his daring plan to return all the toys to their human forms, and Luffy has an emotional encounter with someone from his very distant past!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Operation SOP Starts! Usoland Charges Forth!
sub.description:
Usopp and Robin join the little people on their mission to turn the toys back into humans, Franky wreaks havoc at the toy house, and Rebecca continues her gladiator battle!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Burning Passion! Rebecca vs. Suleiman!
sub.description:
Zoro attracts unwanted attention by upsetting a child, Soldier risks his life to lead the attack on Doflamingo, and Rebecca struggles to survive the brutal battle of Block D!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The End of the Match?! A Surprising Result of Block D!
sub.description:
Rebecca survives an encounter with an opponent`s deadly alter ego, Franky continues his battle with a man who dresses like a baby, and Violet offers to sneak Luffy into the palace!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Admiral`s Decision! Fujitora vs. Doflamingo!
sub.description:
Franky has his hands full battling a host of enemies at the Toy House, Violet leads Luffy to a secret entrance into the palace, and Fujitora issues Doflamingo a grave warning!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Final Round Starts! Diamante the Hero Shows Up!
sub.description:
Diamante`s unique abilities and the presence of special Fighting Fish add a deadly wrinkle to the tournament`s final round. Elsewhere, Luffy spoils any chance of sneaking up on Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Moving Castle! The Top Executive Pica Rises Up!
sub.description:
Luffy tangles with a monster made of stone, Franky bursts into flames after getting shot by a cannon, and the courageous little people hatch a plan to turn the toys back into humans!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Dragon Claw Strikes! Lucy`s Intimidating Attack!
sub.description:
Soldier takes a beating from a Doflamingo Family Executive, Lucy shows off a powerful new fighting style, and Zoro pushes his blades to the breaking point in a showdown with a man made of stone!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Defeat Sugar! The Army of the Little People Charges!
sub.description:
Zoro repeatedly slices his stone opponent into pieces, but he can`t find a way to make the bad guy stay down. Meanwhile, the bravery of the little people could get them turned into toys!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Last Light of Hope! The Secret of Our Commander!
sub.description:
The Tontattas are devastated by Trebol’s furious attack, but as Usopp tries to convince Leo to abort the operation, Leo tells him about their commander Toy Soldier’s stunning true identity! Meanwhile, with the help of another Tontatta group, the Toy Soldier finally shakes off Lao G and gets moving again!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Rupture Human! Gladius Blows Up Big Time!
sub.description:
Zoro continues his deadly duel with the nearly-indestructible Pica! While the Toy Soldier narrowly escapes Lao G only to come face to face with Gladius! Luffy continues his mad dash to the top of the palace to face Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Liar! Usoland on the Run!
sub.description:
With the Tontattas beaten, Robin turned into a toy, and Luffy, Franky, and the others all busy elsewhere, Usopp is the last hope for Operation SOP! But will he be able to muster the confidence and courage to face the terrible Trebol? Among the cries of the Tontattas, Usopp has a difficult decision to make - run and fight another day or face his own doom and challenge Trebol!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Fateful Encounter! Kyros and King Riku!
sub.description:
The deep and tragic story of Kyros is revealed! The legend of this invincible gladiator is tied up with the royal family of Dressrosa! Meanwhile, Trebol`s defeat at the hands of Usopp is not a sure thing yet!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Operation Failed! Usoland the Hero Dies?!
sub.description:
In the Royal Palace, Viola, Luffy, and the Toy Soldier have hidden themselves outside Doflamingo`s chamber, only to have more enemies approach from behind, leaving them surrounded! Meanwhile, Franky is knocked out cold by the Navy, and all hopes rest on Usopp to provide the miracle everyone needs!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Legend Is Back! Kyros` All-out Blow!
sub.description:
Usopp manages to knock Sugar out and Operation SOP is accomplished! The toys in Dressrosa start turning back to their original forms and the people are slowly realizing who Doflamingo really is! In the meantime, the legendary hero Kyros reverts to his true form - and this mighty champion of the Colosseum has a score to settle!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Fire Fist Strikes! The Flare-Flare Fruit Power Returns!
sub.description:
Kyros finally taking down Doflamingo leaves Doflamingo’s clan shocked! Meanwhile at the Colosseum, Rebecca gets her memories of her loving father Kyros back, and Sabo makes a move to end the championship battle by blowing up the whole ring! Will he be able to snag the Flare-Flare Fruit?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Dashing onto the Scene! The Chief of Staff of the Revolutionary Army, Sabo!
sub.description:
Luffy hurries to free Law, but with their pirate alliance dissolved, will Law still see Luffy as an ally? Meanwhile, Usopp has convinced his new-found followers to destroy the factory! Doflamingo`s defeat has thrown Dressrosa into chaos, but the Young Master may have a trick left up his sleeve...
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Devil`s Trap! A Dressrosa Extermination Plan!
sub.description:
The mystery of Doflamingo`s return from the dead is revealed! But there isn`t much time to ponder how it happened, as his plan to silence the country of Dressrosa unfolds, spelling doom for the Straw Hats!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The 500 Million Berry Men! Target: Usoland!
sub.description:
As the people of Dressrosa see their friends and loved ones slaughter each other under the manipulation of Doflamingo, memories of 10 years ago rush back, and the truth of that event becomes clear. Doflamingo announces the rules for his deadly game - targeting Luffy, King Riku, and Law, but with the highest bounty reserved for Usopp!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Breaking Through Enemy Lines! Luffy and Zoro Launch the Counter-Attack!
sub.description:
Doflamingo and Fujitora`s agreement to not engage each other lasts for the moment - meaning all eyes are turned towards taking down the Straw Hats and claiming the rewards! And as Luffy starts heading to the Royal Palace along with Zoro and Law, Fujitora stands in his way!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: With a Rumbling of the Ground! The God of Destruction - Giant Pica Descends!
sub.description:
Robin, Usopp, the Tontatta`s and the others make moves to rejoin Luffy as Doflamingo`s deadly game rages on! Meanwhile, Kin`emon makes it to the trash heap in his search for his friend Kanjuro - just as Pica emerges in the town and changes the stakes of the game!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Gathering into a Powerful Front! Luffy and a Group of Brutal Warriors!
sub.description:
With Luffy and the others recovering from Pica`s attack, the game is afoot! Luffy has just enough time to regroup and set out to find Doflamingo, only to find that the dastardly Warlord has more enemies than he might realize! A strange argument breaks out - to decide who gets to take down Doflamingo once and for all!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Steady Progress! Luffy`s Army vs. Pica!
sub.description:
Don Chin Jao and Elizabello successfully break Pica’s giant arm but the rock giant is unfazed and starts throwing even more destructive punches at Luffy and his band of unwanted collaborators! Meanwhile, Navy Admiral Fujitora moves into action, summoning all the Navy soldiers on the island!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Shocking Confession! Law`s Soulful Vow!
sub.description:
Luffy and Moocy fast approach the showdown with Doflamingo - while the others with a beef against him continue to tag along. Meanwhile, Violet finds the key to Law`s handcuffs, and Rebecca pledges to deliver it to him. Finally, Law`s reason for despising Doflamingo is revealed!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Big Collision! Chief of Staff - Sabo vs. Admiral Fujitora!
sub.description:
Luffy makes headway toward Doflamingo`s refuge, making his way through Doflamingo`s guards, while down below Admiral Fujitora faces off against Sabo, who has the power of the Fire Fist from eating the Flare-Flare Fruit! But with Fujitora`s ability to call down a meteor, will Sabo have to power to save himself?
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Desperate Situation! Luffy Gets Caught in a Trap!
sub.description:
Luffy cuts a lucky break as Kelly Funk shows him a shortcut to the Palace! But all may not be as it seems... Meanwhile, Franky and Zoro are locked in one-on-one duels, while Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo enlist the help of the Tontattas to catch up with Luffy and Law!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Great Escape! Luffy`s Tide-Turning Elephant Gun!
sub.description:
Penned in at the bottom of a well, Luffy and Law are caught in a trap! But someone has come to save them who they least expect! Meanwhile, the Tontattas help Franky break in to the SMILE factory, and Bartolomeo resorts to tactics he used in the Colosseum to defend himself and protect Robin and Rebecca!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A United Front! Luffy`s Breakthrough to the Victory!
sub.description:
The Tontattas locate their captive comrades and seem to be able to get the message to them - the prison break is on! Meanwhile, heavy-hitters from the Colosseum turn from wringing each other`s necks towards a unified plan, which might just be enough to get Luffy the chance to make it to a final showdown with Doflamingo!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Second Samurai! Evening Shower Kanjuro Appears!
sub.description:
Hidden far underground, Kin`emon finds his old friend Kanjuro, whose powers allow the two to, quickly, but not elegantly, escape to the surface! Meanwhile, Cavendish shares his fears that the "Birdcage" game Doflamingo is playing has been rigged all along - and that the only way to win is to take the Warlord down!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Hard-Fought Battle Against Pica! Zoro`s Deadly Attack!
sub.description:
The Tontattas are in full revolt! But can they keep their wits about them long enough to make it out? Meanwhile, Zoro finally gains the upper hand against Pica, and Franky finds a way to deal with Señor Pink.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Little People`s Princess! Captive Mansherry!
sub.description:
Franky finally makes it into the factory and the Tontattas are reunited with their captive friends! But Princess Mansherry is nowhere to be found. Factory manager Kuween becomes irate when ignored and launches an attack on Franky while Señor Pink, wise to Frankie`s deception, arrives on the scene ready for a manly showdown!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Invincible! A Gruesome Army of Headcracker Dolls!
sub.description:
Robin, Rebecca, and Bartolomeo draw closer to the Flower Field on the fourth level of the Royal Palace plateau, but a sudden attack by Gladius exploding spheres sends Robin and Bartolomeo hurtling towards the level below - and directly into Luffy and the others` battle with the creepy Headcracker Dolls!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Risking Their Lives! Luffy Is the Trump Card for Victory!
sub.description:
Rebecca makes it to the Flower Field alone, but unfortunately finds company there that is less than friendly! Meanwhile, Bartolomeo pushes himself to the limit in order to help Luffy advance, but does he leave himself vulnerable in the process? Meanwhile, Sabo tastes Fujitora`s full might!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Tearful Reunion! Rebecca and Kyros!
sub.description:
Diamante has Rebecca pinned and completely overpowered. If only the Soldier-san of her youth were able to protect her! Meanwhile, Luffy and Law finally surmount incredible odds to land themselves in striking distance of Doflamingo -- but Sugar stands in their way!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: One Shot One Kill! The Man Who Will Save Dressrosa!
sub.description:
Usopp uses Viola`s Clairvoyance to prepare his ammunition to take Sugar out! But the slightest hesitation now will spell disaster -- and the end of Luffy! Luckily for the Straw Hats, Usopp`s ammunition has been specially designed for this specific situation!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Anger Erupts! Luffy and Law`s Ultimate Stratagem!
sub.description:
The final showdown with Doflamingo begins, but the Warlord still has several tricks up his sleeve - including turning one of Luffy`s own friends against him! Meanwhile Franky and Señor Pink are in a standoff to find out who is the coolest.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Noble Family! The True Identity of Doflamingo!
sub.description:
All hopes rest on Luffy and Law being able to take down Doflamingo; but the Warlord has other plans in mind as he gives the two the fight of their lives, and reveals his true, shocking history! Meanwhile, Sabo finds out Fujitora’s true intention…
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Ultimate Power! The Secret of the Op-Op Fruit!
sub.description:
With Fujitora`s stalemate arousing suspicion in the Navy ranks, Law and Luffy stand seconds away from execution at the hand of Doflamingo! But before he dispatches them both, he shares the secret of his sway over the Celestial Dragons!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: Sad Memories! Law, the Boy from the White Town!
sub.description:
The horrible secret of Flevance, the White Town, is revealed, giving clues to Law`s traumatic past! A rage born from the lies of the World Government created a child who had the will to kill Corazon!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Celestial Dragon! Doffy's Stormy Past!
sub.description:
Law`s attack on Corazon looks less successful than he thought! And after he`s accepted into the Doflamingo Family, Corazon`s mysterious silence hides a fact that may save Law`s life - and a hidden danger Law must face in Doflamingo himself!
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: A Rocky Road! Law and Corazon's Journey of Life!
sub.description:
Things grow stranger for Law as he learns the secret behind why Corazon feigns being mute! But the mysterious Corazon`s actions are only beginning to baffle Law as he takes him on a journey to cure his White Lead Disease.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Time is Ticking Down! Seize the Op-Op Fruit!
sub.description:
Corazon`s double-dealing with the Navy raises suspicions both with Doflamingo and Law. But all that is secondary as Corazon finally has a chance to grab the Op-Op Fruit during a staged handoff arranged by the Government.
Source: crunchyroll

sub.title: The Moment of Resolution! Corazon's Farewell Smile!
